name: Spiced Porridge with Dates & Almonds
method: Place 50g oats, 250ml oat milk, ½ tsp cinnamon and ¼ tsp cardamom in a small saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer, stirring occasionally, and cook for 8 minutes until creamy.
Pour into your favourite bowl. Scatter the 40g chopped dates and 15g almonds on top.

name: Bircher Muesli with Apple & Cinnamon
method: The night before, mix 40g oats, 100ml oat milk, 80g yoghurt, the grated apple (120g), and ½ tsp cinnamon in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight. In the morning, stir, then top with 10g sunflower seeds and a drizzle of honey if you like.

name: Rainbow Smoothie Bowl
method: Blend the 100g açai, 100g frozen banana, and 60ml oat milk until thick and smooth.
Spoon into a bowl, then scatter over 15g hemp seeds, 25g granola, and 50g berries.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes with Tahini
method: Blitz 50g oats, 100g banana, 1 egg, ½ tsp baking powder, and ¼ tsp cinnamon in a blender until smooth.
Warm 1 tsp coconut oil in a non‑stick pan over medium heat. Pour in the batter and cook for about 3 minutes each side until golden.
Slide onto a plate, drizzle with 15g tahini and a whisper of maple syrup if you wish.

name: Scrambled Eggs on Sourdough with Spinach
method: Toast the sourdough slice. Whisk 2 eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt 1 tsp butter in a small pan over low heat. Add 30g spinach and let it wilt for 1 minute.
Pour the 2 large eggs into the same pan, stirring gently until just set. Pile onto the toast.

name: Buckwheat Porridge with Banana
method: Simmer 50g buckwheat groats in 200ml oat milk for 8–10 minutes until tender and creamy.
Pour into a bowl. Top with sliced banana, 10g walnuts, ½ tsp cinnamon, and a drizzle of honey.

name: Omelette with Feta & Spinach
method: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper. Heat 1 tsp oil in a small non‑stick pan over medium heat. Sauté 30g onion for 2 minutes, then add 30g spinach and cook until wilted.
Pour the eggs over the vegetables. Cook for 3 minutes until the edges are set, then scatter 30g feta over half the omelette and fold. Slide onto a plate.

name: Greek Yoghurt with Berries & Almonds
method: Spoon 150g yoghurt into a bowl. Top with 60g berries, 15g almonds, and a drizzle of honey.

name: Avocado on Rye with Hemp Seeds
ingredients: Pinch sea salt and chilli flakes
method: Toast the 2 slices rye bread. Mash the avocado with the ½ lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread onto the toast. Sprinkle with 10g hemp seeds and chilli flakes.

name: Warm Oat Porridge with Banana & Almond Butter
method: Cook 50g oats in 200ml oat milk for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Pour into a bowl. Top with sliced banana, 15g almond butter, ½ tsp cinnamon, and 10g chia seeds.

name: Red Lentil & Spinach Soup with Sourdough
method: Warm 1 tbsp olive oil in a saucepan. Add 50g onion and cook for 3 minutes until soft. Stir in the garlic and 1 tsp cumin for 30 seconds.
Add 60g lentils and 400ml stock. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Stir in 30g spinach until wilted. Season and serve with the sourdough toast on the side.

name: Tuna & White Bean Salad
ingredients: 95g tin tuna in olive oil, drained
100g tinned cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
method: Toss the tuna, 100g beans, onion, rocket, and 1 tsp capers together in a bowl.
Drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil and 1 tsp lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Chicken & Vegetable Soup
method: Warm 1 tsp oil. Sauté onion, carrot, and celery for 5 minutes. Add chicken and cook until no longer pink.
Pour in 400ml stock and a pinch of thyme. Simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in 30g spinach until wilted. Season.

name: Miso Tofu Broth
method: Soak the wakame in warm water for 5 minutes. Heat 350ml water to a gentle simmer — not boiling. Whisk in 1 tbsp miso.
Add the tofu, drained wakame, and spring onion. Simmer for 2 minutes. Season with ½ tsp tamari.

name: Black Bean Tacos with Avocado
ingredients: 100g tinned black beans, drained and rinsed
method: Warm the 100g beans in a small pan with ½ tsp cumin and paprika. Warm the 2 small tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill 2 small tortillas with 100g beans, avocado, salsa, and coriander. Squeeze lime over the top.

name: Warm Quinoa & Roasted Beetroot Salad
method: Roast the foil‑wrapped beetroot at 200°C for 30 minutes until tender. Cook 40g quinoa in 120ml water.
Peel and slice the 1 medium beetroot. Toss rocket with 1 tbsp oil and vinegar. Top with 40g quinoa, beetroot, 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds, and feta.

name: Lamb & Lentil Soup
method: Brown the lamb in 1 tsp oil, set aside. Sauté onion, garlic, and carrot for 5 minutes.
Return lamb, add 300ml stock. Simmer 25 minutes. Add lentils, warm through. Season and scatter parsley.

name: Tempeh & Broccoli Stir‑Fry
method: Cook 50g rice. Warm 1 tbsp oil, cook tempeh until golden. Add garlic, ginger, broccoli, carrot; stir‑fry 3 min.
Add 1 tbsp tamari, toss, and serve over rice.

name: Lentil & Roasted Capsicum Bowl
method: Cook lentils 18‑20 min until tender; drain. Roast capsicum under grill until charred, peel and slice.
Whisk 2 tbsp tahini, lemon juice, garlic, 1 tbsp oil. Toss 60g lentils with capsicum, 50g cucumber, and dressing.

name: Soba Noodle Salad with Sesame
method: Cook 75g noodles according to packet, rinse under cold water. Cook 50g edamame if frozen.
Whisk 1 tbsp tamari, sesame oil, 1 tsp vinegar, ginger. Toss 75g noodles, edamame, carrot, 50g cucumber with dressing. Top with 1 tsp sesame seeds.

name: Tuna Poke Bowl
method: Season 120g tuna with tamari and ½ tsp sesame oil. Arrange 100g rice in a bowl. Top with tuna, 50g edamame, avocado, cucumber, 1 tsp ginger, nori, and 1 tsp sesame seeds.

name: Turkey & Avocado Wrap
method: Spread 1 tbsp cranberry sauce on the 1 wrap. Layer turkey, avocado, and 20g salad leaves. Roll tightly, slice in half.

name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
method: Cook chicken in 1 tsp oil, 6 min each side, slice. Spread dressing on wrap, layer lettuce, chicken, Parmesan, roll tightly.

name: Prawn & Mango Salad
method: Toss leaves with 1 tbsp lime juice and oil. Top with 120g prawns, mango, onion, cashews, and coriander.

name: Roasted Vegetable & Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 100g mixed vegetables (capsicum, zucchini, red onion), diced
method: Cook quinoa. Toss vegetables in ½ tbsp oil, roast at 200°C 15 min. Combine quinoa, veg, remaining oil, lemon juice, and pumpkin seeds.

name: Grilled Fish Tacos with Slaw
method: Season fish with cumin, grill or pan‑fry 3‑4 min each side. Warm tortillas.
Mix 50g cabbage and carrot with 1 tbsp yoghurt and lime juice. Flake fish into 2 small tortillas, top with slaw and coriander.

name: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto & Cherry Tomatoes
method: Toss zucchini noodles with pesto. Warm briefly in a pan for 1‑2 min. Top with tomatoes, pine nuts, and nutritional yeast if using.

name: Mango & Avocado Sushi Bowl
method: Season 100g rice with vinegar. Arrange 60g avocado, mango, cucumber, and nori over rice. Drizzle 1 tsp tamari and sesame oil, scatter 1 tsp seeds.

name: Big Leafy Salad with Seeds & Tahini
method: Arrange leaves, 1 tbsp seeds, avocado, and 50g cucumber in a bowl. Whisk 1 tbsp tahini with lemon juice, 1 tbsp oil, and a splash of water. Drizzle over.

name: Grilled Chicken & Mango Salad
method: Grill chicken 6 min each side, slice. Toss leaves with lime juice and oil. Top with chicken, mango, onion, cashews, coriander.

name: Prawn & Avocado Rice Paper Rolls
ingredients: 1 tbsp sweet chilli sauce for dipping
method: Dip rice paper in warm water until pliable. Layer 4 large prawns, avocado, cucumber, 40g carrot, and herbs. Roll tightly.
Serve with sweet 1 tbsp chilli sauce.

name: Quinoa Tabbouleh with Fresh Herbs
method: Cook 40g quinoa, let cool. Combine with 50g cucumber, tomatoes, herbs, and 1 onion. Dress with 1 tbsp lemon juice and oil.

name: Stuffed Capsicums with Quinoa & Black Beans
ingredients: 1 large red capsicum, halved and deseeded
method: Mix 40g quinoa, beans, corn, and ½ tsp cumin. Fill 1 large capsicum halves. Top with 15g cheese.
Bake at 190°C for 25 min until tender.

name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Soup
method: Sauté onion in oil, add garlic and cumin. Add sweet potato, beans, and stock. Simmer 20 min until tender.
Blend roughly, leaving some texture. Serve with coriander and lime.

name: Minestrone Soup
method: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, zucchini in oil. Add garlic, tomatoes, stock, beans, oregano. Simmer 15 min.
Add pasta, cook until tender. Serve with 1 tbsp Parmesan if using.

name: Baked Potato with Hummus & Salad
method: Pierce potato and bake at 200°C for 45‑50 min until soft. Cut open and top with hummus.
Serve with 30g salad dressed in oil and lemon.

name: Chicken & Sweet Potato Soup
method: Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Add sweet potato, stock, paprika. Simmer 15 min.
Add chicken, cook 8 min. Stir in coconut cream, season.

name: Stuffed Sweet Potato with Tahini Slaw
method: Bake sweet potato at 200°C for 35 min. Massage cabbage and carrot with tahini, lemon juice, and oil.
Split sweet 1 medium potato, fill with slaw, top with 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds.

name: Tuna Melt on Sourdough
ingredients: 95g tin tuna in spring water, drained
method: Mix tuna with mayo, 20g onion, lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Pile onto one slice of sourdough, top with 30g cheese.
Grill or toast until the 30g cheese melts and the 2 slices bread is golden.

name: Egg & Avocado Rice Bowl
method: Boil eggs 7 min, cool, peel, halve. Arrange rice, eggs, avocado, and broccoli in a bowl.
Drizzle with 1 tsp tamari and sesame oil, sprinkle with 1 tsp sesame seeds.

name: Tomato & Lentil Soup
method: Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Add lentils, tomatoes, stock, and basil. Simmer 20 min.
Blend roughly. Stir in balsamic if using. Season.

name: Salmon & Rocket Salad
method: Pan‑fry salmon skin‑side down 4 min, flip 3 min. Toss rocket with oil, lemon juice, onion, and capers. Flake salmon over.

name: Chicken & Beetroot Salad with Feta
method: Roast beetroot in foil at 200°C for 30 min. Grill chicken 6 min each side. Slice.
Toss leaves with 1 tbsp oil and vinegar. Top with chicken, 1 medium beetroot, feta, and 10g walnuts.

name: Warm Lentil Dhal with Turmeric
method: Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Add turmeric and cumin, stir 30 sec. Add lentils, coconut milk, and water. Simmer 20 min.
Serve with coriander.

name: Slow‑Cooked Beef & Sweet Potato Stew
method: Brown beef in 1 tbsp oil. Sauté onion. Add garlic, 150g sweet potato, carrot, 1 tbsp tomato paste, stock, thyme. Bring to simmer.
Cover, cook on low heat 1½ hours until beef is tender. Season.

name: Lamb Shanks with Root Vegetables
method: Brown lamb in 1 tbsp oil. Sauté onion and garlic. Add 100g parsnip, carrot, stock, 100g tomatoes, and rosemary.
Return lamb, cover, and simmer 2 hours until meat falls off the bone.

name: Salmon with Roasted Veg & Quinoa
ingredients: 100g mixed vegetables (capsicum, zucchini, red onion), diced
method: Cook quinoa. Toss veg with ½ tbsp oil, roast at 200°C 15 min. Pan‑fry salmon skin‑side down 4 min, flip 3 min.
Serve salmon over 40g quinoa with roasted veg and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Chicken Thigh Curry with Brown Rice
method: Cook 50g rice. Sauté 50g onion and garlic in 1 tsp oil, add curry powder and ½ tsp turmeric. Add chicken, brown lightly.
Pour in coconut milk, simmer 20 min. Serve over rice with coriander.

name: Chickpea & Sweet Potato Curry
method: Cook rice. Sauté onion and garlic in oil, add curry powder. Add sweet potato and coconut milk, simmer 20 min.
Add 100g chickpeas, warm through. Serve over 50g rice.

name: Pan‑Seared Salmon with Mashed Potato & Greens
method: Boil potato 15 min, drain, mash with butter and milk. Steam beans 4 min.
Pan‑fry salmon skin‑side down 4 min, flip 3 min. Serve on mash with beans and lemon.

name: Chickpea & Pumpkin Curry
method: Cook 50g rice. Sauté 50g onion and 1 garlic clove in 1 tsp coconut oil. Add 1 tsp curry powder. Add 150g pumpkin, 100g chickpeas and 150ml coconut milk; simmer 20 minutes. Stir in 50g spinach until wilted. Serve over rice.

name: Lentil Bolognese with Spaghetti
method: Cook 60g spaghetti. Sauté 50g onion, 1 garlic clove and 50g carrot in 1 tsp oil. Add 60g lentils, 200g tomatoes, 1 tsp oregano and 150ml water. Simmer 20 minutes until thick. Serve sauce over spaghetti.

name: Mushroom & Lentil Shepherd's Pie
ingredients: 200g potato, boiled and mashed with 1 tsp butter
method: Sauté 50g onion and 80g mushrooms. Add 1 garlic clove, 50g cooked lentils, 1 tsp tomato paste, 100ml stock and ½ tsp thyme; simmer 10 minutes. Transfer to a small baking dish, top with 200g mashed potato. Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.

name: Black Bean Chilli with Rice
method: Cook 50g rice. Sauté 50g onion and 1 garlic clove in 1 tsp oil. Add 100g black beans, 100g kidney beans, 200g tomatoes, ½ tsp cumin and ½ tsp paprika. Simmer 20 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: Coconut Dhal with Spinach
method: Cook 50g rice. Sauté 50g onion and 1 garlic clove in 1 tsp coconut oil. Add ½ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp cumin, 60g lentils and 150ml coconut milk. Simmer 20 minutes. Stir in 50g spinach until wilted. Serve over rice.

name: Tempeh & Broccoli Stir‑Fry with Brown Rice
method: Cook 50g brown rice. Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil, cook 120g tempeh until golden. Add 1 garlic clove, 1 tsp ginger, 100g broccoli and 80g carrot; stir‑fry 3 minutes. Add 1 tbsp tamari, toss, and serve over rice.

name: Tofu & Vegetable Thai Green Curry
ingredients: 80g mixed vegetables (capsicum, zucchini, green beans), sliced
method: Cook 50g rice. Sauté 1 tbsp curry paste in 1 tsp coconut oil for 1 minute. Add 150ml coconut milk and 80g vegetables, simmer 10 minutes. Add 120g tofu, cook 5 minutes. Serve over rice with basil.

name: Chickpea Shakshuka with Crusty Bread
method: Sauté 50g onion and 1 garlic clove in 1 tsp oil. Add ½ tsp cumin and ½ tsp paprika. Add 200g tomatoes and 100g chickpeas. Simmer 10 minutes. If using eggs, make 2 wells and crack eggs in. Cover and cook 5 minutes until whites set. Serve with 50g crusty bread.

name: Miso Tofu Soba Bowl
method: Mix 1 tbsp miso, 1 tsp mirin and 1 tsp tamari into a glaze. Coat 120g tofu. Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes. Cook 75g soba noodles. Steam bok choy for 3 minutes. Serve tofu over noodles with bok choy, drizzle with 1 tsp sesame oil, top with spring onion.

name: Roasted Vegetable & Quinoa Bowl
ingredients: 100g mixed vegetables (capsicum, zucchini, red onion, sweet potato), diced
method: Cook 40g quinoa. Toss 100g vegetables in ½ tbsp oil, roast at 200°C for 15 minutes. Combine quinoa and veg, drizzle with remaining ½ tbsp oil and 1 tsp lemon juice. Serve with 2 tbsp hummus.

name: Lentil & Vegetable Casserole
method: Sauté 50g onion, 80g carrot and 80g celery in 1 tsp oil. Add 1 garlic clove, 60g lentils, 200g tomatoes, 150ml stock and 1 tsp thyme. Simmer 25 minutes until thick.

name: Pumpkin & Kale Chilli
method: Sauté 50g onion and 1 garlic clove in 1 tsp oil. Add 150g pumpkin, 100g beans, 200g tomatoes, ½ tsp cumin and ½ tsp paprika. Simmer 25 minutes. Stir in 30g kale until wilted. Season.

name: Roasted Tomato & Lentil Soup
method: Sauté 50g onion and 1 garlic clove in 1 tsp oil. Add 60g lentils, 200g tomatoes, 200ml stock and ½ tsp basil. Simmer 20 minutes. Blend roughly. Season.

name: Roasted Cauliflower & Chickpea Bowl
method: Toss 150g cauliflower and 80g chickpeas with 1 tsp oil, ½ tsp cumin and ½ tsp paprika. Roast at 200°C for 25 minutes. Whisk 15g tahini with 1 tsp lemon juice and a splash of water. Serve over 30g rocket, drizzled with dressing.

name: Creamy Mushroom & Chickpea Stroganoff
method: Cook 80g pasta. Sauté 50g onion, 1 garlic clove and 100g mushrooms in 1 tsp oil. Add ½ tsp paprika, 80g chickpeas and 100ml stock; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp sour cream off the heat. Toss with pasta.

name: Tempeh & Mushroom Stew with Crusty Bread
method: Brown 100g tempeh in 1 tsp oil. Sauté 50g onion, 1 garlic clove and 100g mushrooms. Add 200ml stock, 1 tbsp tamari, 1 tbsp tomato paste and ½ tsp thyme. Simmer 15 minutes. Return tempeh, cook 5 minutes. Serve with 50g crusty bread.

name: Tofu & Pumpkin Curry
method: Cook 50g rice. Sauté 50g onion and 1 garlic clove in 1 tsp coconut oil. Add 1 tsp curry powder. Add 150g pumpkin and 150ml coconut milk; simmer 20 minutes. Add 120g tofu, cook 5 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: Ratatouille with White Beans
method: Sauté 50g onion and 2 garlic cloves in 1 tbsp oil for 2 minutes. Add 50g eggplant, 50g zucchini, 50g capsicum. Cook 5 minutes. Add 200g tomatoes, 100g beans and 1 tsp herbs. Simmer 20 minutes until vegetables are tender.

name: Spinach & Tofu Curry
method: Cook 50g rice. Sauté 50g onion and 1 garlic clove in 1 tsp coconut oil. Add 1 tsp cumin and ½ tsp turmeric. Add 120g tofu and 150ml coconut milk; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in 50g spinach until wilted. Serve over rice.

name: Jacket Potato with Bean Chilli
method: Bake 250g potato at 200°C for 50–60 minutes until soft. Sauté 50g onion and 1 garlic clove in 1 tsp oil. Add 100g kidney beans, 50g black beans, 200g tomatoes, ½ tsp cumin and ½ tsp paprika. Simmer 15 minutes. Split potato, top with chilli and a dollop of sour cream if using.

name: Tofu Pad Thai
method: Cook 80g noodles according to packet. Drain. Pan‑fry 120g tofu in 1 tsp sesame oil until golden. Whisk 1 tbsp tamari, 1 tbsp peanut butter and 1 tsp lime juice with 2 tbsp warm water. Toss noodles and tofu with sauce, bean sprouts and spring onion. Top with peanuts if using.

name: Vegetable & Chickpea Korma
method: Cook 50g rice. Sauté 50g onion and 1 garlic clove in 1 tsp coconut oil. Add 1 tsp curry powder. Add 100g pumpkin, 50g cauliflower, 100g chickpeas and 150ml coconut milk. Simmer 20 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: Red Lentil & Coconut Soup
method: Sauté 50g carrot, 50g onion and 1 garlic clove in 1 tsp coconut oil for 5 minutes. Add 1 tsp turmeric, 60g lentils and 200ml stock. Simmer 20 minutes. Stir in 100ml coconut milk and 1 tsp lime juice. Blend if desired.

name: Mushroom & Barley Stew
method: Sauté 50g onion, 50g carrot, 50g celery and 1 garlic clove in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes. Add 100g mushrooms and cook 3 minutes. Add 50g barley, 300ml stock and 1 tsp thyme. Simmer 35–40 minutes until barley is tender.

name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Bowl
method: Roast 150g sweet potato with 1 tsp oil and ½ tsp paprika at 200°C for 20 minutes. Cook 50g rice. Whisk 1 tbsp tahini with 1 tsp lemon juice and water. Assemble bowl: rice, sweet potato, 100g beans, 30g rocket, drizzle with tahini.

name: Warm Quinoa & Massaged Kale Salad
ingredients: 50g kale, chopped and massaged with 1 tsp oil
method: Cook 40g quinoa. Massage 50g kale with 1 tsp oil until tender. Combine quinoa, kale, 50g tomatoes, 20g seeds. Dress with 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp lemon juice and 1 garlic clove.

name: Buckwheat Soba with Stir‑Fried Vegetables
method: Cook 75g soba noodles, rinse. Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil, stir‑fry 100g vegetables, 1 garlic clove and 1 tsp ginger for 3 minutes. Add noodles and 1 tbsp tamari, toss. Top with spring onion.

name: Egg Fried Rice with Vegetables
method: Heat 1 tsp sesame oil in a pan. Scramble 2 eggs, break into small pieces. Add 100g rice and 50g vegetables. Stir‑fry 3 minutes. Add 1 tbsp tamari and spring onion. Toss and serve.

name: Zucchini Fritters with Tzatziki
ingredients: 1 medium zucchini (150g), grated and squeezed dry
method: Mix 150g zucchini, 20g flour, 1 egg and 1 tbsp dill. Form into two fritters. Fry in 1 tsp oil until golden on both sides. Mix 50g yoghurt, 50g cucumber and 1 garlic clove for tzatziki. Serve with fritters.

name: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
method: Sauté 50g onion, 1 garlic clove and 100g mushrooms in 1 tsp oil until golden. Add 60g rice, stir 1 minute. Gradually add 350ml warm stock, stirring, until rice is creamy and tender (about 20 minutes). Stir in 1 tbsp Parmesan and parsley if using.

name: Vegetable & Chickpea Tagine
method: Sauté 50g onion and 1 garlic clove in 1 tsp oil for 2 minutes. Add 100g pumpkin, 50g carrot, 100g chickpeas, 200g tomatoes, ½ tsp cumin and ½ tsp cinnamon. Simmer 20 minutes. Serve over 50g couscous.

name: Spinach & Feta Omelette with Salad
method: Whisk 3 eggs. Heat 1 tsp oil in a pan, add 30g spinach, wilt for 1 minute. Pour eggs over, cook 3 minutes until edges set. Scatter 30g feta over half, fold. Serve with 30g salad leaves dressed with 1 tsp lemon juice.

name: Baked Vegetable Frittata
method: Preheat oven to 190°C. Sauté 50g vegetables in 1 tsp oil for 3 minutes. Whisk 3 eggs, stir in vegetables and 20g Parmesan. Pour into small ovenproof dish. Bake for 15 minutes until set.

name: Eggplant Parmesan (Vegetarian)
method: Brush 150g eggplant slices with 1 tbsp oil, roast at 200°C for 15 minutes until tender. Sauté 1 garlic clove, add 100g tomatoes, simmer 5 minutes. Layer eggplant and tomato sauce in a small dish, top with 30g mozzarella and 10g Parmesan. Bake at 200°C for 10 minutes until cheese melts. Garnish with basil.

name: Chicken & Quinoa Bowl with Hummus
method: Cook 40g quinoa. Season 120g chicken, pan‑fry in 1 tsp oil for 6 minutes each side. Slice. Steam 100g broccoli and 80g capsicum for 4 minutes. Arrange bowl with quinoa, chicken, vegetables and 30g hummus.

name: Chicken Stir‑Fry with Broccoli & Brown Rice
method: Cook 50g rice. Stir‑fry 120g chicken in 1 tbsp sesame oil, set aside. Add 1 garlic clove, 1 tsp ginger, 100g broccoli and 80g carrot; cook 3 minutes. Return chicken, add 1 tbsp tamari. Serve over rice.

name: Chicken & Sweet Potato Stew
method: Sauté 50g onion and 1 garlic clove in 1 tsp oil. Add 120g chicken, brown for 5 minutes. Add 150g sweet potato, 300ml stock and ½ tsp paprika. Simmer 25 minutes. Stir in 30ml coconut cream, season.

name: Lemon Herb Chicken with Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 100g mixed vegetables (capsicum, zucchini, red onion), diced
method: Marinate 120g chicken in 1 tbsp oil, lemon juice and zest, 1 garlic clove and 1 tsp oregano for 10 minutes. Toss 100g vegetables with remaining marinade. Roast chicken and vegetables at 200°C for 25 minutes.

name: Mild Chicken Curry with Brown Rice
method: Cook 50g rice. Sauté 50g onion and 1 garlic clove in 1 tsp coconut oil. Add 1 tsp curry powder and ½ tsp turmeric. Add 120g chicken, brown for 2 minutes. Add 150ml coconut milk, simmer 15 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: Lemon Herb Salmon with Asparagus
method: Place 130g salmon and 80g asparagus on a lined tray. Drizzle with 1 tbsp oil, lemon zest, 1 garlic clove and dill. Bake at 200°C for 12–15 minutes. Squeeze lemon over before serving.

name: Prawn & Avocado Tacos with Slaw
method: Cook 100g prawns in 1 tsp oil with 1 garlic clove for 2–3 minutes. Warm 2 tortillas. Mix 50g cabbage with 1 tbsp lime juice. Fill tortillas with prawns, 30g avocado, slaw and coriander.

name: Seared Tuna with Quinoa & Asian Greens
method: Cook 40g quinoa. Sear 130g tuna for 2 minutes each side (pink in the middle), slice. Stir‑fry 80g bok choy in 1 tsp sesame oil and ½ tsp ginger for 2 minutes. Serve tuna over quinoa with bok choy, drizzle 1 tsp tamari, scatter sesame seeds.

name: Baked Salmon with Herbed Couscous
method: Bake 130g salmon at 200°C for 12–15 minutes. Pour 100ml boiling water over 50g couscous, cover 5 minutes, fluff. Stir in 1 tbsp oil, 1 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp parsley and 1 tsp lemon zest. Serve salmon on couscous.

name: Prawn Stir‑Fry with Rice Noodles
method: Cook 80g rice noodles, drain. Stir‑fry 100g prawns in 1 tbsp sesame oil with 1 garlic clove and 1 tsp ginger until pink, set aside. Stir‑fry 50g snow peas and 50g carrot for 2 minutes. Add noodles, prawns, 1 tbsp tamari and 1 tsp lime juice. Toss.

name: Beef Bolognese with Spaghetti
method: Sauté 50g onion, 1 garlic clove and 50g carrot in 1 tsp oil for 3 minutes. Add 100g beef mince, brown for 5 minutes. Add 200g tomatoes and 1 tsp oregano. Simmer 15 minutes. Cook 60g spaghetti. Serve sauce over pasta.

name: Lamb & Lentil Stew
method: Brown 100g lamb in 1 tsp oil, set aside. Sauté 50g onion and 1 garlic clove. Add 60g lentils, 300ml stock, 200g tomatoes and ½ tsp cumin. Return lamb. Simmer 35 minutes until lentils and lamb are tender.

name: Beef & Vegetable Stir‑Fry with Brown Rice
method: Cook 50g rice. Stir‑fry 100g beef in 1 tbsp sesame oil, set aside. Add 1 garlic clove, 1 tsp ginger, 100g broccoli and 80g capsicum; cook 3 minutes. Return beef, add 1 tbsp tamari. Serve over rice.

name: Lamb Chops with Minted Peas & Quinoa
method: Cook 40g quinoa. Boil 100g peas for 3 minutes, drain, mash roughly with 1 tbsp mint and 1 tsp lemon juice. Season lamb chops, pan‑fry in 1 tsp oil for 3 minutes each side (medium). Serve chops with minted peas and quinoa.

name: Creamy Oats with Berries and Fresh Fig
ingredients: 250ml full-fat milk or unsweetened plant milk

name: Cardamom Peach Baked Oats
ingredients: 1/2 cup (125ml) water or unsweetened plant milk

name: Baked Oats with Blueberries and Pear
ingredients: ¾ cup (180ml) unsweetened plant milk (like oat or soy)
½ small pear, cored and diced
¼ cup (35g) fresh or frozen blueberries

name: Bircher with Poached Pear and Pistachio
Spiced Chickpea and Kale Scramble
ingredients: Large handful (50g) kale leaves, stems removed, roughly chopped

name: Grated Apple Oats with Spiced Carrot
Smoky Kūmara and Capsicum Baked Eggs
ingredients: 80g kūmara, peeled and diced into 1cm cubes
50g red capsicum, deseeded and diced into 1cm squares

name: Green Beans and Egg with Lemon Tahini
Cloudy Eggs with Crushed Peas and Greens
ingredients: Fresh parsley, a small handful, chopped, to serve

name: Kūmara, Spring Onion & Pea Bake
ingredients: 150g kūmara, scrubbed and diced into 1cm cubes
½ stalk leek, white and light green parts, thinly sliced
½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

name: Layered Beans and Eggs with Avocado
ingredients: 1/2 (200g) can black beans, rinsed and drained
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

name: Curried Rice with Greens and Salmon
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

name: White Bean & Herb Bowl with Lemon Pepita Crunch
ingredients: 1/2 can (200g) cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
1 large handful (about 30g) mixed fresh herbs (such as flat-leaf parsley, mint, dill, coriander), roughly chopped
Pinch of lemon zest (from about 1/8 lemon)
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

name: Roasted Kumara, Mustard Greens, Coddled Egg
ingredients: 4 large silverbeet leaves, stalks removed, chopped

name: Creamy Butter Beans with Rocket and Toasted Seeds
ingredients: 1/2 can (200g) butter beans, rinsed and drained
Freshly ground black pepper to taste

name: Broad Bean and Walnut Green Glow
Walnut-Crusted Fish with Braised Red Cabbage
ingredients: 150g firm white fish fillet (like hoki or gurnard)
1 tablespoon olive oil, plus extra for drizzling

name: Golden Corn, Bean and Herb Salad
ingredients: 80g broad beans, fresh or frozen (shelled weight)

name: Crimson Roots, Leaf & Crisped Bread
ingredients: 1 thick slice sourdough bread, torn into bite-sized pieces
Freshly ground black pepper to taste

name: Warm Lentil & Fennel Salad with Lemon
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

name: Spiced Sardine & Lentil Brown Rice Bake

Toast sourdough. Arrange avocado and tomato on plate.
Top with poached eggs. Season.

name: Rainbow Smoothie Bowl with Hemp Seeds
method: Blend acai, banana, and oat milk until thick.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with hemp seeds, granola, and berries.

name: Rainbow Smoothie Bowl -- Acai, Banana, Mixed Berries
method: Blend acai, banana, berries, and coconut water until thick.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with granola, coconut, and hemp seeds.

name: Scrambled Eggs with Smoked Salmon and Avocado
method: Whisk eggs. Melt butter in a pan.
Cook eggs over low heat, stirring gently until just set.
Serve on toast with smoked salmon and avocado. Garnish with dill.

name: Smoothie -- Banana, Almond Milk, Cacao, Chia
method: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Pour and serve.

name: Smoothie Bowl -- Spinach, Banana, Hemp Seeds, Cacao
method: Blend spinach, banana, cacao, and oat milk until thick.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with hemp seeds, granola, and coconut flakes.

name: Sourdough with Smashed Avocado and Microgreens
method: Toast sourdough until golden.
Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt.
Spread onto toast. Top with microgreens, pumpkin seeds, and chilli flakes.

name: Sourdough with Smashed Avocado and Poached Egg
method: Toast sourdough. Poach eggs in simmering water with vinegar for 3 min.
Mash avocado onto toast.
Top with poached eggs, salt, pepper, and chilli flakes.

name: Warm Spiced Oat Porridge with Dates and Almonds
method: Combine oats and oat milk in a saucepan. Simmer 8-10 min, stirring.
Stir in cinnamon and cardamom.
Top with chopped dates and almonds.

name: Warm Chia Pudding with Poached Pear
method: Mix chia seeds and oat milk. Let set 10 min, stirring occasionally.
Simmer pear halves in water with cinnamon and maple syrup for 8 min.
Warm the chia pudding gently. Serve topped with poached pear and walnuts.

name: Avocado and Mango Sushi Rolls
ingredients: Pickled ginger and wasabi to serve
method: Cook sushi rice per packet instructions. Season with rice wine vinegar.
Lay nori on a sushi mat. Spread rice, leaving 2cm at the top.
Layer avocado, mango, and cucumber along the centre.
Roll tightly, slice into 8 pieces. Serve with tamari and ginger.

name: Black Bean Tacos with Avocado and Salsa
method: Heat black beans in a pan with cumin and paprika.
Warm tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill tortillas with beans, avocado, salsa, and coriander.
Squeeze lime juice over the top.

name: Brown Rice Sushi Bowl with Edamame
method: Cook brown rice. Season with rice wine vinegar.
Arrange edamame, avocado, cucumber, carrot, and nori over rice.
Drizzle with tamari and sesame oil. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Chicken and Pumpkin Salad
method: Roast pumpkin at 200 degreesC for 20 min until golden.
Season and grill chicken 5-6 min each side. Slice.
Toss rocket with olive oil. Top with chicken, pumpkin, pumpkin seeds, and balsamic glaze.

name: Chicken and Pumpkin Soup
method: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add pumpkin, stock, and cumin. Simmer 15 min.
Add chicken and cook 10 min until done. Shred chicken.
Blend soup partially, stir in coconut cream and shredded chicken.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Soup with Sourdough
method: Saute onion, carrot, and celery in olive oil for 5 min.
Add chicken and stock. Simmer 15 min.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Season with thyme, salt, and pepper.
Serve with toasted sourdough.

name: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
method: Season chicken and grill 5-6 min each side. Slice.
Toss lettuce with Caesar dressing.
Top with chicken, parmesan, and sourdough croutons.

name: Grilled Chicken and Quinoa Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (capsicum, zucchini, red onion)
method: Cook quinoa per packet instructions.
Season and grill chicken 5-6 min each side. Slice.
Roast or saute vegetables in olive oil.
Assemble bowl with quinoa, chicken, vegetables, and hummus. Drizzle with lemon juice.

name: Hummus and Roasted Veg Wrap
method: Roast vegetables with olive oil and cumin at 200 degreesC for 15 min.
Spread hummus on the wrap.
Layer roasted vegetables and spinach. Roll tightly.

name: Lamb and Roasted Vegetable Wrap
ingredients: 1 cup roasted vegetables (capsicum, pumpkin, red onion)
method: Roast vegetables at 200 degreesC for 15 min.
Season and grill lamb 3-4 min each side. Slice.
Spread hummus on wrap. Layer lamb, roasted veg, and rocket. Roll.

name: Lamb Kofta Wrap with Hummus
method: Mix lamb mince with cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and garlic. Shape into small kofta.
Grill kofta 4 min each side until cooked.
Warm flatbreads. Spread with hummus.
Top with kofta, salad, and lemon juice.

name: Large Leafy Salad with Pumpkin Seeds, Sunflower Seeds, and Tahini
ingredients: 3 cups mixed salad leaves (spinach, rocket, cos)
method: Arrange salad leaves in a bowl.
Top with pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, avocado, and cucumber.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice, olive oil, and a splash of water.
Drizzle dressing over the salad. Season.

name: Lentil and Spinach Salad
method: Cook lentils in water for 15 min until tender. Drain.
Toss warm lentils with spinach, capsicum, and onion.
Dress with olive oil and balsamic. Top with pumpkin seeds.

name: Minestrone Soup with Shredded Chicken
method: Saute onion, carrot, and celery in olive oil.
Add chicken, tomatoes, stock, beans, and oregano. Simmer 15 min.
Remove chicken, shred, and return to pot. Add pasta, cook 8 min.

name: Miso Soup with Tofu and Wakame
method: Soak wakame in warm water for 5 min.
Heat water to a gentle simmer (not boiling). Whisk in miso paste.
Add tofu, wakame, and spring onions. Simmer 2 min.
Season with tamari.

name: Miso Soup with Rice and Pickled Veg
method: Heat water to a gentle simmer. Whisk in miso paste.
Add tofu and simmer 2 min.
Serve over rice with pickled vegetables and spring onion.

name: Quinoa and Roasted Beet Salad with Pumpkin Seeds
method: Cook quinoa per packet instructions.
Roast beetroot at 200 degreesC for 20 min.
Toss rocket with olive oil and balsamic.
Top with quinoa, beetroot, pumpkin seeds, and feta.

name: Roast Chicken and Avocado Salad
method: Arrange salad leaves on a plate.
Top with chicken, avocado, cucumber, and pumpkin seeds.
Dress with olive oil and lemon juice.

name: Roast Chicken and Hummus Plate
method: Arrange chicken, hummus, tomatoes, cucumber, and olives on a plate.
Warm pita bread. Drizzle plate with olive oil.

name: Roast Chicken Sandwich with Avocado
method: Spread mayonnaise on bread.
Layer chicken, avocado, and rocket. Season.
Close sandwich and slice.

name: Roasted Veg and Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (capsicum, zucchini, red onion, kumara)
method: Cook quinoa. Roast vegetables with 1 tbsp olive oil at 200 degreesC for 15 min.
Toss leaves with remaining olive oil and lemon juice.
Top with quinoa, roasted veg, and pumpkin seeds.

name: Roasted Chickpea and Root Vegetable Bowl
method: Toss chickpeas, kumara, and carrots with olive oil and spices.
Roast at 200 degreesC for 25 min.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water.
Serve roasted veg over spinach, drizzle with tahini dressing.

name: Roasted Veg Frittata (Vegan, Chickpea Flour)
method: Whisk chickpea flour, water, nutritional yeast, turmeric, baking powder, salt, and pepper.
Let batter rest 10 min.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe pan. Add roasted vegetables.
Pour batter over and cook 5 min. Transfer to oven at 200 degreesC for 15 min.

name: Soba Noodle Salad with Sesame Dressing
method: Cook soba noodles per packet instructions. Rinse under cold water.
Whisk tamari, sesame oil, rice wine vinegar, and ginger.
Toss noodles with vegetables and dressing.
Top with sesame seeds and spring onion.

name: Tuna Poke Bowl with Edamame
method: Season tuna with tamari and sesame oil.
Arrange rice in a bowl. Top with tuna, edamame, avocado, and cucumber.
Garnish with ginger, sesame seeds, and nori.

name: Vietnamese Rice Paper Rolls
method: Dip rice paper in warm water until pliable.
Layer vermicelli, vegetables, tofu, mint, and coriander.
Roll tightly, tucking in sides. Repeat.
Serve with hoisin sauce.

name: White Bean and Kale Soup
method: Saute onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add beans, stock, and paprika. Simmer 15 min.
Add kale and cook 5 min until wilted.
Season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice.

name: Beef Bolognese with Pasta
method: Saute onion, garlic, carrot, and celery in olive oil.
Add beef mince and brown, breaking up with a spoon.
Add tomatoes and oregano. Simmer 20 min.
Cook pasta. Serve sauce over pasta with parmesan.

name: Beef and Mushroom Stroganoff
method: Cook noodles. Sear beef in butter over high heat, set aside.
Saute onion and mushrooms in olive oil.
Add stock, simmer 5 min. Stir in sour cream and mustard.
Return beef, heat through. Serve over noodles with parsley.

name: Beef and Vegetable Stir-fry with Noodles
method: Cook noodles. Stir-fry beef in sesame oil over high heat. Set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, ginger, and vegetables for 3 min.
Add noodles, beef, tamari, and oyster sauce. Toss well.

name: Baked Fish with Lemon Butter and Greens
method: Place fish in a baking dish. Top with butter, lemon juice, dill.
Bake at 200 degreesC for 15 min.
Blanch greens in boiling water for 2 min. Toss with olive oil.
Serve fish with greens and pan juices.

name: Chicken and Mushroom Pie with Salad
method: Saute onion and mushrooms in butter. Add flour, stir 1 min.
Add stock and cream. Simmer until thickened.
Add chicken and cook 10 min. Season.
Transfer to a pie dish, top with pastry, brush with egg.
Bake at 200 degreesC for 20 min until golden. Serve with salad.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala with Rice
ingredients: Coriander and naan bread to serve
method: Marinate chicken in yoghurt and half the tikka sauce for 10 min.
Saute onion and garlic. Add chicken, cook until golden.
Add remaining sauce, simmer 15 min.
Cook rice. Serve with coriander and naan.

name: Fish Pie with Mashed Potato
method: Boil potatoes until soft. Mash with half the butter and a splash of milk.
Saute leek in remaining butter. Add flour, stir 1 min. Add milk and cream, simmer until thick.
Add fish and peas, cook 5 min. Transfer to a baking dish.
Top with mash. Bake at 200 degreesC for 15 min until golden.

name: Grilled Fish with Roasted Capsicum and Couscous
method: Grill capsicums until charred. Peel and slice.
Season fish and grill 4 min each side.
Pour boiling water over couscous, cover 5 min, fluff.
Toss couscous with capsicum, olive oil, lemon, and parsley. Serve with fish.

name: Lamb Cutlets with Roasted Vegetables
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (kumara, capsicum, red onion, zucchini)
method: Toss vegetables with 1 tbsp olive oil and rosemary. Roast at 200 degreesC for 20 min.
Season lamb cutlets. Pan-fry 3 min each side for medium.
Rest 5 min. Serve with roasted vegetables.

name: Lentil Bolognese with Pasta
method: Saute onion, garlic, carrot, and celery in olive oil.
Add lentils, tomatoes, and 1 cup water. Simmer 25 min.
Season with oregano and salt.
Cook pasta. Serve sauce over pasta with nutritional yeast.

name: Roast Chicken with Roasted Vegetables
method: Rub chicken with olive oil, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Arrange vegetables around chicken in a roasting pan.
Roast at 200 degreesC for 50 min until golden and cooked through.
Rest 10 min before carving. Serve with pan juices.

name: Salmon with Mashed Kumara and Greens
method: Boil kumara until soft. Mash with butter.
Season salmon. Pan-fry skin-side down 4 min, flip 3 min.
Blanch greens. Serve salmon on kumara mash with greens.

name: Salmon with Roasted Vegetables and Quinoa
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (capsicum, zucchini, red onion)
method: Cook quinoa. Roast vegetables with olive oil at 200 degreesC for 15 min.
Season and pan-fry salmon 4 min each side.
Serve salmon on quinoa with roasted vegetables and lemon juice.

name: Salmon Teriyaki with Stir-fried Vegetables
method: Marinate salmon in teriyaki sauce for 5 min.
Pan-fry salmon 4 min each side.
Stir-fry vegetables in sesame oil for 3 min.
Cook rice. Serve salmon over rice with vegetables, sesame seeds, and spring onion.

name: Slow-cooked Beef Casserole with Root Vegetables
method: Brown beef, set aside. Saute onion. Add flour, stir.
Add stock, tomato paste, and thyme. Return beef.
Add root vegetables. Cover, cook at 160 degreesC for 2 hours.
Season and serve.

name: Slow-cooked Lamb Shanks with Root Vegetables
method: Brown lamb shanks in olive oil. Set aside.
Saute onion and garlic. Add tomatoes, stock, and rosemary.
Return shanks, add vegetables. Cover.
Cook at 160 degreesC for 2.5 hours until meat falls off the bone.

name: Slow-cooked Lamb Curry with Rice
method: Brown lamb in olive oil. Set aside.
Saute onion, garlic, and spices.
Add coconut milk and lamb. Simmer 1 hour until tender.
Cook rice. Serve curry over rice with coriander.

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Burrito Bowl
ingredients: 2 tbsp Greek yoghurt or sour cream
method: Roast sweet potato with olive oil and cumin at 200 degreesC for 20 min.
Cook rice. Warm black beans.
Assemble bowls: rice, sweet potato, beans, avocado, salsa, yoghurt.
Garnish with coriander and lime.

name: Tempeh Stir-fry with Broccoli and Ginger
method: Stir-fry tempeh in sesame oil until golden.
Add ginger and broccoli. Cook 3 min.
Add tamari, toss. Serve over rice with sesame seeds.

name: Teriyaki Tempeh with Jasmine Rice
method: Marinate tempeh in teriyaki sauce for 5 min.
Pan-fry tempeh in sesame oil until caramelised.
Steam broccoli and carrot.
Cook rice. Serve tempeh over rice with vegetables, sesame seeds, and spring onion.

name: Fig and Blackberry Porridge
method: Cook oats with plant milk and top with fresh figs and blackberries.

name: Pear and Blueberry Baked Oats
method: Mix oats with plant milk and fruit and bake until set.

name: Mango and Pomegranate Porridge
method: Cook oats and top with diced mango and pomegranate seeds.

name: Peach and Cardamom Baked Oats
method: Mash banana into oats with cardamom and bake with sliced peach.

name: Pistachio and Pear Overnight Oats
method: Combine oats with plant milk overnight then top with pear and pistachios.

name: Cinnamon Apple and Carrot Overnight Oats
method: Mix oats with grated apple and carrot overnight; serve with cinnamon.

name: Masala One-pan Breakfast
method: Fry chickpeas and kale with masala spices in one pan until golden.

name: Spicy Baked Beans
method: Simmer beans in harissa-spiced passata with peppers; stir through spinach and serve on sourdough.

name: Sriracha Sweet Potato Hash
method: Fry sweet potato and onion until crispy; add sriracha and sweetcorn then wilt cavolo nero.

name: Breakfast Green Beans with Dill and Sumac
method: Sauté spring vegetables and crack in eggs to bake; drizzle with tahini and sumac.

name: Fiery Frittata
method: Fry squash and peppers slowly; add spiced egg mixture and finish in the oven.

name: Spring Green and Broad Bean Shakshuka
method: Simmer greens and beans in passata; poach eggs in the sauce and scatter with parsley.

name: Za'atar Frittata
method: Fry potatoes and leeks; pour in za'atar egg mixture and finish in the oven.

name: Sourdough and Veggie Sausage Bake
method: Roast leeks and sausages; add torn sourdough and roast until golden; drizzle with caper relish.

name: Huevos Rancheros
method: Cook beans and peppers in spiced tomato sauce; poach eggs in the pan and serve with avocado.

name: Fennel and Mustard Potatoes
method: Roast potatoes and fennel with seeds; add kale and eggs to bake; dress with Dijon vinaigrette.

name: Spicy Salmon Kedgeree
method: Bake rice with spiced stock then lay salmon and greens on top and return to oven.

name: Breakfast Burritos
method: Bake spiced rice and beans; serve wrapped in tortillas with avocado guacamole.

name: Ginger Chicken Salad with Tahini Ranch Dressing
method: Poach chicken with ginger and star anise; arrange on salad leaves and drizzle with tahini ranch dressing.

name: Mixed Herb Salad with Paprika and Sumac
method: Spoon hummus onto plates; pile salad and beans on top; scatter toasted spiced seeds.

name: Roasted Carrot Salad with Allspice Cinnamon and Pistachio
method: Roast spiced carrots; toss with lentils and watercress; drizzle with molasses and scatter feta.

name: Green Leaves and Broad Beans with Preserved Lemon and Paprika
method: Blanch broad beans; toss with spinach and preserved lemon; dress with spiced balsamic oil.

name: Butter Bean Salad with Fried Garlic and Hazelnut Dressing
method: Fry hazelnuts and anchovies in oil; add spices and garlic; toss with beans and leaves.

name: Herb and Walnut Crumbed Fish with Pickled Red Cabbage
method: Quick-pickle red cabbage; press herb-walnut crumb onto fish and bake; serve with peas.

name: The Red One
method: Roast spiced beetroot with seeds; add torn sourdough to crisp; toss with radicchio and tomatoes.

name: Southern-style Succotash Salad
method: Fry beans and corn with garlic until golden; toss with tomatoes and serve on leaves.

name: Harissa Green Bean Salad
method: Roast beans and nuts with harissa; add spinach to wilt; drizzle with molasses and pomegranate.

name: Grilled Chicory Salad with Fennel Capers and Pecans
method: Char chicory on a griddle; toss with shaved fennel, lentils, pecans and lemon dressing.

name: Kimchi Slaw with Greens and Sriracha Mayo
method: Squeeze kimchi juice into sriracha mayo dressing; toss with shredded veg and kimchi.

name: Mixed Bean Salad with Spicy Tarragon and Oregano Dressing
method: Blanch green beans; toss with tinned beans and olives in a herby citrus dressing.

name: Masala Rice with Sardines
method: Combine rice, lentils, peas and spinach in a baking dish; top with sardines and bake covered.

name: Wild Mushroom Barley and Beans
method: Soak mushrooms; simmer barley with root veg and mushroom stock; stir in beans.

name: Fragrant Jewelled Rice
method: Simmer rice with spices and chickpeas; fold in courgettes, cherries and nuts off the heat.

name: Nasi Goreng
method: Bake rice with nasi goreng paste and vegetables; fold in beansprouts and serve with peanuts.

name: Broad Bean Pea and Dill Rice
method: Simmer rice with beans and peas; fold in herbs and dot with saffron butter to finish.

name: Jamaican-style Rice and Peas
method: Fry rice with aromatics; add peas and spices and simmer; serve with lime and coriander slaw.

name: Spinach and Watercress Risotto
method: Slowly add stock to toasted rice; stir in watercress and spinach; finish with Parmesan.

name: Pearl Barley Mint and Asparagus Risotto
method: Simmer pearl barley with fennel and celery; add asparagus and mint at the end; finish with Parmesan.

name: Ginger and Tomato Pilau
method: Fry spices with rice and aromatics; simmer in spiced tomato stock; fold in greens.

name: Leek Artichoke and Prawn Paella
method: Fry leeks and courgettes; toast rice; simmer in saffron stock; add artichokes and prawns.

name: Massaman Cauliflower
method: Roast spiced cauliflower wedges; add lentils and roast again; scatter with coriander.

name: Smoky Glazed Pepper and Prawn Tacos with Caramelised Pineapple
method: Grill prawns with pepper and pineapple in smoky-sweet glaze; serve in corn tacos with avocado.

name: Spicy Garlic Mushrooms with Pomegranate
method: Roast mushrooms and onion with spices; toss with watercress and scatter pomegranate seeds.

name: Harissa Fennel Aubergine and Chickpeas
method: Smother vegetables in harissa-pomegranate mixture; roast until tender; scatter with lemon and dill.

name: Baked Spiced Celeriac with Hummus and Pomelo
method: Roast spiced celeriac and chickpeas; toss with pomelo and rocket; serve on harissa hummus.

name: Roasted Masala Chickpeas with Green Bean Sambol
method: Roast chickpeas and beans with curry spices; toss with coconut, tomatoes and lime.

name: Herb-baked Aubergine with Tenderstem Broccoli
method: Roast herbed aubergine; add broccoli and beans; scatter breadcrumbs and roast until crispy.

name: Roast Sea Bass and Asparagus with Tomatoes and Capers
method: Roast asparagus and tomatoes with capers; add spinach and sea bass on top and bake.

name: Black-eyed Peas with Sweetcorn Tarragon and Paprika
method: Roast beans with sweetcorn and onion; squeeze over lemon and toss with rocket and tarragon.

name: Gochujang Tempeh with Baby Aubergine and Sesame
method: Roast tempeh and aubergine in gochujang glaze; add chard and sesame for final 10 minutes.

name: Roasted Brassicas and Tofu with Chilli Miso Sauce
method: Roast sprouts, broccoli and tofu with tamari and maple; drizzle with miso-tahini dressing.

name: Baked Sea Bass Fillets with Fennel Oregano and Lentils
method: Roast broccoli and leeks; add lentils and sea bass and bake until fish is just cooked.

name: Cinnamon and Cumin Roasted Winter Vegetables with Baked Halloumi
method: Roast winter vegetables; add pitta and halloumi with spices and bake until golden.

name: Sweet Masala Charred Greens and Peanuts
method: Roast broccoli and peanuts with garam masala; add lentils and honey; toss spinach to wilt.

name: Fennel Leek and Beans with Basil Pesto
method: Toss fennel, beans and leeks in pesto and lemon; roast until tender; scatter hazelnuts.

name: Spanish-style Beans with Marsala and an Almond Picada
method: Roast courgettes and tomatoes with spices; add marsala and beans; serve with almond picada.

name: Ginger and Lemongrass Snapper with Mangetout and Peas
method: Marinate snapper in ginger-soy glaze; roast with greens until fish is cooked through.

name: Sri Lankan Polos Curry
method: Fry spices with onion; add jackfruit and simmer in coconut milk and tomatoes; finish with coconut.

name: Butternut Korma
method: Fry squash with whole spices and ground almonds; simmer in stock; stir in spinach and yoghurt.

name: Caribbean-style Black Bean Curry
method: Fry aromatics with Caribbean spices; simmer beans and tomatoes until sticky and reduced.

name: Pumpkin Peanut Curry
method: Fry pumpkin with spices; add peanut butter and tomatoes; simmer and fold in greens.

name: Almond Chicken Curry
method: Toast spices and almonds; brown chicken and simmer in spiced tomato sauce; wilt spinach.

name: Coconut Yellow Dhal with Tamarind and Curry Leaves
method: Simmer lentils with coconut, tamarind and aromatics; add green beans and spinach to finish.

name: Mango Pickle and Squash Curry
method: Fry squash until coloured; add mango pickle and mustard seeds; simmer in tomatoes and wilt spinach.

name: Sambal Red Lentils
method: Fry aromatics and sambal; simmer lentils in coconut milk; add peas and finish with coconut.

name: Jerk-style Jackfruit and Sweet Potato Curry
method: Fry jackfruit and onion with jerk spices; simmer with sweet potato and tomatoes until tender.

name: Split Green Peas with Kaffir Lime and Coconut
method: Simmer soaked peas with coconut milk and aromatics; add green beans; finish with coconut flakes.

name: Tempeh Red Curry
method: Brown tempeh; sauté onion with curry paste; simmer vegetables in peanut coconut sauce; return tempeh.

name: Malaysian-style Kari
method: Fry whole spices with aromatics; add aubergine and lentils and simmer for 40 minutes; blend to a thick dhal.

name: Persian-style Brown Lentils with Mixed Green Herbs
method: Fry spiced onion; simmer lentils in passata and stock; finish with fresh herbs and serve with yoghurt.

name: Cajun Crab Stew
method: Fry vegetables with Cajun spice; simmer in passata and stock; fold in crab meat at the end.

name: Chicken Gumbo
method: Brown chicken; fry the holy trinity with spices; return chicken and simmer in thickened stock.

name: Prawn Bouillabaisse
method: Slowly cook fennel and leeks; add saffron broth and simmer; add prawns to cook through.

name: Green Gumbo
method: Sauté the green vegetables; add spices and stock; simmer with greens and beans until thick.

name: French Lentils with a Dijon and Red Wine Vinaigrette
method: Fry shallot and vegetables; simmer lentils in stock; dress hot lentils with Dijon vinaigrette.

name: Rice Butter Bean and Wild Mushroom Stew
method: Fry mushrooms with rice and sage; simmer in stock with cashew butter; add beans to finish.

name: Tuscan Beans
method: Fry onion and squash with sage and chestnuts; simmer in stock; add beans and cabbage.

name: Walnut and White Bean Stew
method: Slowly sauté onion with juniper and thyme; add walnuts and figs; simmer with beans and chard.

name: Harissa Lentil Stew with Feta and Honey
method: Slowly fry leeks; simmer lentils in harissa tomatoes; wilt spinach and top with feta and honey.

name: Ful Medames with Spinach and Garlic and Herb Dressing
method: Simmer beans in spiced tomatoes with spinach; mash lightly and serve with herb-lemon dressing.

name: Korean-style Bean Stew
method: Sauté ginger and garlic; add beans with gochujang; simmer with tofu and sesame oil.

name: Red Bean Giouvetsi
method: Combine everything in a casserole; simmer then bake; scatter with feta and parsley.

name: Borlotti Bean Soup with Pesto
method: Simmer beans and greens in tomato stock; serve with a dollop of fresh basil pesto.

name: 5-a-day Bean Soup
method: Fry five vegetables; simmer with beans and chestnuts in stock; blend until smooth.

name: Haricot Bean Leek and Olive Soup
method: Sauté leeks with herbs; add beans, olives and spinach; blend and top with feta and hazelnuts.

name: Green Masala Cauliflower Soup
method: Fry spices with onion and cauliflower; simmer in stock; blend with spinach and coconut cream.

name: Iranian-style Soup with Sumac and Fresh Green Herbs
method: Fry onion with spices; simmer chickpeas with spinach in stock; serve with herbs and yoghurt.

name: Black Bean and Chipotle Soup
method: Simmer beans and celery with chipotle in spiced stock; rough-blend and top with avocado.

name: Ultimate Garlic Broth with Sage and Greens
method: Fry garlic half; simmer in water with sage for 40 minutes; add greens and noodles to finish.

name: Korean-style Broth with Kimchi
method: Stir-fry gochujang and garlic; add stock and simmer; add kimchi, cabbage and tofu.

name: Fennel Brodo
method: Toast fennel seeds; soften fennel and onion; simmer in white wine and stock with orzo and broccoli.

name: Chicken and Mushroom Ramen
method: Poach chicken with ginger in stock; add miso, mushrooms and noodles; top with beansprouts.

name: Asparagus Courgette and White Bean Broth with Pistou
method: Infuse stock with chilli; cook asparagus and courgettes; top with herb pistou.

name: Sesame Rice Noodles with Carrots and Peas
method: Cook noodles; stir-fry in tahini-soy sauce with spring onions; toss in peas and carrots.

name: Balsamic Sautéed Mushrooms with Rosemary
method: Fry golden sourdough then sauté mushrooms with garlic and pine nuts; deglaze with balsamic.

name: Bang Bang Cauliflower
method: Stir-fry cauliflower in hoisin-sriracha sauce until tender; stir through beansprouts.

name: Green Beans and Black-eyed Peas
method: Fry onion and green beans with spices; add spring greens to wilt; stir in black-eyed peas.

name: Spring Vegetables with Miso Butter and Teriyaki Rice
method: Melt miso butter with mushrooms; steam mangetout and asparagus; toss in rice with teriyaki.

name: Spicy Mushroom and Tofu Shawarmas with Cucumber Yoghurt
method: Fry mushrooms and tofu with shawarma spices and molasses; fill flatbreads with cabbage and yoghurt.

name: Asian-style Green Vegetables in Black Bean Sauce
method: Stir-fry greens with ginger-black bean sauce; toss with soaked noodles and water chestnuts.

name: Spring Greens Soup with Roasted Asparagus
method: Roast asparagus; sauté leek and garlic; blend soup base with white beans; top with roasted asparagus.

name: Chunky Gazpacho with Cumin
method: Blend or pulse all vegetables to desired chunkiness; season with cumin and vinegar; chill before serving.

name: Italian Escarole Soup
method: Sauté onion and garlic; add broth and tomatoes; stir in escarole and white beans; simmer until tender.

name: Red Bean and Butternut Caldo Verde
method: Sauté onion; add squash and broth; simmer; stir in kale and red beans; season with paprika.

name: Borscht with Cabbage and Dill
method: Sauté vegetables; add beets and broth; simmer until tender; finish with dill and a splash of vinegar.

name: Ribollita with White Beans and Kale
method: Sauté aromatics; add tomatoes, broth, beans, and kale; simmer; stir in stale bread to thicken.

name: Hot and Sour Soup with Shiitakes and Greens
method: Simmer broth with mushrooms and ginger; add greens and tofu; season with vinegar and miso for hot-sour balance.

name: Three-Bean Soup with Turmeric and Lentils
method: Sauté onion and spices; add lentils, beans, tomatoes, and broth; simmer until lentils are tender.

name: Ginger Carrot Soup
method: Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger; add carrots and broth; simmer; blend until smooth; finish with lemon.

name: Cheesy Broccoli Soup
method: Cook broccoli and onion in broth; blend with white beans and nutritional yeast for creamy cheesy texture.

name: Ratatouille-Inspired French Lentil Soup
method: Roast or sauté ratatouille vegetables; add lentils and broth; simmer with herbes de Provence until tender.

name: My Minestrone
method: Sauté aromatics; add vegetables and broth; simmer; add beans and pasta near end of cooking.

name: Mushroom Barley Soup
method: Sauté mushrooms and aromatics; add barley and broth; simmer 45–60 minutes until barley is tender.

name: Corn Chowder
method: Sauté onion and celery; add potatoes and broth; blend part of the soup; stir in corn and beans.

name: Curried Lentil and Kale Soup
method: Sauté onion with curry spices; add lentils, tomatoes, and broth; simmer; stir in kale until wilted.

name: Tuscan White Bean Soup with Roasted Fennel
method: Roast fennel; sauté garlic and rosemary; add beans, tomatoes, and broth; simmer; top with fennel.

name: Summer Salad
method: Toss fresh summer vegetables and fruit with greens; drizzle with balsamic syrup.

name: Waldorf Slaw
method: Shred cabbage; combine with apple, celery, grapes, and walnuts; dress with creamy tahini-date dressing.

name: Thai Green Papaya Salad
method: Shred papaya; toss with vegetables and a tangy lime-chili dressing; top with peanuts.

name: Rye Berry Salad
method: Toss cooked rye berries with fresh vegetables and herbs; dress with a simple vinaigrette.

name: Vegetable Chirashi Bowls
method: Prepare seasoned rice; arrange colorful toppings; drizzle with umami sauce and sesame seeds.

name: Southwest Kale Salad with Cumin–Tomato Dressing
method: Massage kale; toss with beans, corn, and onion; dress with cumin-tomato vinaigrette.

name: Marrakech Sorghum Salad with Fresh Apricots and Mint
method: Toss cooked sorghum with apricots, chickpeas, and mint; dress with lemon and cumin.

name: Corn and Black-Eyed Pea Salad
method: Combine vegetables and beans; toss with tangy vinegar-based dressing.

name: Barley Tabbouli Salad with Tahini Drizzle
method: Cook barley; cool and toss with herbs and vegetables; drizzle with lemon-tahini dressing.

name: Red Bean and Arugula Salad with Mango Balsamic Dressing
method: Toss arugula and beans with mango slices; dress with mango-balsamic vinaigrette.

name: Lettuce Cups with Curried Tempeh and Chickpeas
method: Crumble and cook tempeh with chickpeas and curry spices; serve in lettuce cups with chutney.

name: Watercress and Summer Fruit with Balsamic Syrup
method: Arrange watercress with summer fruit; drizzle with balsamic syrup and garnish with mint.

name: Roasted Potato Salad with Basil Pesto Dressing
method: Roast potatoes until golden; toss warm with basil pesto, green beans, and tomatoes.

name: Chopped Salad Bowl
method: Chop all vegetables uniformly; toss with chickpeas and herb dressing.

name: Antipasto Vegetables with Tuscan White Bean Dressing
method: Roast vegetables; arrange on platter with antipasto accompaniments; dress with blended white bean sauce.

name: Indonesian Gado-Gado
method: Blanch or steam vegetables; arrange with tempeh; drizzle with spiced peanut dressing.

name: Cauliflower Alfredo Linguine with Roasted Asparagus
method: Roast asparagus; blend cauliflower sauce with nutritional yeast and garlic; toss with pasta.

name: Pasta with Creamy Pumpkin Sauce
method: Blend pumpkin with beans and nutritional yeast into a creamy sauce; toss with cooked pasta.

name: Zucchini Linguine with Mushroom–Lentil Bolognese
method: Cook mushroom-lentil bolognese; serve over zucchini ribbons or noodles.

name: Penne Primavera
method: Sauté spring vegetables; toss with cooked penne and a light garlic-lemon sauce.

name: Pesto-Tossed Spaghetti Squash Noodles and White Beans
method: Roast and shred spaghetti squash; toss with pesto, white beans, and tomatoes.

name: Pasta with Roasted Tomato Sauce
method: Roast tomatoes until caramelized; blend into sauce with garlic and herbs; toss with pasta.

name: Gemelli with Zucchini Meatballs and Avocado Chimichurri
method: Form and bake zucchini-walnut meatballs; blend avocado chimichurri; serve over gemelli.

name: Pasta with Garlicky White Beans and Italian Kale
method: Sauté garlic and kale; add white beans and broth; toss with pasta and lemon.

name: Root Vegetable Mac 'n Cheese
method: Roast or steam root vegetables; blend into cheesy sauce with nutritional yeast and beans; toss with pasta.

name: Green Bean and Mushroom Stroganoff
method: Sauté mushrooms; blend creamy cashew-bean sauce; toss with green beans and pasta.

name: Three Sisters Stew
method: Sauté aromatics with spices; add squash, corn, beans, and tomatoes; simmer until tender.

name: Cheesy Cauliflower Potato Bake
method: Layer cauliflower and potatoes in baking dish; pour over blended cheesy bean sauce; bake until golden.

name: Ethiopian-Inspired Collard Greens and Beans
method: Sauté onion with berbere; add greens and beans; simmer with broth until tender.

name: Black Cumin–Rubbed Balsamic Roasted Cauliflower
method: Rub cauliflower with spice paste; roast whole until golden and tender; serve sliced.

name: Roasted Root Vegetables on Garlic-Braised Greens
method: Roast root vegetables; braise greens with garlic; plate vegetables atop wilted greens.

name: Portobellos and Spinach on Cauliflower Mash with Miso–Mushroom Sauce
method: Mash steamed cauliflower; sauté portobellos and spinach; make miso-mushroom gravy; assemble.

name: Jicama Nachos
method: Slice jicama into chips; top with seasoned beans, vegetables, and fresh salsa; serve with avocado.

name: Cauliflower Piccata with Mushrooms and Potatoes
method: Roast cauliflower steaks; sauté mushrooms; make piccata sauce with capers and lemon; serve over potatoes.

name: Balsamic Butternut, Brussels, and Beets
method: Roast all vegetables; drizzle with balsamic syrup; serve warm.

name: Vegetable Tart
method: Press grain-bean crust into pan; fill with seasoned vegetable mixture; bake until set.

name: Artichoke and Spinach Stuffed Portobellos
method: Sauté filling of artichoke, spinach, and beans; stuff into portobello caps; bake until tender.

name: Bell Peppers Stuffed with Black Beans and Mushroom–Walnut Crumbles
method: Make mushroom-walnut crumbles; mix with beans and grains; stuff peppers; bake in tomato sauce.

name: Roasted Kabocha with Kale–Cranberry Stuffing
method: Roast squash halves; make kale-cranberry grain stuffing; fill and bake until tender.

name: Cumin-Roasted Carrots with Chickpeas and Tomatoes
method: Roast carrots and chickpeas with cumin; toss with tomatoes and fresh herbs; serve warm.

name: Sage-Kissed Sweet Potato Wedges with Shallots
method: Roast sweet potato wedges with shallots and sage; drizzle with balsamic; serve hot.

name: Cottage Pie with Sweet Potato Mash
method: Make lentil-vegetable filling with mushroom gravy; top with mashed sweet potato; bake until bubbling.

name: Cornmeal-Crusted Buffalo Tempeh with White Bean Ranch
method: Batter tempeh in cornmeal; bake; toss in hot sauce; serve with creamy white bean ranch dip.

name: Red Bean and Beet Cutlets
method: Blend beans with beets, walnuts, and grains; shape into cutlets; refrigerate; bake until firm.

name: Persian-Inspired Black-Eyed Peas and Greens
method: Sauté onion and carrots; add greens, spices, and black-eyed peas; simmer until tender.

name: Butternut–Black Bean Chili
method: Sauté vegetables with spices; add beans, tomatoes, and squash; simmer 45 minutes; garnish with scallions.

name: BBQ Tempeh with Sweet Potatoes and Collards
method: Braise collards; roast sweet potatoes; cook tempeh in BBQ-style sauce; serve in bowls.

name: Black Lentil Dal
method: Sauté aromatics with spices; add lentils and broth; simmer 35–45 minutes; finish with lemon and cilantro.

name: West African Red Bean and Sweet Potato Stew
method: Sauté aromatics; add sweet potatoes, tomatoes, and broth; simmer; stir in kidney beans and peanut butter.

name: Red Curry Chickpeas and Kabocha Squash
method: Make red curry paste; roast squash wedges; cook chickpeas in curried tomato sauce; plate together.

name: Szechuan Tempeh and Broccoli
ingredients: Szechuan sauce (miso, molasses, five-spice, rice vinegar)
method: Marinate and sear tempeh; stir-fry vegetables; add Szechuan sauce; serve over whole grains.

name: Vegetable Paella with Golden Barley
method: Sauté aromatics; add barley, tomatoes, and broth; simmer 45–50 minutes; stir in beans and peas.

name: Great Grain Tart
method: Press grain-bean crust into pie plate; fill with sautéed mushroom-chard mixture; bake 30–35 minutes.

name: Millet Risotto with Mushrooms, White Beans, and Spinach
method: Cook millet in broth; sauté mushrooms; combine with beans and spinach; serve drizzled with balsamic syrup.

name: Baked Grain Loaf with Umami Gravy
method: Process grains and lentils with walnuts; press into loaf pan; bake 50–60 minutes; serve with mushroom gravy.

name: Turmeric Quinoa and Red Beans with Cauliflower and Chard
method: Cook turmeric quinoa; sauté cauliflower and beans with spices; stir in chard; serve over quinoa.

name: Stuffed Winter Squash with Millet and Kale
method: Pre-roast squash; cook millet-kale stuffing; fill and bake; make roasted pepper-tomato sauce to top.

name: Sorghum and Chickpeas with Broccoli and Tomatoes
method: Cook sorghum in broth; stir-fry broccoli and chickpeas with umami-tahini sauce; combine and serve.

name: Teff and Black Lentils over Berbere-Spiced Kale
method: Cook teff and lentils separately with berbere; braise kale in spiced tomato broth; layer in bowls.

name: Grain-Stuffed Bell Peppers with Cheesy Tomato Sauce
method: Fill peppers with grain-chickpea stuffing; bake in tomato puree; top with blended cheesy tomato sauce.

name: Green Tea Quinoa and Peas with Roasted Asparagus
method: Roast asparagus; cook quinoa in brewed green tea with ginger and peas; top with sesame seeds.

name: Barley-Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
method: Make barley-bean filling; blanch cabbage leaves; roll and arrange in baking dish; cover with tomato sauce; bake.

name: Ful Medames
method: Simmer fava beans with garlic and spices; top with chopped cucumber-tomato garnish and black cumin.

name: Kale and Sweet Potato Hash
method: Roast sweet potato; sauté vegetables with umami sauce; add kale and peas; press and brown hash.

name: Stovetop Overnight Oats with Bananas and Pecans
method: Boil groats briefly; soak overnight; reheat next morning; stir in banana and nutmeg; top with pecans.

name: Quinoa Kitchari
method: Cook quinoa and moong dal together with vegetables and spices until creamy; top with cilantro.

name: Chocolate-Covered Cherry BROL Bowl
method: Warm BROL; top with cocoa, date syrup, walnuts, and cherries; stir and serve.

name: Millet Upma
method: Sauté vegetables with spices; add millet and broth; simmer until tender; top with cashews and cilantro.

name: Chickpea–Cauliflower Scramble
method: Sauté vegetables with spices; add mashed chickpeas; cook until set; serve with salsa or hot sauce.

name: BROL Bowl with Sautéed Greens
method: Sauté vegetables and kale in broth; serve over warm BROL; sprinkle with nutritional yeast and lemon.

name: Slow Cooker Apple Pie Oat Groats
ingredients: optional goji berries and date syrup
method: Soak groats; combine with apple, chia, and cinnamon in slow cooker; cook overnight on low; top as desired.

name: Fresh Berries with Chocolate Balsamic Syrup
Black Forest Chia Pudding
ingredients: optional almond slivers or cacao nibs

name: Baked Apples with Walnuts and Goji Berries
Dill and Caper Cream Salmon Burger
method: Finely chop salmon and mix with breadcrumbs, dill and lemon zest to form 4 patties.
Bake at 200°C for 8–9 minutes. Crisp kale in oven 3 minutes.
Make dill and caper cream with crème fraîche, dill and capers. Assemble with cream on buns topped with kale, tomato and salmon patty.

name: Asian-Style Spiced Chicken Burger
method: Season chicken with chilli and garlic powder. Bake at 220°C for 20–22 minutes. Rest covered.
Make cucumber ginger topping. Mix mayo and soy sauce for dressing.
Assemble buns with lettuce, chicken, cucumber topping, avocado and coriander.

name: Open Steak and Blue Cheese Sandwich
method: Season and cook steaks 2 minutes each side. Rest 8–10 minutes.
Make garlicky tomato mix with tomatoes, garlic and thyme. Dress rocket with oil.
Build open sandwiches with rocket on toast, topped with sliced steak, blue cheese and tomato mix.

name: Thai Green Chicken Curry with Coconut and Chickpeas
method: Make coconut milk from creamed coconut block. Brown chicken in batches and set aside.
Stir-fry aubergine then add curry paste and coconut milk; reduce. Add chickpeas and return chicken to warm through.
Cook rice. Toast desiccated coconut. Serve with rice, chilli and coriander.

name: Thai Prawn Curry with Spiced Quinoa
method: Make coconut milk. Cook onion and garlic; set half aside for quinoa. Add curry paste and coconut milk; reduce.
Add prawns, soy sauce, fish sauce and lime with mangetout and edamame; simmer 5–6 minutes.
Cook quinoa in stock. Stir reserved onion mix, sesame seeds and chilli into quinoa. Serve curry over quinoa.

name: Prawn and Avocado Tacos
method: Cook onion, garlic and chilli with tomatoes and spices. Add prawns and cook until pink. Drain excess moisture.
Mash avocados with lime juice, soured cream, chilli and coriander. Mix in sliced lettuce.
Fill taco shells with avocado mix then prawn mix. Finish with coriander and chilli flakes.

name: Chicken Satay Skewers with Peanut Sauce
method: Marinate chicken strips in curry paste, honey and spices. Thread on skewers and bake 20–23 minutes at 220°C.
Make peanut sauce by simmering coconut milk with peanut butter, curry paste, honey, soy sauce and vinegar.
Toast sesame seeds and reheat rice. Make cucumber salad. Serve chicken over rice with peanut sauce.

name: Ginger and Oyster Sauce Chicken with Egg-Fried Rice
method: Brown chicken strips in batches and set aside. Stir-fry ginger, garlic, mushrooms and cabbage.
Return chicken and stir through oyster sauce; simmer until cooked.
Cook rice. Make egg-fried rice with garlic, spring onions, scrambled eggs, rice, soy sauce and chilli finished with sesame oil. Serve together.

name: Buffalo-Style Peri-Peri Chicken Bowl
method: Season chicken with paprika and garlic. Bake at 220°C for 15 minutes then brush with peri-peri sauce and bake 5–6 more minutes. Rest and slice.
Toast walnuts at 190°C for 8–10 minutes. Make ranch dressing with yoghurt, mustard and garlic.
Serve lettuce and celery topped with chicken, ranch dressing, blue cheese and walnuts.

name: Cowboy Beef Burger with Corn Relish
method: Mix beef with spices and tomato puree; shape into 4 patties. Fry 3 minutes each side then cover and cook through.
Make corn relish by combining corn, spring onions, garlic, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, chilli, paprika, coriander, mayo and lemon.
Build burgers with lettuce, tomato, relish and patty.

name: Hoisin Beef Noodle Stir-Fry
method: Marinate steak strips in soy sauce and ginger for 10 minutes. Make hoisin-sesame sauce.
Fry steak in batches; set aside. Stir-fry mushrooms, pepper, pak choy and spring onions; add garlic. Return beef and pour over sauce; toss 1–2 minutes.
Toss cooked noodles in sesame oil. Serve noodles topped with beef and vegetables.

name: Steak and Black Bean Burritos
method: Brown steak strips in batches; set aside. Sauté onion and pepper then add garlic, oregano, stock, passata and tomato puree.
Simmer to thicken then add beans and return beef with lime juice and jalapeños.
Divide among tortillas with cheese, soured cream and coriander; wrap tightly.

name: Spiced Lamb Koftas with Tzatziki
method: Mix lamb with spices and mint; shape onto skewers in cylinders. Bake at 220°C for 17–18 minutes.
Make tzatziki with grated drained cucumber, yoghurt, garlic, lemon and mint.
Assemble wraps with tzatziki, koftas, tomatoes and fresh mint.

name: Baked Eggs with Creamed Spinach and Ham
method: Wilt spinach in a pan and add garlic. Stir in crème fraîche and nutmeg. Mix in chopped ham.
Transfer to greased baking dish and make 4 wells. Crack an egg in each and scatter gruyère.
Bake at 200°C for 15–16 minutes until whites are set. Serve with toasted sourdough.

name: Garlic Parsley Butter Salmon with Potatoes
method: Boil potatoes 13–15 minutes. Blanch asparagus and broccoli 4 minutes.
Bake salmon skin-side up at 220°C for 8–10 minutes.
Make garlic parsley butter and drizzle over potatoes and greens. Make caper browned butter by browning butter then adding garlic and capers. Drizzle over salmon.

name: Herb-Crumbed Cod with Cannellini Bean Mash
method: Mix crumb with breadcrumbs, sesame seeds, herbs and spices. Brush cod with mustard and coat in crumb. Bake on a rack at 220°C for 13–14 minutes.
Make bean mash: sauté onion and garlic, add beans and stock then mash with crème fraîche, mustard, lemon zest, thyme and Parmesan.
Cook and butter peas. Serve fish over mash with peas.

name: Pan-Seared Sea Bass with Herbed Pomegranate Rice
method: Cook corn 3–4 minutes. Sauté onion and garlic with cumin then warm rice through.
Season sea bass with cumin and cook skin-side down 2 minutes then flip 2 minutes.
Stir corn, pomegranate seeds, herbs and almonds into rice. Serve fish over colourful rice with lemon wedges.

name: Coronation Chicken with Spinach and Chickpeas
method: Bake seasoned chicken at 220°C for 20–21 minutes. Rest and slice. Toast flaked almonds.
Sauté onion and garlic with curry powder and spinach. Add chickpeas and apricots; warm through.
Stir in crème fraîche and honey. Serve chicken with spinach-chickpea mix and toasted almonds.

name: Garlic Butter Baked Chicken with Herbed Quinoa
method: Bake chicken seasoned with paprika and oregano at 220°C for 20–21 minutes. Rest and slice.
Cook quinoa in stock with garlic powder and thyme; stir in Parmesan.
Blanch broccoli and kale 4 minutes; toss with oil and lemon. Make garlic butter; stir some into quinoa. Serve chicken over quinoa with greens.

name: Golden Sesame-Crumbed Chicken with Ratatouille
method: Make ratatouille: sauté aubergine and courgette then add garlic, tomato puree, peppers, herbs and tomatoes. Simmer 8–10 minutes and stir in honey and fresh herbs.
Flatten chicken breasts. Coat in seasoned flour, then egg, then seeded breadcrumbs.
Shallow-fry in batches 2.5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Serve with ratatouille.

name: Pan-Fried Pork Chops with Cannellini Beans and Greens
method: Quick-pickle thinly sliced red onion in vinegar for 20–25 minutes. Boil potatoes 25 minutes and mash with mustard and crème fraîche.
Season and fry pork chops 4–5 minutes per side.
Make buttered beans and greens by reducing stock with butter then adding beans, peas and wilted rocket. Serve chops over beans with mash and pickled onion.

name: Cheddar-Topped Beef and Mushroom Cottage Pie
method: Boil and mash potatoes with cream cheese and half the cheddar.
Brown mince with onion then add mushrooms, garlic, spices, herbs, vinegar, tomatoes, Worcestershire sauce, peas and corn. Cook until thick and tip into baking dish.
Spread mash over top, scatter with remaining cheddar and bake at 220°C for 17–20 minutes.

name: Jacket Potatoes with Beef and Bean Chilli
method: Brush potatoes with oil and bake at 200°C for 50–70 minutes.
Make beef and bean chilli: brown mince with onion, garlic and spices then add stock, tomatoes, beans, tomato puree and Worcestershire sauce. Simmer 20–30 minutes until thick.
Split jackets and load with chilli, cheese, soured cream and chilli.

name: Sticky Soy Steak Stir-Fry with Crushed Potatoes
method: Boil potatoes 14–15 minutes. Sauté spring onions, garlic and ginger in oil then add potatoes and crush lightly.
Make sauce with mirin, rice wine vinegar, soy sauce and honey. Sear steak strips in batches; set aside.
Add remaining garlic, ginger and sauce to pan; add mangetout and simmer. Return steak and coat in sauce. Serve over crushed potatoes.

name: Dukkah-Crusted Sirloin with Chilli Butter Corn
method: Pan-fry steaks in hot oil 2 minutes per side for medium. Rest 8–10 minutes then slice and brush with oil and scatter over dukkah.
Boil corn 7–8 minutes. Make garlic paprika chilli butter and toss corn in it.
Scatter cheese over warm corn to melt. Serve steak with buttered corn and lime wedges.

name: Steak with Parmesan Mash
method: Boil and mash potatoes with Parmesan and crème fraîche. Season.
Roast cabbage wedges at 220°C for 16 minutes then brush with garlic butter and roast 4 more minutes.
Season and fry steaks 2 minutes per side. Rest 8–10 minutes and slice. Serve steak with Parmesan mash and garlic butter cabbage wedges.

name: Moroccan-Spiced Lamb with Butternut Squash and Herbed Couscous
method: Toss lamb chops and squash with spices and oil. Roast at 200°C for 26–30 minutes.
Caramelise onion slowly in a pan then add garlic. Make couscous in hot stock; fluff and stir in caramelised onion and fresh herbs.
Plate couscous topped with lamb and squash. Finish with crumbled feta and toasted almonds.

name: Slow-Rendered Duck Pancakes with Hoisin Sauce
method: Score duck skin and render fat-side down 15 minutes then sear 1 minute. Transfer to baking dish with stock and honey; sprinkle with 5-spice and bake at 180°C for 15–25 minutes.
Rest uncovered then thinly slice. Make pancakes from flour and hot water; roll thin and cook 20 seconds per side.
Serve duck with hoisin sauce, cucumber strips and spring onions in pancakes.

name: Three Cheese Pasta Salad
method: Cook and cool pasta; toss with olive oil. Toast pine nuts 3–4 minutes.
Combine pasta with tomatoes, mozzarella, feta, olive oil and Parmesan. Season.
Add torn basil just before serving. Plate with rocket and finish with pine nuts and extra Parmesan.

name: Mushroom and Chickpea Stroganoff
method: Sauté onion then add garlic, mushrooms, paprika and thyme; cook until golden. Add lemon juice, chickpeas, stock, soy sauce and mustard.
Simmer until thick then stir in crème fraîche. Cook pasta and toss in olive oil.
Divide pasta among bowls and top with mushroom mix. Scatter toasted chopped walnuts and parsley.

name: Hot-Smoked Salmon with Broad Beans and Lemon Pasta
method: Cook pasta and drizzle with olive oil. Cook broad beans 5 minutes; shell them.
Combine warm pasta with shelled beans, olive oil, lemon juice and zest, olives and dill. Season.
Flake in hot-smoked salmon and gently toss. Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Thai Seafood Broth with Egg Noodles
method: Boil fish stock with garlic, ginger, lemongrass, lime leaves and chilli for 2 minutes then infuse 10 minutes off heat. Stir-fry pak choy.
Strain broth into pak choy pan. Add fish sauce, soy sauce, tamarind and lime juice. Simmer and add prawns and fish for 5–6 minutes until cooked.
Prepare noodles and divide among bowls. Ladle broth and seafood over. Top with coriander and chilli.

name: Lemon and Garlic Prawn Stir-Fry with Egg Noodles
method: Toss prawns with lemon zest. Make sauce with lemon juice, garlic, soy sauce, honey, vinegar, chilli and paprika.
Stir-fry veg 2–3 minutes then set aside. Cook prawns in batches; set aside. Add sauce to pan and deglaze.
Return veg; let sauce bubble. Return prawns and add noodles; toss 1–2 minutes until coated. Finish with lemon squeeze.

name: Quick Chicken Ramen
ingredients: 400g shredded slow-cooked chicken (or cooked chicken breasts)
method: Sauté garlic and ginger 3–4 minutes. Add stock, soy sauce, vinegar and sweet chilli sauce; simmer 5–6 minutes.
Add shredded chicken in last minute. Soft-boil eggs 5–6 minutes; halve. Prepare noodles.
Divide noodles among bowls and ladle over broth and chicken. Top with carrot, spring onions and halved boiled eggs.

name: Chicken and Pesto Pasta with Sun-Dried Tomatoes
method: Bake chicken seasoned with garlic powder, paprika and oregano at 220°C for 20–21 minutes. Rest 8–10 minutes and slice.
Toast pine nuts 3–4 minutes. Cook tagliatelle; drain and toss with pesto and sun-dried tomatoes.
