Divide pasta among plates and top with sliced chicken. Scatter pine nuts and basil.

name: Chicken Marsala Pasta with Mushrooms
method: Brown chicken strips in batches; set aside. Cook mushrooms until golden; add garlic and thyme. Deglaze with marsala and simmer 2 minutes.
Return chicken and simmer 8–10 minutes. Stir in crème fraîche off heat.
Cook pasta and toss with olive oil. Serve pasta topped with chicken and mushroom sauce with Parmesan and parsley.

name: Harissa Chicken and Roasted Pepper Pasta
ingredients: 400g shredded slow-cooked chicken (or cooked chicken breasts)
method: Cook pasta and reserve 100ml pasta water. Sauté onion then add garlic, pasta water and peas; cook 2–3 minutes.
Add peppers and harissa. Stir in crème fraîche and fold in shredded chicken.
Serve over pasta scattered with parsley.

name: Lemon and Oregano Chicken with Orzo
method: Roast chicken skin-side up at 220°C for 20 minutes. Nestle oiled onion wedges around chicken; cook 17–19 more minutes.
Cook orzo. Sauté garlic and chorizo then add oregano, lemon zest, orzo, tomatoes and olives with lemon juice.
Plate orzo topped with roasting juices then chicken and onion wedges. Finish with lemon zest and fresh oregano.

name: Smoky Paprika Chicken and Broccoli Pasta Bake
method: Stir-fry broccoli, corn and spring onions then add garlic; set aside. Brown chicken pieces; set aside. Cook pasta.
Mix pasta, veg and chicken in baking dish. Make béchamel sauce with butter, flour, paprika and milk; stir in Parmesan.
Pour sauce over pasta and bake at 220°C for 15–16 minutes until golden.

name: Quick Beef Bolognese with Herby Spaghetti
method: Brown mince until crispy; add garlic and fresh herbs in last 2 minutes. Stir in passata and honey; cover and keep warm.
Cook spaghetti; reserve 100ml pasta water. Make herby butter sauce with butter, garlic, herbs and pasta water; toss spaghetti to coat.
Fry eggs. Serve spaghetti with mince topped with a fried egg.

name: Creamy Curry Meatball Pasta
method: Bake meatballs with oil at 220°C for 15–18 minutes. Cook pasta.
Sauté onion then add curry powder and turmeric. Pour in beef stock; simmer until reduced by half.
Off heat stir in chutney and crème fraîche. Add meatballs to sauce. Serve saucy meatballs over pasta scattered with parsley.

name: Sesame-Coated Chickpea Cakes with Coriander Lime Dip
method: Blitz chickpeas with spring onions, garlic, chilli, herbs and spices. Mix in egg. Chill 30 minutes.
Form into 20 balls, coat in sesame seeds and bake at 200°C for 10 minutes then 220°C for 10–12 minutes until golden.
Cool 10–15 minutes. Make dressing with lime juice, olive oil, coriander, garlic and chilli powder. Serve sesame cakes with dip.

name: Lentil, Chickpea and Broccoli with Golden Halloumi
method: Roast broccoli at 200°C for 10–12 minutes. Fry halloumi slices in batches 2 minutes per side until golden; season and add lemon zest.
Sauté onion and garlic then deglaze with lemon juice. Add lentils, chickpeas and peppers; warm through.
Make dressing with red wine vinegar and oil. Serve legume mix with roasted broccoli drizzled with dressing and topped with halloumi.

name: Quinoa with Ginger Mushrooms and Crispy Tofu
method: Cook quinoa 12–15 minutes then fluff. Stir-fry mushrooms in batches until golden; add garlic and ginger in last minute.
Reduce heat and add spring onions, soy sauce, lime juice and chilli. Stir mushroom mix into quinoa with sesame oil.
Toss tofu in soy sauce and cornflour then fry until golden on all sides. Gently fold tofu into quinoa. Serve with lime wedges.

name: Spicy Mixed Bean Chilli Bowl
method: Make bean chilli: sauté onion and pepper then add garlic, spices and tomato puree. Add tomatoes and water with black and kidney beans and soy sauce; simmer 5–7 minutes until thick.
Cook rice. Fry eggs.
Divide rice among bowls and serve with bean chilli topped with a fried egg, sliced avocado and crumbled feta. Serve with lime wedges.

name: Crispy Tempeh with Lemon Miso Dressing and Roasted Veg
method: Toss tempeh in soy sauce, garlic powder and paprika; spread on tray. Toss pepper and courgette with oil and season; spread on second tray.
Roast both at 200°C for 20 minutes. Cook rice.
Make lemon miso dressing with miso paste, lemon juice, olive oil, maple syrup and garlic. Combine rice and roasted veg; top with crispy tempeh and drizzle with dressing.

name: Roasted Sweet Potato with Lentils and Goat's Cheese
method: Roast sweet potato wedges with spices at 230°C for 25 minutes. Toast seeds.
Sauté onion until golden; add garlic then lentils, cumin and paprika. Stir in spinach and cook until wilted.
Serve lentil-spinach mix topped with sweet potato wedges, crumbled goat's cheese, a drizzle of honey and toasted seeds.

name: Roasted Butternut Squash and Lentil Stew
method: Roast squash with spices at 210°C for 17–20 minutes. Toast pumpkin seeds and desiccated coconut.
Make coconut milk from creamed coconut. Sauté onion, carrot and celery then add garlic, spices, lentils, beans, tomato puree, coconut milk and spinach.
Simmer 8–10 minutes. Serve lentil stew topped with roasted squash, coconut yoghurt and toasted seed garnish.

name: Mushroom and Lentil Vegetable Bolognese
method: Sauté onion, carrot and celery 8–10 minutes. Add mushrooms, garlic and spices. Stir in tomato puree, tomatoes, water and lentils; simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Add soy sauce and honey. Cook spaghetti; drain and toss in oil.
Stir most of the basil into sauce. Serve pasta with lentil bolognese and Parmesan.

name: Aubergine and Lentil Bake with Egg Custard Topping
method: Slice aubergine and bake at 220°C for 10 minutes. Make lentil filling: sauté onion and carrot then add garlic, mushrooms, spices, tomatoes, lentils and tamari; reduce until dry.
Layer aubergine in baking dish then lentil mix then remaining aubergine.
Whisk eggs, cream cheese, cream, nutmeg and cinnamon; pour over and bake 20 minutes until golden and cooked through.

name: Ratatouille and Feta Baked Omelette
method: Whisk eggs and season. Heat oil or butter in non-stick pan over medium-low heat.
Pour quarter of egg mix and cook undisturbed 2–3 minutes until edges set. Add quarter of ratatouille veg over one side; scatter feta. Fold and cook 1 more minute.
Slide out and repeat for remaining 3 omelettes.

name: Spinach, Olive and Feta Quiche
method: Wilt spinach with garlic until dry; mix in olives, capers and tomatoes.
Whisk eggs with crème fraîche, cream cheese and herbes de Provence; season. Line a 20cm tin. Pour egg mix and fold in spinach mix.
Scatter crumbled feta and bake at 200°C for 18–20 minutes then rest in residual heat 5–10 more minutes. Serve with torn basil.

name: Soba Noodle and Edamame Salad
method: Toast cashews at 190°C for 6–8 minutes and roughly chop. Cook soba noodles; cool in water. Cook edamame 3–4 minutes; cool.
Combine edamame, carrot, red pepper, spring onions, sesame seeds and coriander. Add noodles.
Whisk dressing with sesame oil, soy sauce, vinegar, maple syrup, ginger and garlic. Toss salad in dressing and top with toasted cashews.

name: Black Bean and Mixed Veg Salad
method: Toast seeds in dry pan 2–3 minutes. Cook edamame and corn 3–4 minutes; cool.
Combine edamame, corn, black beans, cabbage, tomatoes, feta and coriander in a large bowl.
Whisk dressing with olive oil, lime juice, honey and cumin; season. Pour over salad and scatter toasted seeds.

name: Crispy Spiced Chickpea and Avocado Salad
method: Toss drained dried chickpeas with oil and spices; roast at 220°C for 25 minutes until crunchy.
Make coriander lime dressing with lime juice, olive oil, garlic and coriander.
Combine rocket, tomatoes, cucumber and avocado; add dressing and toss. Top with halved eggs and crispy chickpeas just before serving.

name: Spinach, Lentil and Beetroot Salad
method: Cook peas 3–4 minutes and cool. Toast pumpkin seeds in dry pan 4–5 minutes.
Thinly slice beetroot and goat's cheese.
Combine with lentils, peas, spinach and mint. Whisk olive oil and red wine vinegar; season. Drizzle over salad and scatter toasted pumpkin seeds.

name: Scrambled Egg and Fresh Salsa Wraps
method: Drain finely chopped tomatoes in a sieve. Scramble whisked eggs in oil over low heat; season.
Make mini salsa with drained tomatoes, red onion, coriander and chilli flakes.
Spoon scrambled eggs over tortillas and top with salsa. Roll tightly and wrap in foil if saving for later.

name: Boiled Egg and Hummus Wraps
method: Hard-boil eggs 8–10 minutes; cool, peel and finely chop. Toast sesame seeds in dry pan; add paprika and chilli flakes off heat.
Combine with eggs and mayo; season.
Spread hummus over tortillas and layer with spinach and egg mix. Roll tightly.

name: Soft-Boiled Egg and Quinoa Salad
method: Cook quinoa until all water absorbed 9–12 minutes; fluff and cool slightly. Season with olive oil and soy sauce.
Boil eggs 5–6 minutes for soft yolks or 8–10 for set.
Combine seasoned quinoa, tomatoes and cucumbers. Top with quartered boiled eggs.

name: Egg and Pea Salad with Dill Dressing
method: Hard-boil eggs 8–10 minutes; cool, peel and slice or chop. Cook peas 3–4 minutes; cool.
Make dill and mustard dressing with yoghurt, olive oil, Dijon mustard and chopped dill; season.
Combine dressing with eggs, peas, rocket and red onion; toss gently to coat.

name: Salmon, Avocado and Bulgur Wheat Salad
method: Cook bulgur wheat 10–15 minutes; drain and cool.
Combine cooled bulgur, lettuce, cucumber, avocado and spring onions. Flake in salmon.
Make sesame soy dressing with soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, honey and garlic. Drizzle over salad and scatter sesame seeds.

name: Tuna and Avocado Rice Bowl
method: Add rice wine vinegar, spring onions, cucumber, tuna and avocado to cooked rice; season and toss.
Make ginger sesame dressing with olive oil, sesame oil, soy sauce, lime juice and fresh ginger.
Drizzle over and scatter sesame seeds.

name: Crispy Fish Cakes with Sweet Chilli Mayo
method: Boil and mash potato. Mix with tinned fish, spring onions, lemon zest, herbs and crème fraîche; form into 12 small patties.
Coat in seasoned flour, then egg, then breadcrumb and sesame seed mix. Shallow-fry in batches 1 minute per side until golden.
Mix mayo with sweet chilli sauce. Serve fishcakes with dip.

name: Mediterranean Baked Chicken with Butter Bean Salad
method: Bake seasoned chicken at 220°C for 20 minutes. Rest and slice. Toast pine nuts 3–4 minutes.
Combine butter beans, olive oil, lemon juice and zest, oregano, garlic, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives and feta.
Make lemon yoghurt drizzle with yoghurt, lemon juice, garlic and oregano. Serve bean mix topped with chicken and drizzle.

name: Spiced Chipotle Chicken Lettuce Bowl
method: Make spiced tomato paste with tomato puree, vinegar, spices and water. Fry chicken pieces at high heat 9–10 minutes; add spicy tomato mix and simmer 1–2 minutes to coat. Cool.
Dress sliced lettuce with olive oil and season. Divide among bowls; add tomatoes, olives and spicy chicken.
Top with soured cream, cheddar, chilli and coriander. Serve with lime.

name: Paprika Chicken and Chorizo Bean Bowl
method: Bake paprika-seasoned chicken at 220°C for 20 minutes. Rest and slice.
Cook corn 3–4 minutes. Make paprika dressing with olive oil, red wine vinegar, honey and smoked paprika.
Combine corn, beans, chorizo, red peppers and red onion; drizzle with dressing and toss. Top with sliced chicken. Serve with butterhead lettuce.

name: Shredded Chicken with Herb Tabbouleh Salad
ingredients: 200g shredded slow-cooked chicken (or cooked chicken breast)
method: Cook bulgur wheat 10–15 minutes; drain and cool.
Combine cooled bulgur, tomatoes, cucumber and finely chopped herbs. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice; season and toss.
Serve alongside shredded chicken with extra olive oil drizzled over.

name: Turkey and Chipotle Sourdough Sandwich
method: Mix crème fraîche with chipotle paste; season.
Spread dressing over 2 bread slices. Layer with lettuce, avocado, tomatoes, sunflower seeds, red onion and turkey.
Season and top with remaining bread slices.

name: Chimichurri Steak with Rice and Rocket
method: Season steaks and pan-fry 2 minutes per side for medium. Rest 8–10 minutes covered.
Make chimichurri with finely chopped parsley, garlic, oregano, chilli flakes, olive oil and red wine vinegar.
Season and toss rice with olive oil and oregano. Plate seasoned rice with tomatoes and rocket; top with sliced steak and drizzle with chimichurri.

name: Beef Meatballs with Minty Lentil Salad and Feta
method: Bake meatballs with oil at 220°C for 15–18 minutes.
Combine lentils, cucumber, spinach and feta in bowls. Top with meatballs.
Make mint and garlic dressing with olive oil, apple cider vinegar, garlic and mint; drizzle over. Finish with yoghurt and pomegranate seeds.

name: Strawberry Jam and Peanut Butter Overnight Oats
method: Combine oats, milk, honey and vanilla in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
For 2 pots: combine base mix with Greek yoghurt. Divide into 2 pots.
Layer each with strawberry jam and peanut butter. Top with chopped peanuts and strawberries.

name: Lemon and Poppy Seed Overnight Oats
method: Combine oats, milk, honey and vanilla; refrigerate overnight.
For 2 pots: mix base with Greek yoghurt. Stir in poppy seeds, lemon zest and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Divide into 2 pots and drizzle with extra honey if desired.

name: Apple and Flaxseed Overnight Oats
method: Combine oats, milk, honey and vanilla; refrigerate overnight.
For 2 pots: mix base with Greek yoghurt. Stir in ground flaxseed and finely chopped apple.
Divide into 2 pots and drizzle with extra honey if desired.

name: Red Berry and Mixed Seed Overnight Oats
method: Combine oats, milk, honey and vanilla; refrigerate overnight.
For 2 pots: mix base with Greek yoghurt. Stir in mixed berries.
Divide into 2 pots, drizzle with extra honey if desired and scatter over toasted mixed seeds.

name: Slow-Cooked Shredded Chicken (Batch)
method: Place chicken in a large pan with stock, oregano, garlic powder and paprika. Bring to gentle simmer; cover and cook on low heat for 1.5 hours.
Remove breasts and rest covered 15–20 minutes. Reserve 100ml cooking stock.
Shred meat with two forks; mix in reserved stock. Season. Refrigerate or freeze in portions.

name: Slow-Cooked Beef Mince and Lentils (Batch)
method: Place mince and lentils in a large deep pan with beef stock and oregano. Bring to gentle simmer; cover and cook on low for 3.5 hours.
Remove lid for final 45–60 minutes to reduce and thicken.
Season. Portion and refrigerate or freeze.

name: Spiced Chicken and Cashew Nut Stew
method: Toast cashews and blitz half with olive oil, onion, garlic, tomato puree and spices to make curry paste. Brown chicken in batches; caramelise mushrooms.
Add stock and curry paste and reduce. Return chicken with apricots; cover and cook on low for 2 hours.
Remove chicken; dissolve coconut in sauce and thicken. Stir in honey and chopped cashews. Serve over rice with yoghurt, sweet chilli sauce and coriander.

name: Chipotle Chicken with Rice
method: Sauté onion and red pepper then add garlic and oregano. Add passata, stock, tomato puree and honey; simmer to thicken.
Stir in chipotle paste and shredded chicken to warm through. Cook rice.
Serve chipotle chicken over rice with soured cream, avocado, coriander and lime wedge.

name: Chipotle Chicken Wraps
method: Make chipotle chicken sauce: sauté onion and red pepper, add garlic, oregano, passata, stock, tomato puree and honey; simmer to thicken. Stir in chipotle paste and shredded chicken.
Divide chipotle chicken among 6 tortillas. Squeeze lime juice over each.
Top with avocado, soured cream and coriander. Fold in sides and roll tightly.

name: Chicken and Red Lentil Soup
method: Sauté onion and carrot 5–6 minutes. Add garlic, spices, herbs, cardamom, stock and tomatoes; boil then add chicken and lentils. Cover and cook on medium-low for 1 hour.
Remove chicken and rest; continue soup for 30 minutes. Shred chicken. Discard cardamom pod.
Add spinach to soup. Divide chicken among bowls; ladle soup over. Top with crumbled feta and lemon wedges.

name: Slow-Pulled Pork with Mustard Yoghurt Slaw
method: Simmer pork in passata, Worcestershire sauce and spices on low heat for 2–3 hours until tender. Remove pork and rest 20 minutes.
Reduce sauce by half and stir in BBQ sauce. Shred pork and combine with sauce.
Make mustard slaw with yoghurt, vinegar, mustard, honey, garlic, cabbage, carrot and red onion. Serve pulled pork with slaw in buns or as a bowl.

name: Creamy Chicken and Leek Filo Pie
method: If using raw chicken, brown in batches; set aside. Sauté leeks and mushrooms then add garlic and thyme. Deglaze with white wine.
Return chicken and stir in soured cream; simmer 4–5 minutes. Tip into baking dish.
Scrunch oiled filo pastry sheets on top; scatter sesame seeds and bake at 190°C for 15–20 minutes until golden and crisp.

name: Beef Mince and Lentils with Roasted Vegetable Rice
ingredients: half batch slow-cooked beef mince and lentils
method: Toss red pepper, courgette and red onion with oregano and oil; roast at 200°C for 20–22 minutes. Cook rice.
Stir roasted veg and half the parsley into rice.
Warm beef mince in a pan; add tomato puree, oregano, lemon juice and zest. Simmer until thick. Serve mince with vegetable rice and remaining parsley.

name: Mexican Beef and Kidney Bean Stew with Rice
method: Sauté onion and green pepper then add mushrooms, garlic and spices. Add wine and simmer until evaporated. Add tomatoes and stock; bring to simmer.
Add beef, cover and cook on low for 3–3.5 hours. Add kidney beans and cook uncovered last hour to thicken.
Serve with rice and top with cheese, soured cream, sliced avocado, chilli and herbs with lime wedges.

name: Lamb and Chickpea Tagine
ingredients: 600g diced lean lamb leg or shoulder
method: Sauté onion then add garlic and spices. Add lamb, chickpeas, tomato puree, tomatoes and water. Bring to simmer; cover and cook on low for 3.5 hours.
Stir in honey and apricots in the last hour.
Cook quinoa in chicken stock; fluff and stir in pine nuts and lemon zest. Divide nutty quinoa among warm bowls and ladle tagine over. Garnish with coriander.

name: Lamb and Lentil Coconut Curry with Rice
ingredients: 800g diced lean lamb shoulder or leg
method: Dissolve creamed coconut in 200ml boiling water. Sauté onion then add garlic and ginger. Add spices, tomatoes, tomato puree, stock, coconut milk, lamb and lentils.
Bring to simmer; cover and cook on low for 3.5 hours. Stir in almond butter in last 30 minutes.
Cook rice; stir in almond butter to coat. Serve curry over almond butter rice scattered with coriander.

name: Mixed Berry Chia Pudding
method: Place chia seeds, vanilla and milk in a serving bowl and refrigerate for 30 minutes, preferably overnight.
Stir through mixed berries when ready to serve.

name: Buckwheat Bread & Smashed Avocado
method: Soak groats, sunflower and pumpkin seeds in water with a pinch of salt for 2 hours, then rinse.
Soak chia seeds in 1/2 cup water until gel-like.
Preheat oven to 160°C. Blend all with olive oil, 1/2 cup water, baking powder and salt until smooth.
Pour into lined loaf tin and bake 75 min. Cool on wire rack.
Serve sliced with smashed avocado and lemon juice.

name: Coconut Berry Smoothie
method: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Serve immediately.

name: Slow Cooked Spiced Lentils
method: Soak lentils overnight, then rinse and strain.
Place all ingredients except coconut milk into slow cooker. Cook on low 6-8 hours.
Stir in coconut milk and season. Serve with steamed broccoli.

name: Scrambled Tofu & Vegetables
method: Heat oil, sauté onion until soft.
Crumble tofu into pan, add turmeric.
Add tamari and vegetables, cook until tender. Season to taste.

name: Quinoa Tabbouleh
method: Cook quinoa with salt and 1.25 cups water. Simmer 10 min, rest 5 min.
Whisk garlic, lemon juice, and olive oil for dressing.
Cool quinoa, combine with vegetables, herbs and dressing.

name: Beetroot & Black Bean Patties
method: Sauté onion and mushrooms until browned.
Mash black beans, mix with quinoa, beetroot, spices and almond flour.
Form into patties, chill, then bake at 190°C for 30-45 min.

name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Chilli
method: Sauté onion and garlic. Add kumara and spices.
Add beans, tomatoes and simmer 25-30 min until kumara is tender.
Serve with fresh coriander and lime.

name: Spiced Cauliflower & Quinoa Bowl
method: Cook quinoa. Toss cauliflower in tahini, oil and spices, bake at 200°C for 20 min.
Fry quinoa with garlic 5 min.
Assemble bowl with cauliflower, quinoa, cucumber, avocado, almonds and tahini dressing.

name: Raw Pad Thai with Coconut Tahini
method: Dry roast pumpkin seeds until they pop.
Prepare vegetables and place in a large bowl.
Mix dressing ingredients, pour over salad and toss.
Garnish with coriander and roasted seeds.

name: Green Pea Fritters
method: Boil peas until just cooked, drain.
Sauté onion and garlic. Mash with peas.
Mix in chickpea flour, baking soda, herbs. Form fritters.
Bake at 180°C for 15-18 min until golden. Serve on salad.

name: Pulled Jackfruit Tacos
ingredients: Carrot, tomato, avocado, cabbage for filling
method: Drain, rinse and chop jackfruit.
Sauté onion and garlic until tender.
Add jackfruit and aminos, cover and cook 8-10 min.
Mash with potato masher until shredded. Serve in wraps with fillings.

name: Tahini & Banana Choc Energy Bars
method: Preheat oven to 180°C. Mash banana, add date syrup, tahini, coconut oil.
Mix in oats, hemp seeds, cinnamon, dried fruit and chocolate.
Press into lined baking tray. Bake 30 min until golden.
Cool before slicing into bars.

name: Date Cacao & Coconut Bliss Balls
method: Place all ingredients into food processor and blitz until sticky.
Roll into balls and store in the fridge.
Keeps 5-7 days in fridge or 1 month in freezer.

name: Carrot Cake Bliss Balls
method: Place all ingredients into food processor and blitz until sticky.
Roll into balls, then roll in desiccated coconut.
Store in fridge up to 1 week or freezer for 1 month.

name: Chunky Monkey Chickpea Cookies
method: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Blend chickpeas, oats, sugar, banana, baking powder and oil until smooth.
Fold in chocolate chips. Roll into balls, place on tray.
Bake 18 min. Cool before storing.

name: Wild Blueberry Oat Bars
method: Blitz oats, coconut and seeds. Add dates, banana and oil, blend until sticky.
Reserve 1/2 cup. Press rest into lined tray. Bake 15 min at 180°C.
Heat berries, mash, add lemon and chia seeds.
Spread jam over base, crumble reserved topping. Bake 18 min more.

name: Chocolate Chip Banana Zucchini Bread
ingredients: 1 flax egg (1 tbsp ground flax + 2 tbsp water)
method: Make flax egg, set aside 5 min.
Mash bananas, add date syrup, coconut oil, oat milk and flax egg.
Mix dry ingredients separately. Combine wet and dry, fold in zucchini and chocolate chips.
Pour into lined loaf tin. Bake at 180°C for 45 min.

name: Bircher Breakfast Bowl
ingredients: Coconut yoghurt, fresh fruit, maple syrup
method: Combine oats, seeds, dried fruit, coconut and milk. Refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, stir and divide into bowls.
Top with coconut yoghurt, fresh fruit and maple syrup.

name: Everyday Chia Pudding
ingredients: Blueberries, hemp seeds, passionfruit, maple syrup for topping
method: Mix chia seeds, soy milk, cinnamon and vanilla. Let sit 15 min.
Scoop into bowls, top with fruit, seeds and maple syrup.

name: Gluten-Free Vegan Pizza
ingredients: Tomato paste, red onion, mushroom, tomato, vegan cheese
method: Mix dry ingredients. Whisk wet ingredients separately.
Combine into dough. Flatten into circle on lined tray.
Bake 10 min at 190°C. Add toppings, bake 15-20 min more.

name: Rice & Bean Salad with Lime Dressing
method: Whisk dressing ingredients together.
Combine all salad ingredients in a large bowl.
Toss with dressing and season.

name: Vegan Quinoa Breakfast Patties
method: Make flax eggs (linseed + water), chill 15 min.
Mix quinoa, carrot, flax eggs, almond flour, garlic, parsley and oil.
Form patties, fry 2-3 min each side until golden. Serve with avocado.

name: Roasted Tomato Soup
method: Sauté onions and carrots until soft. Add garlic 1 min.
Add tomatoes, paste, basil and stock. Simmer 30 min.
Stir in coconut milk. Blend until smooth.

name: Lentil Shepherd's Pie
method: Cook lentil filling with onion, garlic, carrots, tomato paste and stock.
Boil and mash kumara with olive oil.
Layer lentil filling in dish, top with kumara mash.
Bake at 180°C until golden.

name: Curry Lentil Soup
method: Heat oil in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Add onion and carrot and heat 3 minutes.
Add garlic, curry powder, turmeric and cumin. Stir and heat 2 more minutes.
Add stock, crushed tomatoes, potato and green beans. Cover and bring to the boil on high heat.
Remove lid, add lentils and reduce to medium heat. Simmer 20–30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Divide into two serves and store leftovers in the fridge.

name: Chimichurri Black Bean Tacos
method: Make chimichurri sauce by combining 10ml oil, parsley, coriander, garlic, oregano, chilli, salt and red wine vinegar. Set aside.
Heat a small frypan over medium-high heat. Add black beans and heat until warmed through.
Heat tortillas in the pan until crispy.
Serve two tortillas per person with spinach, tomato, cucumber, onion, avocado and black beans. Top with chimichurri sauce. Store leftovers in the fridge.

name: Curried Chickpea Salad Sandwich
method: Mash chickpeas with vegan mayonnaise, curry powder, salt and pepper.
Layer bread with spinach, curried chickpeas, cucumber, tomato and onion.

name: Miso Tofu & Greens
method: Cook rice according to packet instructions.
Prepare sauce by combining miso paste, soy sauce, Dijon mustard, sesame oil and grated ginger.
Add tofu, snow peas and broccolini to a pan and heat on medium-high 5–10 minutes. Add bok choy in the last few minutes.
Pour over sauce and heat a further 2–3 minutes. Divide rice into two bowls and top with miso tofu and greens.

name: Chickpea & Pumpkin Pasta
method: Preheat oven to 180°C. Place pumpkin on a lined baking tray and drizzle with half the oil. Roast 20–30 minutes until soft.
Cook pasta according to packet instructions.
Heat remaining oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic, cumin and paprika. Cook 5 minutes then add chickpeas and pumpkin. Toss 2 minutes.
Add spinach and heat until wilted. Season with salt and pepper. Add pasta and mix through. Divide into two serves.

name: Chickpea Rice Salad
method: Cook rice according to packet instructions.
Combine cooked rice with capsicum, onion, tomato, cucumber, nutritional yeast and chickpeas.
Whisk together oil, lemon juice, curry powder, salt and pepper. Pour over salad and mix through.
Divide into two serves and store leftovers in the fridge.

name: Colourful Lentil Salad Bowl
ingredients: 1 x 425g tin beetroot, drained and diced
method: Cook quinoa according to packet instructions.
Combine cooked quinoa with lentils, carrot, capsicum, cucumber, tomato, beetroot and spinach. Season with salt and pepper.
Combine lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon mustard and tahini to form the dressing. Toss through the salad.
Divide into two serves and store leftovers in the fridge.

name: Cottage Pie
method: Preheat oven to 180°C. Boil potatoes 20 min until soft.
Heat oil, cook onion and garlic 2-3 min. Add mince and brown.
Add frozen veg, kidney beans, tomato paste, stock and worcestershire. Simmer 10 min.
Mash potatoes with soy milk. Transfer mince to oven dish, top with mash.
Bake 25 min until golden. Divide into four serves.

name: One Pan Tempeh & Potatoes
method: Preheat oven to 200°C. Add tempeh, potatoes and carrot to an ovenproof dish.
Whisk oil with salt, pepper, rosemary, garlic powder, oregano, thyme and paprika. Drizzle over and coat well.
Roast 40-50 min until potatoes are tender. Serve with a side salad of spinach, tomato, onion and cucumber dressed with lemon juice.

name: Falafel & Quinoa Bowl with Avocado Dressing
method: Cook quinoa and falafel per packet instructions.
Blend avocado, parsley, lemon juice, salt and pepper until smooth.
Assemble bowl with quinoa, spinach, cucumber, carrot and falafel. Drizzle with avocado dressing.

name: Ginger Tofu Stir Fry
method: Cook rice according to packet instructions.
Heat half the oil on high. Stir-fry ginger and chilli 1–2 minutes. Transfer to a small bowl. Heat remaining oil on high. Toss tofu in cornstarch then stir-fry 4–5 minutes.
Return ginger and chilli to the pan. Stir through bok choy, capsicum and snow peas. Stir-fry 2–3 more minutes.
Combine lemongrass, soy sauce and maple syrup. Add sauce to stir-fry and cook 1–2 minutes. Divide rice and stir-fry into two serves.

name: Greek Lentil 'Meatballs'
method: Preheat oven to 220°C and line two trays with baking paper. Combine broccoli, cauliflower and capsicum with olive oil, salt and pepper. Lay on one tray and set aside.

Make a chia egg by combining chia seeds with water. Leave to set 5 minutes. Add lentils, chia egg, red onion, breadcrumbs, mint, parsley, tomato paste, salt, pepper, paprika, oregano, soy sauce and lemon juice to a food processor. Partially blend until combined but not pureed.
Roll mixture into meatballs (~2 tbsp each). Lay on second tray. Bake meatballs and vegetables 30–35 minutes.
Cook rice. Prepare vegan tzatziki by mixing yoghurt, cucumber, lemon juice, salt, pepper and garlic. Divide rice into four serves. Top with meatballs and vegetables. Serve with tzatziki.

name: Healthy Nachos
method: Cut wrap into small pieces and toast in the oven for a few minutes. Add nutritional yeast on top and heat another few minutes to melt.
Warm kidney beans and taco seasoning in a pan on medium-high heat until warm.
Layer toasted wrap pieces with kidney beans, tomato, onion and avocado.

name: Kidney Bean Melt Quesadilla
method: Combine kidney beans, corn, capsicum, parsley, nutritional yeast and taco seasoning.
Place mixture on half of each wrap, top with tomato and vegan cheese.
Fold and toast in pan or sandwich press until cheese melts.

name: Lemongrass Vegan Meatballs in Red Thai Curry
method: Blitz lemongrass, ginger, garlic, coriander, soy sauce and chilli into a paste. Mix with mince, roll into 12 meatballs.
Cook rice. Heat olive oil, brown meatballs 10 min. Remove.
Heat sesame oil, cook remaining garlic and ginger 2 min. Add curry paste, coconut milk, stock and soy sauce. Simmer 10 min, add meatballs 5 min.
Boil broccoli, cauliflower and beans 5 min. Serve over rice with curry sauce.

name: Loaded Potatoes
method: Preheat oven to 200°C. Par-boil potatoes 10 min, then toss with garlic powder, paprika, salt, pepper and oil. Roast 30-35 min until golden.
Cook beans with taco seasoning, tomato paste and capsicum 5-6 min.
Make pico de gallo: combine tomato, onion, parsley, lime juice and vinegar.
Top potatoes with bean mixture, pico de gallo and avocado.

name: Mexican Kidney Beans
method: Cook rice per packet instructions. Heat oil, cook onion 3 min.
Add capsicum, corn and kidney beans, heat 7 min.
Mix in taco seasoning, add rice and crushed tomatoes. Stir well.
Divide into two serves, sprinkle with nutritional yeast.

name: Moroccan Tofu Pizza
method: Preheat oven to 220°C and line a tray with baking paper.
Coat tofu in olive oil and Moroccan seasoning. Heat in a frypan over medium-high heat 5–7 minutes until browned.
Assemble two wraps with tomato paste, spinach, red onion, mushrooms, capsicum, tofu and vegan cheese.
Heat pizza in oven approximately 15 minutes until cheese has melted. Keep second pizza covered in the fridge until ready to serve.

name: One Pot Black Bean Fajitas & Rice
method: Heat oil with onion, capsicum, black beans and fajita seasoning 5 min.
Add diced tomatoes, stock and rice. Bring to boil.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 min until liquid absorbed and rice cooked.

name: Peanut Butter & Maple Syrup Overnight Oats
method: Mix oats, milk, protein powder and peanut butter.
Divide into four serves, top each with 125g yoghurt.
When ready to serve, add cinnamon, half a sliced banana and drizzle with maple syrup.

name: Spicy Thai Edamame & Quinoa Salad
method: Cook quinoa and edamame per packet instructions.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, vinegar, lime juice, ginger, garlic, sesame oil, sriracha and hot water until smooth.
Combine all vegetables with quinoa and edamame. Pour dressing over and toss.

name: Tahini Mustard Tempeh Wraps
method: Mix tempeh with mustard, tahini, soy sauce, vinegar and garlic powder. Marinate 20-30 min.
Make yoghurt sauce: combine yoghurt, tahini, lemon juice, chives and seasonings.
Fry tempeh 5 min. Assemble wraps with spinach, carrot, onion, tempeh and yoghurt sauce.

name: Vegan 'Egg Roll In A Bowl'
method: Cook rice. Prepare TVP by soaking in boiling water 5 min.
Heat sesame oil, cook onion and TVP 4-5 min. Add coleslaw, carrots, garlic, ginger and soy sauce.
Cover and cook 7-8 min until cabbage softens. Make sauce: combine mayo, sriracha and remaining soy sauce.
Serve over rice with sauce drizzled on top.

name: White Bean Pasta Bake
method: Preheat oven to 180°C. Cook pasta per packet instructions.
Heat oil, cook garlic, onion, carrot, celery and zucchini 10 min.
Add beans, tomatoes, paste, stock, herbs, salt and pepper. Simmer 5 min.
Stir in pasta, transfer to oven dish, top with cheese. Bake 20 min until golden.

name: Sheet Pan Roasted Spring Veggies
ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus, trimmed and cut into 5cm pieces
½ large head broccoli, cut into florets
method: Preheat oven to 220°C and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk together olive oil, balsamic, garlic and Italian seasonings. Toss all veggies until well coated. Season with salt and pepper.
Lay veggies in an even layer on the baking sheet. Roast for 30 minutes, tossing once halfway through.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze if desired and serve.

name: Sheet Pan Roasted Veggies & Tofu with Tahini Sauce
method: Press tofu for 15–20 minutes. Preheat oven to 220°C and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Add veggies and tofu to sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, garlic powder, Italian seasonings, salt and pepper. Toss to combine.
Bake 30–40 minutes, stirring once halfway through.
Blend tahini, water, olive oil, apple cider vinegar, maple syrup, garlic and sriracha until smooth. Add more water as needed.
Drizzle sauce over roasted veggies and tofu. Store leftover sauce up to 10 days.

name: Nourish Buddha Bowl
ingredients: 1 serving microwave quinoa or brown rice
⅓ cup chickpeas, drained and rinsed
method: Heat quinoa or rice according to packet directions. Transfer to a bowl.
Top with mixed greens, tomatoes, red onion, carrot, chickpeas, avocado, hummus, sunflower seeds, almonds and lemon juice if desired.
Enjoy!

name: Macro Lunch Bowl
ingredients: ⅓ cup cooked sweet potato cubes
method: Place mixed greens or spinach in a bowl. Top with rice, sweet potato, chicken and broccoli.
Add hummus and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Enjoy!

name: Rainbow Crunch Quinoa Salad
ingredients: Optional: 2 cups cooked chicken or tofu
method: Cook quinoa according to packet directions.
While quinoa cooks, whisk together almond butter, oil, soy sauce, honey, rice wine vinegar, lime juice and garlic powder.
In a large bowl, combine cooked quinoa, purple cabbage, green cabbage, carrot, capsicum, edamame and chicken/tofu if desired.
Pour dressing over salad and toss well. Serve and enjoy!

name: Turmeric Tahini Bowl
ingredients: ½ cup quinoa or brown rice
1 small sweet potato, cut into ½" pieces
½ small red onion, thinly sliced
method: Preheat oven to 200°C. Toss broccoli and sweet potato with olive oil, salt and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast 20 min, remove broccoli, flip sweet potato and roast 5–10 more min.
Cook quinoa or rice according to packet directions.
Quick-pickle onions: mix red onion, honey, vinegar and 2–3 tbsp water. Microwave 2 minutes, then set aside.
Make sauce: whisk tahini, lemon juice, maple syrup and turmeric. Add water to thin as needed.
Build bowl: quinoa, kale, broccoli, sweet potato, pickled onion. Drizzle with turmeric tahini sauce and top with black pepper.

name: Taco Crunch Bowl
ingredients: 1 cup black beans, drained and rinsed
method: Cook quinoa or rice according to packet directions.
Heat olive oil in a pan on medium heat. Brown the beef mince, breaking into small pieces. Add taco seasoning and cook until fully done.
Combine cherry tomatoes, jalapeño, red onion and juice of 1 lime for a quick salsa.
Assemble bowls: quinoa/rice, romaine, taco meat, tomato salsa, corn, black beans and crushed tortilla chips. Squeeze lime and enjoy!

name: Tahini Glow Bowl
ingredients: 1 block tofu, pressed and cubed (or 450g chicken)
1 medium sweet potato, cut into ½" pieces
method: Preheat oven to 200°C. Cook rice according to packet directions.
Place tofu/chicken, sweet potato, chickpeas and brussels sprouts on a baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil, salt and pepper. Flip brussels cut-side down.
Roast about 20 minutes until veggies are tender and crisp.
Mix tahini, maple syrup and lemon juice. Add water to thin as needed. Season with salt and pepper.
Build bowl: rice, roasted veggies and chickpeas, kale, pickled red onion, pumpkin seeds. Drizzle with tahini sauce.

name: Hummus Sweet Potato Bowl
ingredients: ¾ cup chicken breast, cooked and sliced
method: Place sweet potato in a bowl. Top with broccoli and chicken.
Mix hummus with 1–2 tbsp water to thin into a sauce consistency.
Drizzle hummus dressing over the bowl.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Enjoy!

name: Fried Rice Bowl
ingredients: ¼ cup purple or white onion, diced
method: Heat olive oil in a pan on medium heat. Add rice, chicken, broccoli, onion and soy sauce. Sauté for about 3 minutes.
Transfer to a bowl. Top with a hard-boiled egg, chili crisp and spring onion if desired. Enjoy!

name: Taco Bowl
method: Add spinach to a bowl. Top with rice, veggies, turkey, tomatoes, black beans and avocado.
Top with salsa and/or hot sauce of choice.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Enjoy!

name: Mexican-Style Smash Tacos
method: Heat olive oil in a pan on medium heat.
Spread 2–3 tbsp ground meat onto each tortilla in a thin even layer. Sprinkle with taco seasoning.
Place tortillas meat-side down in the pan. Cook 3–5 minutes until meat is fully cooked. Repeat for all tacos.
Mix yoghurt, lemon juice, dill, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and pepper for ranch dressing.
Top each taco with ranch dressing, black beans, corn and cherry tomatoes. Add lime juice and coriander if desired.

name: Green Goddess Sweet Potato Bowl
method: Preheat oven to 220°C. Add sweet potato to a baking sheet, toss with salt, pepper and 1 tbsp olive oil. Bake 10 minutes.
Toss chicken, broccoli and onion with remaining olive oil, salt and pepper.
Flip sweet potato and add the chicken/veggie mixture. Reduce to 190°C and bake 20–25 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Blend spinach, basil, tahini, lemon juice, garlic powder and maple syrup until smooth for the green goddess sauce.
Serve over greens, rice or quinoa. Drizzle with green goddess sauce.

name: Cashew Chicken Sheet Pan Dinner
ingredients: 2 tbsp soy sauce or coconut aminos
method: Cook rice according to packet directions. Preheat oven to 190°C.
Add chicken, capsicums, broccoli, green onion greens and cashews to a baking sheet.
Mix soy sauce, hoisin, honey, rice vinegar, garlic powder and oil. Pour over chicken and veggies, toss to combine.
Bake 25–30 minutes until chicken is cooked through. Top with sesame seeds and green onion greens.
Serve on its own or over rice. Enjoy!

name: Lentil & Vegetable Cottage Pie
ingredients: ¼ cup vegetable stock, salt reduced
¼ cup reduced-fat milk of choice
method: Spray a saucepan with oil over medium-high heat. Sauté garlic, onion, carrot and celery for 3 minutes until tender.
Add lentils, tinned tomatoes, tomato paste and stock. Simmer 15 minutes until sauce has thickened.
Steam potato until very tender. Add milk, salt and pepper. Mash until smooth.
Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F). Place lentil mixture into a baking dish, top with mashed potato.
Bake 30 minutes until potato is golden and crunchy on top. Serve.

name: Signal Sunrise Oat Bowl
method: Combine oats and almond milk in a bowl. Let sit for 5 minutes.
Stir in berries, peanut butter, and chia seeds. Serve immediately.

name: Signal Berry Bircher
method: Combine oats, chia seeds, and almond milk in a jar or container.
Stir well, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, stir in berries and maple syrup if desired.

name: Signal Garden Frittata
method: Preheat oven to 180 g C. Heat olive oil in an oven-safe frypan over medium heat.
Add diced bacon and cook until crispy. Remove bacon and set aside, reserving a small amount of fat.
Add spinach to the pan and cook until wilted. Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Pour egg mixture over the spinach. Sprinkle with bacon and cheese.
Transfer the frypan to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until set and golden brown.

name: Signal Reset Chia Pudding
method: In a jar or bowl, whisk together chia seeds, almond milk, maple syrup, and vanilla extract.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or preferably overnight, until thickened.
Stir before serving.

name: Signal Savoury Egg Bites
ingredients: 1/4 cup finely chopped mixed vegetables (e.g., bell pepper, courgette)
method: Preheat oven to 180 g C. Lightly grease a muffin tin with cooking spray.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Divide chicken sausage and chopped vegetables among the muffin cups.
Pour egg mixture over the fillings.
Bake for 15-18 minutes, or until set and lightly golden.

name: Signal Golden Cinnamon Toast
ingredients: 1 tsp butter or coconut oil for cooking
method: In a shallow dish, whisk together egg, almond milk, cinnamon, and vanilla.
Dip each slice of bread into the egg mixture, ensuring both sides are coated.
Heat butter or coconut oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Cook bread for 2-3 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through.

name: Signal Berry Bliss Smoothie
method: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy. Add more almond milk if needed for desired consistency.

name: Signal Vitality Green Smoothie
method: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend until smooth. Serve immediately.

name: Signal Zen Matcha Chia Pudding
method: In a jar or bowl, whisk together chia seeds, coconut milk, matcha powder, maple syrup, and vanilla extract.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or preferably overnight, until thickened.
Stir before serving.

name: Signal Autumn Berry Crumble
method: Preheat oven to 180 g C. In a bowl, combine berries and 1 tbsp maple syrup.
In another bowl, mix oats, almond flour, pumpkin seeds, mixed spice, 1 tbsp maple syrup, and melted coconut oil until a crumble forms.
Pour berries into an oven-safe dish. Sprinkle crumble topping evenly over the berries.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until topping is golden brown and berries are bubbly.

name: Signal Mediterranean Pork Pasta
method: Cook gluten-free pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add pork mince and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon.
Add broccoli and cook for 5 minutes, until tender-crisp. Stir in spinach until wilted.
Add cooked pasta, lemon juice, lemon zest, and parsley to the pan. Toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately.

name: Signal Hearty Beef Bolognese
method: Cook gluten-free spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add beef mince and cook until browned, breaking it up.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and beef broth. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat and cook for 15-20 minutes, allowing sauce to thicken.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve bolognese over spaghetti, garnished with fresh basil.

name: Signal Forest Mushroom Pesto Pasta
method: Cook gluten-free pasta according to package directions. Reserve 1/4 cup pasta water before draining.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add mushrooms and cook until softened and lightly browned.
Add cooked pasta and pesto to the pan. Stir to combine.
Gradually add reserved pasta water until the sauce reaches desired consistency.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve.

name: Signal Mediterranean Halloumi Pasta
method: Cook gluten-free pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add halloumi and cook until golden brown on both sides. Remove and set aside.
Add cherry tomatoes and bell pepper to the pan. Cook for 5-7 minutes until softened.
Return halloumi to the pan along with cooked pasta. Toss gently to combine.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with fresh basil, and serve.

name: Signal Emerald Salmon Pasta
ingredients: 2 tbsp light cream cheese or dairy-free alternative
method: Cook gluten-free pasta according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
In a pan, gently warm spinach and mushrooms until softened.
Add flaked salmon, cream cheese, and cooked pasta to the pan. Stir until cream cheese has melted and coated the pasta.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

name: Signal Zesty Shrimp Pesto Spaghetti
method: Cook gluten-free spaghetti according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through. Season with salt and pepper.
Add cooked spaghetti, spinach, and spinach pesto to the pan. Toss to combine.
Stir in chopped walnuts. Serve with a lemon wedge.

name: Signal Golden Pumpkin Risotto
method: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add Arborio rice and stir for 1 minute until lightly toasted.

Pour in 1 cup of warm vegetable broth and stir continuously until absorbed. Repeat with remaining broth, 1 cup at a time, allowing each addition to be absorbed before adding more. This will take about 20-25 minutes.
Stir in pumpkin puree, goat cheese, and pecans. Cook for another 2-3 minutes until creamy.
Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with fresh sage and serve.

name: Signal Zesty Chicken & Broccoli Rice
method: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and cook until browned and cooked through.
Add broccoli florets and a splash of water, cover, and steam for 5-7 minutes until tender-crisp.
Stir in cooked brown rice and teriyaki sauce. Cook for 2 minutes, ensuring everything is well coated.
Garnish with sesame seeds and grated ginger if desired. Serve immediately.

name: Signal Honey Glazed Carrots
method: Preheat oven to 200 g C. Toss carrots with olive oil, honey, salt, and pepper on a baking tray.
Roast for 15-20 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelised, shaking the tray halfway.
Remove from oven, drizzle with fresh lemon juice, and garnish with chopped parsley. Serve warm.

name: Signal Creamy Wilted Spinach
ingredients: 1/4 cup cream or dairy-free cream alternative
2 tbsp grated parmesan cheese or nutritional yeast
method: Heat butter or olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add spinach and cook until wilted, stirring occasionally.
Stir in cream (or alternative), parmesan (or nutritional yeast), and nutmeg if using.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until heated through and slightly thickened. Season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

name: Signal Spring Onion Risotto
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped spring onions (whites and greens separated)
method: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add white parts of spring onions and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add Arborio rice and stir for 1 minute until lightly toasted.

Pour in 1 cup of warm vegetable broth and stir continuously until absorbed. Repeat with remaining broth, 1 cup at a time, allowing each addition to be absorbed before adding more. This will take about 20-25 minutes.
Stir in green parts of spring onions and parmesan cheese. Cook for another 2-3 minutes until creamy.
Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with fresh chives and serve.

name: Signal Ocean Zest Risotto
method: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add Arborio rice and stir for 1 minute until lightly toasted.

Stir in crushed tomatoes. Pour in 1 cup of warm vegetable broth and stir continuously until absorbed. Repeat with remaining broth, 1 cup at a time, allowing each addition to be absorbed before adding more. This will take about 20-25 minutes.
Add shrimp during the last 5 minutes of cooking, stirring until pink and cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve.

name: Signal Sweet & Sour Chicken Delight
method: Toss diced chicken with cornflour.
Heat sesame oil in a wok or large pan over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until browned and cooked through. Remove chicken and set aside.
Add bell peppers to the wok and stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until tender-crisp.
In a small bowl, whisk together all sweet & sour sauce ingredients. Pour sauce into the wok, bring to a simmer, and cook until slightly thickened.
Return chicken and pineapple chunks to the wok. Toss to coat evenly. Serve hot, possibly with brown rice.

name: Signal Creamy Coconut Chicken
ingredients: 1 cup chopped mixed vegetables (e.g., green beans, carrots)
method: Heat coconut oil in a pan over medium heat. Add chicken and cook until browned. Remove and set aside.
Add onion and garlic to the pan and cook until softened.
Stir in coconut milk, vegetable broth, and mixed vegetables. Bring to a simmer.
Return chicken to the pan. Reduce heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve, perhaps with cauliflower rice.

name: Signal Sesame Ginger Chicken Stir-fry
ingredients: 1 cup mixed stir-fry vegetables (e.g., bok choy, snap peas, carrots)
method: Heat sesame oil in a wok or large pan over high heat. Add chicken and stir-fry until cooked through.
Add mixed stir-fry vegetables and cook for 3-5 minutes until tender-crisp.
In a small bowl, whisk together tamari, rice vinegar, and grated ginger. Pour over chicken and vegetables, tossing to coat.
Cook for 2 minutes until sauce has slightly thickened. Serve immediately over brown rice, garnished with sesame seeds.

name: Signal Comfort Shepherd's Pie
ingredients: 2 large kumara (sweet potatoes), peeled and chopped
method: Preheat oven to 180 g C. Boil kumara until very tender. Drain, mash with butter and almond milk, season with salt and pepper. Set aside.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe pan over medium heat. Add onion, carrot, and celery. Cook until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add beef mince and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon.
Stir in beef broth, tomato paste, and mixed herbs. Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes until sauce has thickened.
Remove from heat. Top the mince mixture evenly with mashed kumara. You can create peaks with a fork for crispiness.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the filling is bubbly.

name: Signal Golden Thai Green Curry
ingredients: 200g chicken breast or firm tofu, diced
1 cup mixed vegetables (e.g., broccoli, bell pepper, courgette)
1 tsp brown sugar or maple syrup
Fresh basil or coriander for garnish
method: Heat coconut oil in a pot over medium heat. Add green curry paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in coconut milk and vegetable broth, bringing to a gentle simmer.
Add diced chicken or tofu and mixed vegetables. Cook for 15-20 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Stir in fish sauce (or tamari) and brown sugar (or maple syrup). Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot with brown rice, garnished with fresh basil or coriander.

name: Signal Crispy Herb Pork Belly
method: Preheat oven to 180 g C. Pat pork belly skin dry thoroughly with paper towels.
Rub olive oil, crushed fennel seeds, salt, and pepper all over the pork belly, ensuring spices get into the scores.
Place pork belly on a wire rack in a roasting tray (with a little water in the bottom to catch fat).
Roast for 1 hour at 180 g C.
Increase oven temperature to 220 g C and roast for another 20-30 minutes, or until the skin is golden brown and crackling is crispy.
Rest for 10 minutes before slicing. Serve with a fresh side salad.

name: Signal Lemon Dill Salmon Skewers
ingredients: 1 lemon, juiced and sliced for garnish
Wooden or metal skewers (if using wooden, soak beforehand)
method: Preheat grill or oven to 200 g C.
In a bowl, toss salmon cubes with olive oil, lemon juice, chopped dill, salt, and pepper.
Thread salmon onto skewers.
Grill for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or bake for 10-12 minutes, until salmon is cooked through and flaky.
Garnish with fresh lemon slices and serve, perhaps with a quinoa salad.

name: Signal Hearty Lamb & Tomato Stew
ingredients: 1 cup mixed root vegetables (e.g., carrots, potatoes, kumara), diced
method: Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add lamb and brown on all sides. Remove lamb and set aside.
Add onion, garlic, carrots, and celery to the pot. Cook until softened, about 8-10 minutes.
Return lamb to the pot. Stir in crushed tomatoes, beef broth, and rosemary. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and transfer to a preheated oven at 160 g C. Cook for 1 hour to 1 hour 15 minutes, or until lamb is tender.
Stir in potatoes and kumara during the last 30 minutes of cooking.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve warm.

name: Signal Creamy Spinach & Hummus Wrap
method: Lay the wrap flat. Spread hummus evenly over the wrap.
Layer fresh spinach, grated carrot, and cucumber slices over the hummus.
Season with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Carefully roll up the wrap tightly. Cut in half and serve.

name: Signal Mango Magic Breakfast Bowl
ingredients: 1/2 cup Greek yogurt or coconut yogurt
method: In a bowl, layer Greek yogurt.
Top with frozen mango chunks, granola, shredded coconut, and chia seeds.
Serve immediately.

name: Signal Spicy Shrimp Tacos
ingredients: 1/4 cup Greek yogurt or dairy-free sour cream
method: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add shrimp, chilli powder, and cumin. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Warm tortillas according to package directions.
Assemble tacos: place shredded cabbage on tortillas, top with spicy shrimp, salsa, and a dollop of yogurt/sour cream.
Serve with lime wedges.

name: Signal Avocado Chocolate Mousse
method: Combine avocado, cocoa powder, maple syrup, almond milk, vanilla extract, and sea salt in a food processor or blender.
Process until completely smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed.
Divide into two serving dishes and chill for at least 30 minutes before serving.
Garnish with fresh berries.

name: Signal Goji Cashew Overnight Oats
method: Combine oats, oat milk, cinnamon, and maple syrup in a jar.
Stir well, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, top with goji berries and cashews.

name: Signal Tomato Quinoa Pilaf
method: Heat olive oil in a saucepan. Toast quinoa and cumin for 1 minute.
Add lentils and vegetable stock. Bring to boil, then simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Fold in cherry tomatoes. Rest covered 5 minutes.
Fluff with fork and garnish with parsley.

name: Signal Green Power Smoothie
method: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy immediately.

name: Signal Pumpkin Seed Pesto Zoodles
method: Blend pumpkin seeds, basil, olive oil, garlic, nutritional yeast, and lemon juice into a pesto.
Toss spiralised courgettes with the pesto over gentle heat for 2 minutes.
Season and serve immediately.

name: Signal Avo Sweet Potato Toast
ingredients: 1 large sweet potato, sliced lengthways 1cm thick
method: Toast sweet potato slices in toaster or oven at 200°C for 10-12 min until tender.
Mash avocado with lemon juice. Spread on sweet potato toasts.
Drizzle with tahini and top with bagel seasoning and microgreens.

name: Signal Garlic Kale Chickpea Pasta
method: Cook chickpea pasta according to packet directions. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Sauté garlic in olive oil until fragrant. Add kale and sun-dried tomatoes, cook 3 minutes.
Toss pasta with kale mixture, adding pasta water to create a light sauce.
Finish with nutritional yeast and chilli flakes.

name: Signal PBJ Power Bowl
method: Place warm quinoa in a bowl.
Top with peanut butter, berries, cacao nibs, and hemp seeds.
Drizzle with honey and enjoy.

name: Signal Miso Soba Nourish Bowl
method: Cook soba noodles, drain and rinse.
Dissolve miso paste in warm water to create broth.
Arrange noodles in bowl, pour broth over. Top with edamame, carrot, and nori.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Signal Gut Reset Grain Bowl
method: Roast cauliflower at 200°C for 20 minutes.
Divide farro between bowls. Top with roasted cauliflower, sauerkraut, and avocado.
Sprinkle with pumpkin seeds. Drizzle with olive oil and apple cider vinegar.

name: Signal Golden Anti-Inflam Soup
method: Sauté ginger in coconut oil for 1 minute. Add sweet potato, carrots, turmeric, and black pepper.
Pour in stock and coconut milk. Simmer 20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Blend until smooth. Season to taste.

name: Signal Fibre-Fuelled Rainbow Wrap
method: Spread hummus across the wrap.
Layer red cabbage, beetroot, carrot, avocado, and sprouts.
Squeeze lemon over the top. Roll tightly and slice in half.

name: Signal Prebiotic Morning Porridge
method: Cook oats with oat milk and cinnamon over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Stir in ground flaxseed and cacao powder.
Top with sliced banana and almond butter.

name: Signal Athlete Recovery Bowl
method: Pan-fry tofu in sesame oil until golden.
Arrange rice, tofu, edamame, and broccoli in a bowl.
Drizzle with tamari and sprinkle with sesame seeds.

name: Signal Endurance Fuel Smoothie
method: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Pour and drink 60-90 minutes before training.

name: Signal Tempeh Power Plate
method: Marinate tempeh in tamari, maple syrup, and smoked paprika for 5 minutes.
Pan-fry tempeh until caramelised on each side.
Serve alongside roasted sweet potato and steamed greens. Drizzle with tahini.

name: Signal Iron Warrior Salad
method: Arrange spinach on plates. Top with lentils, beetroot, walnuts, and cranberries.
Add orange segments for vitamin C to boost iron absorption.
Drizzle with balsamic vinaigrette.

name: Ginger Green Refresher
ingredients: 1 inch peeled and chopped fresh ginger
method: Combine the arugula, grapes, ginger, lemon juice, and 2 cups water in a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour over ice to serve. Triple the recipe and store in a sealed mason jar for up to 4 days.

name: Citrus-Spiced Golden Milk
ingredients: 1½ cups almond milk (or other low FODMAP plant-based milk)
1 medium orange, zested and juiced (about 3 tbsp juice)
1 tsp 100% maple syrup or to taste
Freshly ground black pepper to taste (optional)
method: Heat the almond milk in a microwave-safe cup for approximately 2 minutes, or bring to a boil in a small saucepan over high heat.
Carefully pour the hot liquid into a blender. Add the orange juice, maple syrup, turmeric, and ginger. Cover and blend until frothy.
Pour into a mug, top with orange zest and pepper, and enjoy.

name: The Blue Zen Elixir
ingredients: 1 cup frozen blueberries (ideally organic and wild)
method: Place the blueberries, lavender, and lemon zest in a medium to large heatproof pitcher. Carefully pour the hot water into the pitcher and steep for 30 minutes. Add the lemon juice.
Strain into a mug to enjoy hot, or refrigerate to serve cold. Combine with sparkling water for a low-sugar mocktail. Store in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

name: Golden Green Kickstart Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup almond milk or other low FODMAP plant-based milk
½ medium orange, peeled, seeds removed, cut into quarters
1 cup arugula or other low FODMAP leafy greens
Optional: 1 tsp maple syrup, pinch of salt, low FODMAP protein powder
method: Place the almond milk, orange, pineapple, arugula, and ginger in a blender. Add optional maple syrup, salt, and/or protein powder if desired. Blend on high speed until smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy.

name: Citrus Berry Belly Bliss Smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup almond milk or other low FODMAP plant-based milk
½ cup plain unsweetened almond milk yogurt
1 whole orange, zested, peeled, and cut into quarters
Optional: 1 tsp maple syrup, pinch of salt, low FODMAP protein powder
method: Place the almond milk, yogurt, orange, strawberries, flaxseed, and ginger in a blender. Add optional maple syrup, salt, and/or protein powder if desired. Blend on high speed until smooth.
Pour into a glass, top with orange zest, and enjoy. Swap strawberries with cranberries in fall/winter.

name: Tropic Mint Kiwi Cooler
ingredients: ¼ to ½ cup lightly packed fresh mint leaves
method: Place the almond milk, coconut water, kiwifruit, mint leaves, and lime juice in a blender. Blend on high speed until smooth.
Pour into a glass over ice, top with shredded coconut and lime zest, and enjoy.

name: P3 Biome Broth
ingredients: 1 cup sliced leeks, green part only
method: Add all vegetables, thyme, and peppercorns to a large stockpot. Cover with 10 cups water.
Cover and bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour. Remove from heat and let cool.
Strain broth through a fine-mesh strainer and transfer to refrigerator- or freezer-safe glass jars.
Seal well and store in the refrigerator for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 6 months.

name: Creamy Cannellini and Parsnip Soup
ingredients: 1½ cups sliced leeks, green part only
¾ tsp salt or to taste
Freshly ground black pepper to taste
6 cups P3 Biome Broth or water
One 15-oz can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
method: Heat olive oil and garlic oil in a large stockpot over medium heat. Add leeks and sauté for 5 minutes to soften.
Add parsnips, rosemary, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Add broth. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to low and simmer for 15 minutes. Add beans, raise heat to medium, and cook 5 more minutes.
Blend on high speed until smooth. Adjust seasoning. Store in refrigerator up to 4 days or freeze up to 6 months.

name: Citrus-Kissed Cannellini Stew
ingredients: 1½ cups sliced leeks, green part only
1 tbsp chopped fresh oregano or 1 tsp dried
Freshly ground black pepper to taste
6 cups P3 Biome Broth or water
One 15-oz can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
method: Heat a large stockpot over medium heat. Add olive oil, garlic oil, and leeks; sauté for 2 minutes.
Add carrots and zucchini and sauté for 2 minutes.
Stir in paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour in broth; cover and bring to a boil. Add buckwheat, reduce heat to low, and cook for 10 minutes.
Add beans and cook for 3 more minutes.
Divide into 6 bowls, serve with lemon wedges and fresh oregano. Store in refrigerator up to 4 days or freeze up to 6 months.

name: Wild Blueberry Chia Crisp with Yogurt
ingredients: 1 cup almond yogurt (or lactose-free plain yogurt)
Optional: slivered almonds or chopped walnuts
method: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Combine blueberries, chia seeds, 1 tbsp maple syrup, tapioca flour, ginger, and salt in a medium bowl. Stir to coat blueberries.
Divide blueberries into 4 custard cups or ramekins on a baking sheet.
Add avocado oil, remaining 2 tbsp maple syrup, oats, and sorghum flour to the bowl; stir to combine.
Divide topping evenly over blueberry mixture and bake 20–25 minutes until lightly browned.
Remove from oven, cool, and top each serving with ¼ cup yogurt.

name: Cinnamon Crunch Buckwheat Granola
ingredients: ¼ to ½ tsp salt or to taste
½ cup plus 2 tbsp 100% maple syrup
Optional: serve with almond milk or lactose-free plain unsweetened kefir
method: Preheat oven to 325°F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine oats, buckwheat, pecans, walnuts, sunflower seeds, cinnamon, and salt in a large bowl. Stir well.
Add avocado oil and maple syrup, stirring to coat.
Spread evenly on parchment and bake for 10 minutes. Stir the granola, spread again and press down.
Bake for 10 more minutes, remove from oven and allow to cool completely. Press down for clumpier granola.
Break into pieces and store in a well-sealed container at room temperature for up to 1 week or in the freezer for up to 4 months.

name: Miso-Licious Vegetable Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup diced red bell pepper (about ½ large pepper)
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
Crushed red pepper flakes to taste (optional)
1 cup chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley for garnish (optional)
method: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk miso with 1 tbsp water in a large bowl. Stir in 2 tbsp olive oil, then add broccoli, carrots, and bell pepper. Toss to coat and spread on parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake for 20 minutes.
Cook pasta according to package directions while vegetables roast. Drain and place in a serving bowl.
Add roasted vegetables and pine nuts to pasta. Top with remaining 4 tbsp olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Stir well.
Divide among 4 dishes and garnish with red pepper flakes and parsley if using.

name: Herby Chickpea Quinoa Salad
ingredients: 2 cups loosely packed fresh flat-leaf parsley, roughly chopped
1 cup loosely packed fresh dill, roughly chopped
1 cup canned chickpeas, rinsed and drained
¼ cup lemon juice (from 1½ to 2 lemons)
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
Optional: crumbled sheep's milk feta cheese
method: Heat 2 cups water and the quinoa in a medium pot over high heat until the water boils. Reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15 minutes until all water is absorbed.
While quinoa is cooking, combine cucumber, tomatoes, parsley, green onions, dill, and chickpeas in a large bowl.
Combine lemon juice, olive oil, and oregano in a mason jar. Cover and shake well.
Pour dressing over quinoa and vegetables. Add pine nuts and stir well. Season with salt and pepper. Store in refrigerator up to 4 days.

name: Garden Green Spud Salad
ingredients: 2 pounds red potatoes, cut into ½-inch cubes
4 cups loosely packed fresh cilantro, leaves and stems
½ tsp salt or to taste
Freshly ground black pepper to taste
One 15-oz can lentils, rinsed and drained (1½ cups)
method: Place potatoes in a medium to large pot and cover with water 2 inches above potatoes. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes until tender. Drain and refrigerate to cool for 30 minutes.
Prepare the sauce: combine cilantro, mint, garlic oil, olive oil, yogurt, cumin, lime juice, salt, pepper, and jalapeño in a blender. Blend on high until smooth and creamy.
When potatoes are cool, add lentils and green sauce. Stir well to combine. Adjust seasoning.
Divide among 6 serving bowls and top each with green onions. Store in refrigerator up to 4 days.

name: Edamame Guacamole
ingredients: ½ cup sliced green onion tops
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
method: Add edamame, avocado, cilantro, green onions, lime juice, olive oil, and garlic oil to the bowl of a food processor. Process until smooth and creamy, scraping down the bowl as needed.
Add salt, pepper, and jalapeño to taste if using, and process to mix. Spread on sourdough toast and top with sliced tomato and fresh herbs, or serve with low FODMAP crackers.

name: Citrus and Herb Toasted Nut Mix
ingredients: ¼ tsp salt or to taste
Freshly ground black pepper to taste
¾ cup raw pecans, roughly chopped
¾ cup raw walnuts, roughly chopped
½ cup raw Brazil nuts, roughly chopped
method: Combine olive oil, rosemary, lemon zest, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Stir well.
Add nuts and toss to coat.
Heat a medium to large skillet over medium heat. Add nuts and sauté for 4 minutes, or until lightly toasted. Remove from skillet immediately.
Allow to cool before serving. Store in a well-sealed container for up to 1 week.

name: Summer Garden Blended Juice
ingredients: 3 medium tomatoes (heirloom if available), roughly chopped
½ red bell pepper, roughly chopped
½ cucumber, peeled and roughly chopped (about ¾ cup)
½ cup sliced green onion tops
½ cup roughly chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley
½ cup roughly chopped fresh cilantro
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste (optional)
method: Add tomatoes, bell pepper, cucumber, green onion, parsley, cilantro, and lemon juice to a blender. Blend on high speed until well combined.
Season with jalapeño, salt, and pepper if desired, blending to combine.
Serve over ice. Store in refrigerator in a well-sealed container for up to 4 days. Shake well before serving.

name: Top Secret Mango Lassi
ingredients: ½ cup almond milk (or more for thinner consistency)
½ cup canned lentils, rinsed and drained
Optional: lactose-free plain unsweetened yogurt, slivered almonds
method: Add almond milk, yogurt, mango, lentils, and ginger to a blender. Blend on high until smooth.
Add maple syrup to taste and a pinch of salt if desired, and blend again.
Pour into a glass and serve.

name: Spiced Pomegranate Lassi
ingredients: ¾ cup pomegranate arils, frozen or fresh, plus more for garnish
1 tsp raw pine nuts for garnish (optional)
method: Combine pomegranate arils, almond milk, yogurt, lemon juice, maple syrup, cinnamon, cardamom, ginger, and salt (if desired) in a blender. Blend on high until smooth. If using fresh arils, strain after blending if desired for a smoother texture.
Pour over ice, garnish with extra pomegranate arils and pine nuts if desired, and serve.

name: Pre and Pro Miso Bowl
ingredients: 4 cups P3 Biome Broth or water
4 tbsp miso (e.g., mellow white miso; gluten-free if preferred)
7½ oz firm tofu (organic), cut into cubes (about 1¾ cups)
½ cup sliced green onion tops
Optional: bok choy, bamboo shoots, cabbage, green beans, low FODMAP leafy greens
method: Combine carrot and broth in a medium pot and bring to a boil over high heat.
Whisk miso in a small amount of hot water before adding to the soup, to blend better.
Add corn and tofu and simmer for 5 minutes.

Divide into 2 bowls and top each bowl with green onions. Store in refrigerator up to 4 days or freeze up to 6 months. To preserve probiotic benefits of miso, avoid boiling it — add at a gentle simmer.

name: Cherry Pie Chia Pudding
ingredients: 1 tbsp 100% maple syrup or to taste
3 tbsp sliced or slivered raw almonds
method: Combine almond milk, maple syrup, vanilla, chia seeds, and salt (if using) in a mixing bowl or large mason jar. Stir or shake well. Let rest for 5 minutes, stir/shake again. Repeat after another 5 minutes, then refrigerate for 20 minutes until thickened (or overnight for thicker texture).

To serve: layer half of the chia pudding into 3 serving dishes. Top each with ¼ cup cherries and 1½ tsp almonds. Repeat with remaining chia pudding, cherries, and almonds. Store in refrigerator up to 4 days.

name: Avocado Toast with a Dukkah Twist
ingredients: ⅛ tsp salt or to taste
Optional: smoked salmon or a soft-boiled egg
method: Make the dukkah: add pecans, sesame seeds, fennel seeds, coriander, cumin, and salt to a mini food processor. Process until finely chopped, being careful not to over-process into a paste.

Make the toast: toast the bread and top each slice with avocado slices, tomato slices (if desired), and 1 tbsp of the dukkah seasoning. Make dukkah ahead and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

name: Morning Sundae Surprise
ingredients: ½ cup canned rinsed and drained lentils, optionally frozen
¼ cup almond milk, plus more as needed
Optional: almond yogurt or lactose-free plain unsweetened yogurt as topping
method: Combine banana, lentils, almond milk, peanut butter, and cocoa powder in a high-powered blender. Blend on high using a tamper device, periodically scraping sides until ingredients are well combined and mixture has a creamy consistency. Add a splash more almond milk if too thick.

Spoon into a serving glass or bowl and top with peanuts and cacao nibs. Frozen lentils give an ice cream/milkshake consistency — lay cooked lentils on parchment, freeze, then store in a sealed bag for up to 1 month.

name: Citrus Kale Pasta Salad
ingredients: Salt, freshly ground black pepper, and crushed red pepper flakes to taste
Optional: stovetop shrimp, organic whole-wheat pasta, sheep's milk feta or goat cheese
method: Cook pasta according to package directions, then drain and transfer to a large bowl.
Make the dressing: combine olive oil, garlic oil, and lemon juice in a jar and shake well.
Add kale and pistachios to the pasta bowl. Pour dressing on top and toss well. Season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Serve warm or at room temperature. Store in a well-sealed container in the refrigerator up to 4 days.

name: Double Strawberry Spring Salad
ingredients: 5 whole strawberries, hulled, plus 2 cups sliced strawberries
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
Optional: crispy baked tofu, tempeh, or easy pan-seared salmon, microgreens or sprouts
method: Combine olive oil, lemon juice, vinegar, the 5 whole strawberries, and salt and pepper in a blender. Blend on high until smooth and creamy.
Assemble the salads: divide arugula between 2 plates. Top each with sliced strawberries, almonds, and optional ingredients if using. Drizzle the dressing over the salad.

name: Spiced Chickpea and Beet Yogurt Bowl
ingredients: ½ tsp salt or to taste
One 15-oz can chickpeas, rinsed and drained
YOGURT BOWL: ⅔ cup almond milk yogurt
method: Make the chickpeas: combine paprika, cumin, coriander, turmeric, and salt in a small bowl. Heat olive oil in a medium skillet over medium-high heat. Add chickpeas and spices; stir well to combine. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 8 minutes until chickpeas get crispy.

Assemble the bowl: add yogurt to a serving bowl, along with arugula, beets, and chickpeas. Serve with lemon wedges. Make the spiced chickpeas ahead and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.

name: Springtime Panzanella Salad
ingredients: 4 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for the bread
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
One 15-oz can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
Optional: stovetop shrimp, crispy baked tofu, or the best tempeh for extra protein
method: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Cut bread into 1-inch cubes. Place on foil-lined baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, season with pepper, and toss to coat. Bake for 5 minutes until lightly browned. Remove and set aside.
Make the dressing: combine 3 tbsp olive oil, lemon juice, and vinegar in a mason jar. Season with salt and pepper. Cover and shake well.
Heat a medium skillet over medium-high heat. Add remaining 1 tbsp olive oil and asparagus. Sauté for 5 minutes until tender.

Add arugula to a large serving bowl along with cooked asparagus, beans, toasted bread cubes, mint, and tarragon. Top with salad dressing and toss well. Season with additional salt and pepper if desired.

name: Mulligatawny Soup
ingredients: 1½ cups sliced leeks, green tops only
1 tbsp chopped fresh thyme or 1 tsp dried
Freshly ground black pepper to taste
4 cups P3 Biome Broth or water
2 cups finely diced peeled Honeycrisp or other sweet-tart apple (about 1½ apples)
1 cup canned lentils, rinsed and drained
method: Heat a medium to large stockpot over medium-high heat. Add olive oil, celery, leeks, and carrots and sauté for 5 minutes.
Add curry powder, thyme, cinnamon, salt, and pepper; stir well to combine.
Add broth, apples, rice, and lentils. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat and use an immersion blender to slightly puree the ingredients — keep the soup a little chunky for the best texture.
Stir in coconut milk, divide into 4 bowls, and top with yogurt and cilantro to serve if using. Store in refrigerator up to 4 days or freeze up to 6 months.

name: Cashew Citrus Energy Bites
ingredients: ⅛ tsp salt or to taste
method: Combine cashews, oats, coconut, maple syrup, ginger, orange zest, lemon zest, and salt in the bowl of a food processor.
Process until the mixture starts to stick to the bowl. Scrape the sides and bottom and process again until sticky and easy to shape. Scrape the bowl several times to get the correct consistency.
Roll mixture into about 12 equal-shaped balls.
Place hempseeds on a plate or parchment paper and roll the balls in hempseeds to coat.
Store in the refrigerator in a well-sealed container for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 1 month.

name: Chocolate-Drizzled Berry Bites
ingredients: 4 tbsp dark chocolate chips (at least 70% cacao)
method: Heat a medium skillet over medium-high heat. Add vegan butter and melt. Add raspberries, chia seeds, and maple syrup and cook, stirring constantly, for 4 minutes until mixture thickens. Transfer chia jam to a small bowl.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Place rice cakes on the sheet and spread each with 1 tbsp peanut butter.
Melt chocolate chips in the microwave on high for 1 minute, or until melted.
Spread chia jam evenly over the rice cakes. Drizzle each with melted chocolate.
Place the sheet in the freezer for 15 minutes and serve. Store in the freezer in a sealed container for up to 2 weeks.

name: Smoked Chili Lime Popcorn
ingredients: ¼ tsp cayenne pepper or to taste
¼ tsp salt or to taste
2 tsp lime juice or to taste
method: Make the popcorn by combining 2 tsp of the olive oil with the popcorn kernels using your favourite popcorn cooking method (popcorn maker, microwave, or stovetop).
Combine smoked paprika, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, and salt in a small bowl.
Pour hot popped popcorn into a large bowl or bag and top with remaining 2 tsp olive oil, the lime juice, and the spice mixture. Stir or shake well until all popcorn is coated.

name: Crispy Baked Tofu
method: CONVECTION OVEN: Preheat to 400°F. Line baking sheet with parchment paper and lightly coat with avocado oil spray. Cut tofu into ½-inch cubes. Press between paper towels with a heavy object for 10 minutes. Toss tofu cubes in avocado oil, tamari, and cornstarch. Bake for 20 minutes until golden brown and crispy.
CONVENTIONAL OVEN: Preheat to 425°F. Follow above directions but check for doneness at about 25 minutes, turning the tofu over halfway through.
Best made right before serving to maintain crispiness.

name: The Best Tempeh
ingredients: Extra-virgin olive oil or avocado oil
MARINADE OPTION 1: tamari + ginger + sesame oil + maple syrup
MARINADE OPTION 2: lemon juice + parsley + garlic-infused oil + red pepper flakes
MARINADE OPTION 3: lime juice + avocado oil + oregano + cumin
method: STEAM (optional but preferred): Steam tempeh for 5–10 minutes in a steamer basket until a fork can slide through easily. Drain excess water.
MARINATE (optional): Marinate tempeh for 1 hour using one of the three marinade options.

COOK: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado or olive oil to coat the bottom. Add plain or marinated tempeh slices or crumbles. Sauté for 5–8 minutes, turning periodically, until lightly browned and crispy. Season with salt and pepper. Store cooked tempeh in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days or freeze for 2–3 months.

name: Soft / Medium / Hard-Boiled Eggs
method: Place cold whole eggs on the bottom of a saucepan and cover with water, 1 inch above the eggs. Heat the saucepan over medium-high heat.
When the water bubbles gently, reduce the heat immediately, allowing a light simmer. Simmer for 10 minutes for hard-boiled, 6 minutes for medium-boiled, and 4 minutes for soft-boiled.
