Use a slotted spoon to remove eggs and place in a bowl of ice water to cool for at least 1 minute before peeling. Soft- and medium-boiled eggs are best eaten immediately. Store hard-boiled eggs in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

name: Easy Pan-Seared Salmon
ingredients: Extra-virgin olive oil or avocado oil
method: Heat a large skillet (cast-iron works well) over medium heat. Add olive or avocado oil to coat the bottom.
Place salmon fillets skin side down and season with salt and pepper. Cook for 4 minutes, flip, and cook for an additional 3 minutes.
Allow frozen salmon to thaw before cooking. Store extra cooked salmon in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.

name: Stovetop Shrimp
ingredients: Extra-virgin olive oil or avocado oil
Frozen or fresh shrimp (peeled or unpeeled)
method: Heat a large skillet (cast-iron works well) over medium heat. Add olive or avocado oil to coat the bottom.
Place shrimp in the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook for 5 minutes, or until shrimp become opaque and slightly curled.
Allow frozen shrimp to thaw before cooking. Store extra cooked shrimp in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.

name: Signal Keto-Green Power Bowl
method: Arrange greens in bowls. Top with sliced avocado and halved soft-boiled eggs.
Add sauerkraut to one side. Drizzle with olive oil and apple cider vinegar.
Sprinkle pumpkin seeds, season and serve.

name: Signal Cauliflower Steak with Chimichurri
method: Brush cauliflower steaks with oil, season. Roast at 200°C for 25 min until golden.
Blend parsley, vinegar, garlic, chilli and remaining oil for chimichurri.
Serve steaks drizzled with chimichurri.

name: Signal Protein Power Plate
method: Season chicken with paprika, salt and pepper. Grill 6 min each side.
Assemble plates with quinoa, broccoli, sliced chicken and avocado.
Mix yoghurt with lemon juice for a dressing. Drizzle and serve.

name: Signal Steak & Kumara Mash
method: Boil kumara until tender. Mash with butter, garlic and seasoning.
Season steaks, sear in a hot pan 3 min each side for medium-rare.
Rest 5 min. Serve with kumara mash and steamed green beans.

name: Signal Volume Veggie Soup
method: Sauté celery until soft. Add zucchini, cauliflower and spices, cook 3 min.
Add tomatoes and stock. Simmer 15 min until vegetables are tender.
Stir in spinach. Serve topped with parsley.

name: Signal Stuffed Capsicum
method: Preheat oven to 190°C. Mix rice, beans, corn, spices together.
Stuff capsicum halves with the mixture. Top with cheese.
Bake 25 min until capsicums are tender. Garnish with coriander.

name: Signal Keto Salmon Plate
method: Season salmon, pan-fry skin-side down 4 min, flip 3 min.
Toss greens with olive oil, lemon juice and capers.
Serve salmon on greens with avocado slices.

name: Signal Keto Egg Cups
method: Preheat oven to 180°C. Line muffin tin with prosciutto slices.
Divide spinach and sun-dried tomatoes among cups. Crack an egg into each.
Top with parmesan. Bake 15 min until eggs are set.

name: Signal AIP Healing Bowl
method: Cook turkey mince in coconut oil with turmeric and ginger until browned.
Add cauliflower rice and bone broth. Simmer 10 min.
Stir in kale until wilted. Serve in bowls.

name: Signal AIP Sweet Potato Hash
method: Heat coconut oil. Add kumara, cook 12 min until tender and crisp.
Add beef and cinnamon, cook until browned.
Toss in kale and thyme, cook 3 min. Serve.

name: Signal Pre-Workout Power Toast
method: Toast sourdough. Spread with almond butter.
Top with banana slices, drizzle honey and dust with cinnamon.

name: Signal Post-Workout Recovery Smoothie
method: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Serve immediately.

name: Signal Fibre-30 Rainbow Salad
method: Combine chickpeas, edamame, beetroot, carrot and cabbage in a large bowl.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and a splash of water for dressing.
Drizzle dressing, top with flaxseed and mint.

name: Signal Bone Building Bowl
method: Arrange rice in bowls. Top with rocket, white beans and sardines.
Drizzle with lemon-olive oil dressing. Sprinkle sesame seeds and dill.

name: Signal Gut-Hormone Repair Plate
ingredients: 1 cup Jerusalem artichoke, sliced and roasted
method: Roast Jerusalem artichoke at 200°C for 20 min until golden.
Arrange greens, artichoke, chicken and kimchi on plates.
Dress with olive oil and apple cider vinegar.

name: Signal Fermented Feast Bowl
method: Arrange rice and greens in bowls. Add tempeh, sauerkraut and pickled beetroot.
Drizzle with miso-tahini dressing and sprinkle sesame seeds.

name: Signal Balanced Gourmet Burger
method: Grill patties 4 min each side. Toast buns lightly.
Spread hummus on buns. Layer with lettuce, tomato, patty, onion and pickle.

name: Signal Dark Chocolate Seed Bark
method: Melt chocolate gently. Pour onto a lined tray and spread thin.
Scatter pumpkin seeds, cranberries and coconut. Sprinkle salt.
Refrigerate until set. Break into pieces.

name: Signal 30-Plant Stir-Fry
method: Heat sesame oil in a wok. Stir-fry tofu until golden, set aside.
Add all vegetables and ginger, stir-fry 4 min on high heat.
Return tofu, add tamari and cashews. Toss and serve over brown rice.

name: Signal Polyphenol Power Bowl
method: Spoon yoghurt into a bowl. Top with cherries, walnuts and cacao nibs.
Sprinkle flaxseed and drizzle honey.

name: Signal Nourish Pasta
method: Cook pasta al dente. Pan-fry chicken in olive oil until golden.
Toss pasta with pesto, chicken and tomatoes.
Serve topped with parmesan and fresh basil.

name: Signal Energy-Dense Granola
method: Preheat oven to 160°C. Mix oats, almonds and seeds.
Combine coconut oil, maple syrup, molasses and cinnamon. Pour over dry mix.
Spread on a lined tray. Bake 20 min, stirring halfway.
Cool completely. Stir in dried apricots. Store in an airtight jar.

name: Signal Blood Sugar Balance Bowl
method: Grill chicken and slice. Roast broccoli at 200°C for 15 min.
Assemble bowls with lentils, chicken, broccoli and avocado.
Drizzle with dressing and sprinkle hemp seeds.

name: Signal Cinnamon Protein Pancakes
ingredients: Berries and Greek yoghurt, for serving
method: Mix oat flour, protein powder, baking powder and cinnamon.
Whisk in egg and milk until smooth.
Cook pancakes in coconut oil, 2 min each side.
Serve with berries and a dollop of Greek yoghurt.

name: Signal Low-FODMAP Chicken Bowl
method: Pan-fry chicken in garlic-infused oil until golden and cooked through.
Sauté zucchini and carrots in the same pan 3 min.
Serve over rice, drizzle tamari and top with chives.

name: Signal Low-FODMAP Pumpkin Soup
method: Sauté pumpkin in garlic-infused oil with cumin and ginger 3 min.
Add stock. Simmer 20 min until pumpkin is very soft.
Blend until smooth. Stir in coconut cream.
Serve topped with pumpkin seeds.

name: Signal Turmeric Fish Tray Bake
method: Preheat oven to 200°C. Toss kumara, tomatoes and broccolini with oil and spices.
Spread on a tray and roast 15 min.
Nestle fish fillets among vegetables. Roast another 12 min.
Serve with lemon wedges.

name: Signal Anti-Inflam Golden Latte
method: Heat oat milk gently. Whisk in turmeric, cinnamon, ginger and pepper.
Sweeten with maple syrup. Pour and enjoy.

name: Warming Ginger Congee
ingredients: 2 chicken thighs, boneless/skinless, thinly sliced (or 1 block firm tofu, cubed)
method: Rinse the rice thoroughly. Combine rice and water/broth in a large pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1.5-2 hours, stirring occasionally, until the rice breaks down into a porridge-like consistency.
Add grated ginger and sliced chicken/tofu to the congee during the last 20 minutes of cooking. Cook until chicken is tender/tofu is heated through.
Stir in spinach during the last 5 minutes, until wilted.
Serve hot, garnished with spring onion and a drizzle of sesame oil, if desired.

name: Blood-Nourishing Beetroot & Carrot Soup
ingredients: 1 tsp apple cider vinegar (optional, for brightness)
Salt and black pepper to taste
method: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Add chopped beetroot, carrots, and potato to the pot. Stir well.
Pour in vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 25-30 minutes, or until vegetables are very tender.
Carefully blend the soup until smooth using an immersion blender or by transferring to a regular blender (blend in batches if needed).
Return soup to the pot, stir in apple cider vinegar if using, season with salt and pepper to taste. Reheat gently if needed.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh parsley.

name: Qi-Building Chicken & Mushroom Stir-fry
ingredients: 200g boneless, skinless chicken breast or thigh, sliced
2 cups mixed mushrooms (shiitake, button, oyster), sliced
2 tbsp oyster sauce (or vegetarian stir-fry sauce)
method: Marinate chicken slices with soy sauce and cornflour for 10 minutes.
Heat sesame oil in a large wok or frying pan over high heat. Add chicken and stir-fry until cooked through and lightly browned. Remove from pan and set aside.
Add mushrooms to the hot pan and stir-fry until softened and slightly browned. Add broccoli and capsicum, stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add garlic and ginger to the vegetables, stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return chicken to the pan. Add oyster sauce and water, stir to coat everything. Cook for another 1-2 minutes until heated through and sauce thickens slightly.
Serve immediately with brown rice.

name: Liver & Kidney Nourishing Salmon with Greens and Goji
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
1/4 cup goji berries, rehydrated in warm water for 10 minutes
method: Preheat oven to 180°C or heat a pan over medium heat. Season salmon fillets with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice.

If baking: Place salmon on a baking tray lined with baking paper and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked to your liking. If pan-frying: Heat olive oil in a pan, place salmon skin-side down and cook for 4-6 minutes, then flip and cook for another 3-5 minutes.
While salmon cooks, gently warm the mixed greens in a separate pan with a tiny bit of water or steam lightly until just wilted. Drain excess water.
In a small bowl, whisk together rice vinegar, sesame oil, and honey (if using) for the dressing. Drain the rehydrated goji berries.
Arrange wilted greens on plates, top with cooked salmon. Scatter rehydrated goji berries over the top and drizzle with the dressing.
Serve immediately.

name: Spleen Harmonizing Pumpkin & Ginger Millet Bowl
ingredients: 1 tbsp maple syrup or honey (optional, for sweetness)
method: Combine rinsed millet, water/plant milk, diced pumpkin, grated ginger, cinnamon, and nutmeg (if using) in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until millet is tender and most liquid is absorbed.
Stir in maple syrup or honey if desired.
Serve warm, topped with toasted pumpkin seeds.

name: Kidney Fortifying Black Bean & Kumara Salad
ingredients: 1 can black beans, rinsed and drained
Salt and black pepper to taste
method: Preheat oven to 200°C. Toss diced kumara with a little olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast for 25-30 minutes, or until tender and slightly caramelised.
In a large bowl, combine roasted kumara, rinsed black beans, red onion, red capsicum, and fresh coriander.
Whisk together all dressing ingredients in a small bowl.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Nourishing Tofu & Vegetable Broth
ingredients: 1 cup bok choy or pak choy, chopped
1 tbsp soy sauce (or tamari for gluten-free)
method: In a medium pot, bring vegetable broth to a simmer. Add sliced ginger and carrots, cook for 5 minutes.
Add cubed tofu and sliced mushrooms to the pot. Continue to simmer for another 5-7 minutes, until mushrooms are cooked.
Stir in chopped bok choy/pak choy and cook for 2-3 minutes, until just wilted. Do not overcook.
Stir in soy sauce and sesame oil. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Serve hot as a light, restorative meal.

name: Qi & Blood Enriching Egg & Spinach Omelette
ingredients: Pinch of salt and black pepper
method: Whisk eggs with milk/water, salt, and pepper in a small bowl until well combined.
Heat olive oil or butter in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat.
Add spinach to the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes until wilted. Spread evenly.
Pour egg mixture over the spinach. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until edges are set.
Carefully fold the omelette in half or slide onto a plate.
Garnish with sliced spring onion if desired and serve immediately.

name: Cooling Mung Bean & Apple Dessert
ingredients: 1 medium apple, peeled, cored, and diced
1 tbsp rock sugar or maple syrup (adjust to taste)
method: Combine rinsed mung beans and water in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes, or until mung beans are soft.
Add diced apple, rock sugar/maple syrup, and a pinch of salt to the pot. Continue to simmer for another 5-10 minutes, until apples are tender.
Serve warm or chilled. This dessert can be thicker or thinner depending on desired consistency (add more water if too thick).

name: Five-Element Lamb & Veggie Stir-fry
ingredients: 200g lamb leg or shoulder, thinly sliced
method: Marinate lamb slices with soy sauce, five-spice powder, and cornflour for 15 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a wok or large pan over high heat. Add lamb and stir-fry until browned. Remove from pan and set aside.
Add onion to the pan and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes. Add carrots and broccoli, stir-fry for another 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add zucchini, garlic, and ginger, stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Return lamb to the pan. Add oyster sauce and water, stir well to coat. Cook for 1-2 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Serve immediately with rice.

name: Vata & Kapha Balancing Ginger Turmeric Oats
ingredients: Optional toppings: chopped apple, few almonds
method: Combine oats, water/almond milk, grated ginger, turmeric, black pepper, cinnamon, and salt in a small saucepan.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 5-7 minutes, or until oats are cooked and liquid is absorbed.
Stir in maple syrup/jaggery if using.
Pour into a bowl and top with chopped apple and almonds if desired. Serve warm.

name: Tridoshic Kitchari (Follicular Focus)
ingredients: 1/2 cup split yellow mung beans (moong dal), rinsed well
1/4 tsp ginger powder (or 1 inch fresh grated)
Pinch of asafoetida (hing, optional, for digestion)
method: Heat ghee/oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds).
Add turmeric, ginger powder, and asafoetida (if using). Stir quickly for a few seconds.
Add rinsed mung beans and rice. Stir well to coat with spices. Pour in water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30-35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice and dal are soft and well-cooked. Add more water if kitchari becomes too thick.
Stir in mixed greens during the last 5 minutes, until wilted. Season with salt.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh coriander.

name: Cooling Pitta-Balancing Salad with Cucumber & Mint
ingredients: 1 cup cooked quinoa or couscous, chilled
Pinch of salt and black pepper
method: In a large bowl, combine chilled quinoa/couscous, diced cucumber, halved cherry tomatoes, chopped mint, chopped coriander, sliced red onion (if using), and chickpeas.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, roasted cumin powder, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss gently to combine.
Serve immediately or chill briefly before serving.

name: Vata Pacifying Kumara & Coconut Soup
ingredients: 2 medium kumara (sweet potato), peeled and diced
Fresh coriander or roasted pumpkin seeds for garnish
method: Heat ghee/coconut oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and grated ginger, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in cumin, coriander, turmeric, and black pepper. Cook for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Add diced kumara and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until kumara is very tender.
Stir in coconut milk and heat through gently (do not boil after adding coconut milk). Season with salt.
Blend the soup until smooth using an immersion blender or by transferring to a regular blender.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh coriander or roasted pumpkin seeds.

name: Vata & Kapha Pacifying Golden Milk
ingredients: 1/2 tsp honey or maple syrup (optional, add after heating)
method: Combine milk, turmeric, ginger, black pepper, cinnamon, and cardamom (if using) in a small saucepan.
Gently heat over medium-low heat, whisking constantly, until warm and frothy (do not boil).
Remove from heat. Let cool slightly, then stir in honey/maple syrup if using.
Pour into a mug and enjoy warm.

name: Kapha & Vata Reducing Lentil Dahl with Spinach
method: Combine rinsed lentils and water in a pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, skim any foam, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until lentils are tender and mushy.

While lentils cook, prepare the 'tarka' (tempering): Heat ghee/oil in a small pan over medium heat. Add mustard seeds. Once they pop, add cumin seeds, onion, garlic, and grated ginger. Cook until onion is softened and fragrant (5-7 minutes).
Stir in turmeric, coriander powder, and asafoetida (if using). Cook for 30 seconds, stirring constantly.
Add the tarka to the cooked lentils. Stir well. Add chopped spinach and cook for 2-3 minutes until wilted. Season with salt.
Serve hot with basmati rice and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.

name: Pitta & Kapha Reducing Mint & Coriander Chutney
ingredients: 1 green chilli, deseeded (optional, adjust to Pitta)
1/4 tsp black salt (kala namak) or regular salt to taste
method: Combine all ingredients (coriander, mint, green chilli, ginger, lemon/lime juice, cumin powder, salt, and 2 tbsp water) in a blender or food processor.
Blend until a smooth paste forms, adding more water if needed to reach desired consistency.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3-4 days.
Serve as a condiment with meals or as a dip.

name: Kapha Pacifying Courgette & Mung Dahl Sabzi
ingredients: 1/4 cup yellow mung dal, pre-soaked for 30 min (optional, helps digestion)
method: Heat ghee/coconut oil in a pan over medium heat. Add mustard seeds. Once they pop, add cumin seeds, asafoetida, grated ginger, and green chilli (if using). Cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add diced courgette and pre-soaked mung dal (if using). Stir well.
Add water, turmeric, and coriander powder. Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until courgette is tender and dal is cooked (if using).
Season with salt. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve warm with roti or rice.

name: Agni-Stimulating Cinnamon Apple Bake
method: In a saucepan or oven-safe dish, combine sliced apples, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg (if using), ghee/butter, maple syrup (if using), and water.
If stovetop: Cover and simmer over low heat for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until apples are tender.
If oven: Bake at 180°C for 20 minutes, or until apples are soft.
Serve warm as a comforting, digestive snack or light dessert.

name: Kapha & Vata Balancing Broccoli & Ginger Stir-fry
ingredients: 1 head broccoli, cut into small florets
method: Heat ghee/oil in a wok or large pan over medium-high heat. Add mustard seeds. Once they pop, add julienned ginger and sliced garlic. Sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add broccoli florets and red capsicum. Stir-fry for 5-7 minutes, until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Stir in turmeric powder and salt. Cook for another minute.
Remove from heat, squeeze fresh lemon juice over the stir-fry and serve immediately.

name: Pitta Calming Cucumber Raita
ingredients: 1/2 medium cucumber, grated or finely diced
Pinch of black salt (kala namak) or regular salt
A few fresh mint leaves, chopped (optional)
method: In a small bowl, whisk the yoghurt until smooth.
Add grated/diced cucumber, roasted cumin powder, and salt. Stir well to combine.
If using, stir in chopped fresh mint leaves.
Chill for at least 15 minutes before serving to allow flavours to meld.
Serve as a cooling side dish or dip.

name: Light & Digestible Masoor Dal Soup
method: Combine rinsed red lentils and water in a pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until lentils are very soft and break down into a soup.

While lentils cook, prepare the tempering: Heat ghee/oil in a small pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds. Once they sizzle, add grated ginger, turmeric, and asafoetida. Cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the tempering to the cooked lentils. Stir well. Season with salt.
Stir in lemon juice. Serve hot, garnished with fresh coriander.
This soup can be left as is for a liquid consistency, or blended for a smoother texture.

name: Vata & Pitta Pacifying Pumpkin Semolina Porridge
ingredients: Few raisins or chopped nuts for topping
method: Heat ghee/coconut oil in a saucepan over medium-low heat. Add semolina and roast, stirring frequently, until lightly fragrant and golden (about 3-5 minutes). Be careful not to burn it.
Add pumpkin puree, milk, cinnamon, ginger, and cardamom to the saucepan. Whisk continuously to prevent lumps.
Bring to a gentle simmer, then reduce heat to low and cook, stirring frequently, for 5-7 minutes, until porridge thickens to desired consistency.
Stir in jaggery or maple syrup if using. Serve warm, topped with raisins or chopped nuts.

name: Warming Sesame & Ginger Greens
ingredients: 200g mixed greens (kale, spinach, bok choy), chopped

name: Easy Banana Cake
method: Spray a ramekin with cooking oil spray. Preheat oven to 160°C.
Combine flour, baking powder, salt and sweetener. Add water, mashed banana, vanilla and walnuts and mix well.
Pour batter into dish. Melt coconut oil and combine with cinnamon. Pour over batter.
Bake 20–22 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Serve warm.

name: Gluten-Free Double Choc Fudge Cookies
method: Soak chia seeds in ¼ cup water for 10 minutes.
Preheat oven to 190°C and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Blend avocado with maple syrup, peanut butter and chia gel until smooth.
Stir through vanilla, chickpea flour, baking powder, sweetener and cacao until smooth. Fold in chocolate chips.
Spoon into 12 dollops on prepared tray. Bake 12–15 minutes until slightly golden.
Cool on tray 10 minutes then on a wire rack. One cookie is one serve. Store in the fridge 3–4 days.

name: Hedgehog Slice
method: Line a loaf tin with baking paper. Soak dates in boiling water 10 minutes then drain.
Blend walnuts, dates, honey, cacao and coconut in a food processor. Transfer to a bowl and mix through puffed rice. Press into tin.
Melt chocolate chips and coconut oil in the microwave in 30-second increments until smooth. Pour over base and tilt to cover evenly.
Freeze 10 minutes to set. Cut into 16 bars. One bar is one serve. Store in fridge or freezer.

name: Homemade Ferrero Rochers
method: Set aside 6 hazelnuts. Blend remaining hazelnuts to a fine meal. Set aside 2 tbsp of the meal for rolling.
Add cacao, date and vanilla to the blender with the hazelnut meal. Process until smooth. Add a drop of water if needed.
Freeze for 30 minutes until firm.
Scoop tablespoons of mix to form 6 small balls. Press a whole hazelnut into the centre of each.
Roll balls in reserved hazelnut meal. Two balls is one serve. Store in the freezer up to 2 months.

name: Lamington Bliss Balls
ingredients: 50g desiccated coconut, plus extra for rolling
method: Place all ingredients (except extra coconut) into a food processor and pulse until it comes together.
Roll into 12 balls and coat with extra desiccated coconut. One ball is one serve.

name: No-Bake Choc Banana Fudge
method: In a bowl combine banana, peanut butter, maple syrup, vanilla and chocolate chips.
Fold through coconut flour.
Press into a small lined pan and freeze 2–3 hours until firm.
Slice into 8 pieces. One piece is one serve. Store in the freezer up to 3 months.

name: No-Bake Muesli Bars
method: Combine honey and peanut butter with water a little at a time, stirring until smooth.
Dry-cook oats and pepitas in a large frypan over medium-high heat for 5–10 minutes until golden.
Remove from heat, stir through goji berries and pour over peanut butter mixture. Stir to coat well.
Press to about 1cm thick on a lined tray and refrigerate approximately 2 hours until firm. Cut into 8 bars. Two bars is one serve. Store in fridge.

name: No-Egg Chocolate Custard
method: Whisk a little of the milk with the cornflour to form a smooth paste, then slowly whisk in the remaining milk.
Add to a saucepan with coconut sugar, vanilla and cacao.
Bring to the boil then simmer on low heat 7–8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Divide between two bowls. Serve warm or cold. Garnish with mint or coconut if desired.

name: Orange & Chocolate Avocado Mousse
method: Peel the orange.
Blend orange with avocado, cacao and pitted date until smooth.
Serve immediately or chill in the fridge for 30 minutes.

name: Peanut Butter Mousse
method: Rinse, drain and press tofu to remove as much liquid as possible.
Blend tofu, almond milk, vanilla, stevia, peanut butter and salt until smooth and creamy.
Divide between two bowls and refrigerate 1 hour.
Top with crushed peanuts and maple syrup to serve. Store in the fridge up to 2 days.

name: Peanut Butter Rice Cups
method: Line a muffin tin with 12 patty cases.
Melt chocolate in a heatproof bowl over simmering water until smooth.
Divide half the melted chocolate between the bases of the 12 patty cases.
Melt peanut butter, coconut sugar, vanilla and coconut oil in a saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat and stir through puffed rice.
Divide peanut butter mixture over the chocolate in each case.
Drizzle remaining chocolate over each cup. Refrigerate 15 minutes until firm. One cup is one serve. Store in the fridge up to a week.

name: Secret Centre Chocolate Cookies
ingredients: 100g dark chocolate (70%), cut into 16 small pieces
method: Soak chia seeds in ⅓ cup water for 10 minutes.
Preheat oven to 180°C and line two baking trays with baking paper.
Combine chia mix with almond butter, sweetener and baking powder. Beat by hand or with an electric beater for 5 minutes until a dough forms.
Divide into 16 even pieces. Shape each piece around a small square of chocolate and place on trays.
Bake 15–20 minutes until golden brown. Cool on trays 5 minutes. One cookie is one serve. Store in the fridge 4–5 days.

name: Vegetable Coconut Curry with Quinoa
method: Cook quinoa according to packet instructions.
While quinoa cooks, heat water in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add onion, garlic and ginger and cook 1–2 minutes until tender and fragrant.
Add broccoli, capsicum, carrot and beans and cook 5 minutes until just tender.
Add curry powder, coconut milk and stock and simmer 10–15 minutes until sauce has slightly thickened.
Serve curry and sauce on top of quinoa.

name: Chocolate Protein Fudge
method: Blitz all ingredients in a high speed blender until smooth.
Press into a small baking tin and freeze for at least 1 hour. Remove and cut into 8 pieces.
Store in an airtight container in the fridge or freezer.

name: Vegan Cottage Pie
ingredients: 1 x 400g tin kidney beans, drained and rinsed
method: Preheat oven to 180°C. Boil potatoes for 20 minutes until softened.
Heat oil in a large frypan over medium-high heat. Add onion and garlic and cook 2–3 minutes. Add mince and cook until browned.
Add frozen vegetables and heat 2 minutes. Add kidney beans and heat 3 minutes. Add tomato paste, stock, Worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper. Cook on low-medium heat 10 minutes until thickened.
Drain potatoes and mash with soy milk. Transfer mince mixture to a deep ovenproof dish and top with mash, spreading edge to edge.
Bake 25 minutes until lightly browned on top. Divide into four serves and store leftovers in the fridge.

name: Lemongrass Vegan Meatballs in Red Thai Curry Sauce
ingredients: 1 x 400ml tin reduced fat coconut milk
method: Blitz lemongrass, 5g ginger, 1 clove garlic, coriander, 30ml soy sauce and chilli into a paste. Mix paste with mince. Refrigerate 30 minutes if time permits, then roll into 12 meatballs.
Cook rice. Heat olive oil in a large frypan and cook meatballs 10 minutes until crispy and brown. Remove and set aside.

Heat sesame oil in the same pan. Add remaining garlic and ginger, heat 2 minutes, then add red curry paste and heat 2–3 minutes. Add coconut milk, stock and remaining soy sauce. Simmer 10 minutes, then add meatballs and cook 5 more minutes.
Boil broccoli, cauliflower and green beans for 5 minutes. Drain. Divide rice and vegetables into four serves. Top with 3 meatballs per serve and curry sauce.

name: Mexican-Style Loaded Potatoes
ingredients: 1 x 400g tin kidney beans, drained and rinsed
method: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a tray with baking paper. Par-boil potatoes for 10 minutes. Drain and toss with garlic powder, paprika, salt, pepper and olive oil. Roast on baking tray 30–35 minutes until golden and crispy.
Heat frypan over medium-high heat. Cook kidney beans with taco seasoning, tomato paste and capsicum 5–6 minutes until capsicum is softened.
Combine cherry tomatoes, red onion, parsley, lime juice and red wine vinegar to make pico de gallo.
Divide potatoes into two serves. Top with bean mixture, pico de gallo and mashed avocado.

name: Mexican Kidney Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 x 125g tin corn kernels, drained and rinsed
1 x 400g tin kidney beans, drained and rinsed
method: Cook rice according to packet instructions.
Heat oil in a large frypan over medium-high heat. Add onion and heat 3 minutes. Add capsicum, corn and kidney beans and heat 7 minutes.
Mix in taco seasoning, then add cooked rice and crushed tomatoes. Stir well to combine.
Divide into two serves and store leftovers in the fridge. When ready to serve, sprinkle 20g nutritional yeast over each serve.

name: One-Pan Tempeh and Roasted Potatoes
method: Preheat oven to 200°C. Add tempeh, potatoes and carrot to a deep ovenproof dish.
Whisk together oil, salt, pepper, rosemary, garlic powder, oregano, thyme and paprika. Drizzle over tempeh and vegetables. Mix well to coat.
Roast 40–50 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Prepare side salad by combining spinach, tomato, onion and cucumber. Dress with lemon juice. Serve tempeh, potatoes, carrot and salad.

name: Signal Wild Blueberry Smoothie Bowl
method: Blend blueberries, almond milk, flaxseed, and ginger until thick.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with granola, kiwi slices, and hemp seeds.

name: Signal Oatmeal Cookie Dough Smoothie
method: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend on high until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass and enjoy immediately.

name: Signal Tropical Chia Pudding
method: Mix chia seeds with coconut milk and refrigerate overnight.
In the morning, layer with mango, pineapple, and passion fruit.
Top with shredded coconut and macadamia nuts.

name: Signal Kimchi Tofu Scramble Tacos
method: Sauté crumbled tofu with turmeric and nutritional yeast until golden.
Stir in kimchi and spinach until wilted.
Serve in warmed corn tortillas with avocado and sesame seeds.

name: Signal Orange Spice Overnight Oats
method: Combine oats, milk, orange juice, zest, chia, and spices in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with walnuts and cranberries before serving.

name: Signal Sun-Kissed Curry Carrot Soup
method: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add carrots, curry powder, and turmeric. Cook 2 minutes.
Add broth and coconut milk. Simmer 25 minutes until tender.
Blend until smooth. Garnish with fresh coriander.

name: Signal Rosemary Minestrone
method: Sauté carrots, celery, and zucchini in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, broth, rosemary, and beans. Bring to a boil.
Add pasta and kale. Simmer 15 minutes until pasta is cooked.
Season with salt and pepper. Remove rosemary before serving.

name: Signal 15-Minute Tortilla Soup
method: Combine tomatoes, broth, beans, corn, cumin, and paprika in a pot.
Bring to a boil, then simmer 10 minutes.
Serve topped with crispy tortilla strips, avocado, lime, and coriander.

name: Signal Creamy Miso-Peanut Noodle Bowl
method: Cook soba noodles according to packet. Drain and rinse.
Whisk miso, peanut butter, rice vinegar, and tamari with 2 tbsp warm water.
Toss noodles with sauce, edamame, cabbage, and carrot.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.

name: Signal Sweet Potato Lentil Curry
method: Sauté onion and garlic until soft. Add spices and cook 1 minute.
Add sweet potato, lentils, tomatoes, and coconut milk.
Simmer 25 minutes until lentils and sweet potato are tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Serve with coriander.

name: Signal Wild Rice Power Bowl
method: Cook wild rice according to packet instructions.
Arrange rice in bowls with beetroot, chickpeas, and rocket.
Top with walnuts, cranberries, and pumpkin seeds.
Drizzle with balsamic vinaigrette.

name: Signal Crunchy Tempeh Tacos
method: Sauté crumbled tempeh with paprika, cumin, and chilli until crispy.
Fill taco shells with tempeh, lettuce, and pickled onion.
Top with avocado, lime juice, and coriander.

name: Signal Speedy Chickpea Shakshuka
method: Sauté capsicum until soft. Add spices and cook 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and chickpeas. Simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted.
Serve with sourdough and fresh parsley.

name: Signal Southwest Quinoa Salad
method: Cook quinoa and let cool.
Toss with black beans, corn, capsicum, tomatoes, and onion.
Dress with lime juice, cumin, and olive oil.
Top with avocado and coriander.

name: Signal Eat the Rainbow Salad
method: Arrange cabbage, kale, and carrot in bowls.
Top with edamame, capsicum, and blueberries.
Sprinkle with hemp seeds and drizzle with tahini dressing.

name: Signal Hummus Kimchi Wraps
method: Spread hummus generously on each wrap.
Layer with kimchi, greens, carrot, and cucumber.
Sprinkle with sunflower seeds, roll tightly, and slice.

name: Signal Forbidden Rice Salad
method: Cook black rice according to packet and let cool.
Toss with mango, edamame, cabbage, onions, and mint.
Dress with rice vinegar, sesame oil, and tamari.

name: Signal Peanut Pumpkin Power Bowl
method: Arrange brown rice, roasted pumpkin, and broccoli in bowls.
Whisk peanut butter, tamari, lime juice, and sriracha with warm water.
Drizzle sauce over bowls. Top with peanuts and sesame seeds.

name: Signal Stir-Fried Veggie & Edamame Rice
method: Heat avocado oil in a wok over high heat.
Stir-fry broccoli and carrot 3 minutes.
Add rice, edamame, and corn. Cook 5 minutes.
Season with tamari, sesame oil, and garlic oil. Top with green onions.

name: Signal 5-Ingredient Energy Bites
ingredients: ⅓ cup raw honey or maple syrup
method: Mix all ingredients in a bowl until combined.
Roll into 12 bite-sized balls.
Refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving.

name: Signal Chocolate Raspberry Chia Parfait
method: Mix chia seeds, oat milk, cacao powder, and maple syrup. Refrigerate 2+ hours.
Layer chia pudding with raspberries and coconut yoghurt.
Top with cacao nibs.

name: "Snickers" Slice
method: Soak cashews and dates in boiling water for 20 min. Drain.
Pulse cashews until smooth. Divide in half.
Mix half with almond meal, 1 tbsp cacao, vanilla and maple. Press into lined 20cm tin.
Blend other half with dates, vanilla, maple and coconut oil. Stir through peanuts. Spread over base, chill 30 min.
Melt remaining coconut oil, cacao and maple. Pour over top. Chill until set. Cut into 24 pieces.

name: Banana & Cinnamon Pancakes
method: Combine all ingredients except maple syrup in a blender and blitz to a smooth pourable batter. Add a little extra milk if needed.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Pour in a third of the batter and cook 1–2 minutes each side until bubbles form.
Repeat with remaining batter. Serve with a drizzle of maple syrup.

name: Banana Breakfast Bites
method: Preheat oven to 180°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Mash banana until smooth.
Mix in peanut butter, apple, honey and vanilla until well combined. Add flour, oats and cinnamon and stir to combine.
Drop spoonfuls onto tray and bake 12–15 minutes until slightly browned. Allow to cool. Divide between two serves. Store leftovers in the fridge 3–4 days or freeze up to 2 months.

name: Healthy Caramel Slice
method: Soak dates and cashews in boiling water 15 min. Drain.
Mix oats, 1 tsp cacao, 2 tbsp coconut oil, 2 tbsp maple and 1/2 tsp vanilla. Press into lined tin.
Blend cashews, dates and remaining vanilla until smooth. Spread over base. Chill 30 min.
Melt remaining cacao, maple and coconut oil. Pour over top. Chill until set. Slice into 16.

name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Crumble Balls
method: Soak dates in boiling water 15 min. Drain.
Blend dates, oats, peanut butter and cacao until combined.
Roll into 20 balls, coat in desiccated coconut. 2 balls = 1 serve.

name: Chocolate Raspberry Ripple Cake
method: Simmer raspberries, chia, sweetener, lemon juice, zest and water 5 min. Cool.
Mix flour, coconut sugar, cacao and baking powder. Add almond milk and coconut oil.
Pour into lined 20cm tin. Swirl raspberry mixture through batter.
Bake at 180°C for 35-45 min. Cool and slice into 16.

name: Cookie Dough Bliss Balls
method: Spread flour on lined tray. Bake at 180°C for 5 min. Cool.
Mix all ingredients until doughy. Add extra milk if too dry.
Roll into 12 balls. 2 balls = 1 serve. Store in fridge up to 1 week.

name: Choc Hazelnut Freezer Pie
method: Blend 1/2 cup hazelnuts, sunflower seeds and dates. Press into lined springform tin. Freeze.
Grind 1/4 cup hazelnuts to meal. Blend with avocado, 3 tbsp cacao, maple and salt. Spread over base. Freeze.
Melt coconut oil, Natvia and remaining cacao. Pour over pie. Top with chopped remaining hazelnuts. Freeze 2 hours.

name: Chocolate Chip Chickpea Cookies
ingredients: 1.5 cups tinned chickpeas, rinsed and drained (180g)
method: Preheat oven to 200°C. Rinse chickpeas and dry well.
Blend chickpeas, peanut butter, milk, vanilla and baking powder until smooth. Fold in chocolate chips.
Drop tablespoons onto lined tray (16 cookies). Bake 15 min until lightly browned.

name: Coconut & Vanilla "Ice Cream"
method: Blend all ingredients until well combined.
Pour into freezer-proof container. Freeze 1-2 hours until firm.
Break up, re-blend until smooth. Serve as soft serve or refreeze until firm.

name: Chocolate Fudge
method: Blitz all ingredients in a high speed blender until smooth.
Press into a small baking tin and freeze for at least 1 hour.
Remove and cut into 8 pieces. Store in fridge or freezer.

name: Signal Iron Restore Bowl
method: Arrange warm lentils in bowls with spinach and roasted beetroot.
Add orange segments and pumpkin seeds.
Whisk tahini, lemon juice and cumin into a dressing. Drizzle and serve.

name: Signal Golden Immunity Soup
method: Sauté onion and garlic until soft. Add turmeric and ginger, stir 1 min.
Add kumara, lentils, stock and coconut milk. Simmer 20 min until tender.
Blend until smooth. Finish with lemon juice and coriander.

name: Signal Warming Miso Ramen
method: Heat stock to a simmer. Whisk in miso paste until dissolved.
Cook noodles separately. Pan-fry tofu until golden.
Assemble bowls: noodles, broth, tofu, bok choy. Top with spring onions, nori and sesame.

name: Signal Spring Grain Bowl
method: Arrange quinoa in bowls. Top with kimchi, avocado, edamame and carrot ribbons.
Sprinkle with hemp seeds and drizzle with dressing.

name: Signal Herbed Chickpea Flatbread
method: Whisk chickpea flour, water, 1 tbsp oil, cumin and rosemary. Rest 15 min.
Heat remaining oil in a pan. Pour batter, cook 4 min each side until golden.
Top with hummus, roasted capsicum and rocket.

name: Signal Citrus Tempeh Salad
method: Marinate tempeh in tamari and maple syrup 10 min. Pan-fry until caramelised.
Toss greens, cabbage, orange and seeds. Top with tempeh.
Drizzle with citrus-tahini dressing.

name: Signal Rainbow Nourish Plate
method: Arrange quinoa on plates. Layer with tomatoes, cucumber, mango and avocado.
Scatter pumpkin seeds and fresh herbs. Drizzle with lime dressing.

name: Signal Green Goddess Wrap
method: Spread mashed avocado on each wrap.
Layer with sprouts, cucumber, spinach and hemp seeds.
Squeeze lemon, season and roll tightly.

name: Signal Mango Cashew Sushi Bowl
method: Divide rice between bowls. Arrange mango, avocado, edamame and cashews.
Add nori strips and pickled ginger. Serve with tamari and wasabi.

name: Signal Magnesium Power Bowl
method: Roast kumara at 200°C for 25 min. Massage kale with a drizzle of olive oil.
Assemble bowls with rice, kumara, kale and chickpeas.
Whisk tahini, lemon and maple for dressing. Drizzle and top with pumpkin seeds.

name: Signal Comfort Dhal
method: Sauté onion, garlic and ginger until fragrant. Add spices, stir 1 min.
Add lentils, coconut milk and stock. Simmer 20 min until lentils are soft.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Finish with lemon juice and coriander.

name: Signal PMS Ease Stew
method: Sauté onion and garlic. Add pumpkin and spices, cook 3 min.
Add beans, tomatoes and stock. Simmer 30 min until pumpkin is tender.
Serve with fresh coriander and lime wedges.

name: Signal Seed Cycling Granola
method: Preheat oven to 160°C. Mix all dry ingredients.
Combine maple, coconut oil and vanilla. Pour over dry mix and stir well.
Spread on lined tray. Bake 20 min, stirring halfway.
Cool completely — it will crisp as it cools. Store in jar up to 2 weeks.

name: Signal Adaptogen Hot Cacao
method: Heat oat milk in a saucepan until steaming (not boiling).
Whisk in cacao, maca, cinnamon and maple syrup until frothy.
Pour and enjoy warm.

name: Signal Omega-3 Breakfast Bowl
method: Cook oats with oat milk and chia seeds until creamy.
Top with hemp seeds, walnuts, banana and a drizzle of tahini.
Finish with maple syrup.

name: Signal Hormone Balance Smoothie
method: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Serve immediately.

name: Signal Anti-Inflammatory Curry
method: Sauté onion until soft. Add turmeric, cumin and ginger, stir 1 min.
Add chickpeas, cauliflower, tomatoes and coconut milk. Simmer 25 min.
Stir in spinach. Serve over brown rice.

name: Signal Protein Recovery Bowl
method: Pan-fry tofu with tamari until golden. Steam broccoli.
Assemble bowls with quinoa, tofu, broccoli and avocado.
Drizzle with tahini-sesame dressing.

name: Loaded Mediterranean Bowl
ingredients: Optional: ½ cup cooked chicken breast
method: Cook rice according to package directions.
In a bowl, combine rice, chicken (if using), chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion and feta cheese.
Top with lemon juice, olive oil, and salt and pepper to taste.

name: Bagel with Cream Cheese and Turkey
method: Top bagel with cream cheese then add lettuce leaves and slices of turkey. No cooking required.

name: Tuna with Pecans and Olives
method: Combine canned tuna with pecans and olives; drizzle with olive oil. No cooking required.

name: Apple with Walnuts and Cheddar
method: Slice apple and serve alongside walnuts and cheddar cheese. No cooking required.

name: Full-Fat Yogurt with Fruit and Tahini
method: Top yogurt with sliced fruit; drizzle tahini and add a pinch of salt. No cooking required.

name: Poached Eggs with Sautéed Greens
method: Poach eggs in simmering water. Sauté greens in olive oil until wilted. Serve together.

name: Quinoa Porridge with Fried Egg
method: Cook quinoa with water or milk to a porridge consistency. Fry egg and place on top.

name: Sausage and Broiled Tomatoes
method: Cook sausages in a pan. Halve tomatoes and broil until tender. Serve together.

name: Scrambled Eggs with Goat Cheese
method: Scramble eggs in butter over low heat. Crumble goat cheese over the top before serving.

name: Toast with Fried Egg
method: Toast bread. Fry egg in butter and place on top of toast.

name: Warm Lentils with Fried Egg
method: Warm cooked lentils in a pan. Fry egg separately and place on top of lentils.

name: Glucose-Healthy Protein Smoothie
method: Blend 2 scoops protein powder with 1 tbsp flaxseed oil, ¼ avocado, 1 tbsp almond butter, ½ banana, 1 cup frozen berries, and unsweetened almond milk until smooth.

name: ACV Ginger Lemon Hot Drink
ingredients: allulose or monk fruit or stevia

name: Soft-Boiled Egg with Salt and Pepper
Vegan Egg Roll Bowl
method: Cook rice according to packet instructions. Prepare TVP by pouring boiling water over it and allowing to sit for 5 minutes.
Heat 5ml sesame oil in a pan over medium heat. Add onion and TVP and cook 4–5 minutes.
Add coleslaw mix, carrots, garlic, ginger, 40ml soy sauce and remaining sesame oil. Stir. Cover and cook 7–8 minutes until cabbage has softened.
Prepare sauce by combining mayo, sriracha and remaining soy sauce. Divide rice into four serves, top with TVP and vegetable mixture. Drizzle sauce over when ready to serve.
